name: US Heatwave CDD Spike → Data Center Cooling Cost
rule: Each summer (Jun-Aug): compute CDD proxy as avg daily high temp in DC corridor states (VA, TX, AZ) from NOAA/FRED. When summer is hotter than normal (top quartile of 10yr CDD distribution), short DLR+EQIX equal-weight vs long SPY from Jun 1 through Aug 31. Exit Aug 31.
entry_conditions: June 1 each year
Simpler proxy: compare DLR+EQIX summer return vs SPY in hot vs normal summers
exit_conditions: August 31 each year

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance DLR, EQIX, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: NOAA CDD data or FRED CDSD (cooling degree days)

backtest_approach: Simpler version: compute DLR+EQIX Jun-Aug return minus SPY Jun-Aug return each year 2015-2025. Compare hot summers (2018, 2023, 2024) vs normal. If DC REITs underperform more in hot summers, signal has edge.
known_events: 2020 (normal)
2023 (record hot)
implementation_notes: CDD data may not be on FRED directly — use temperature proxy or just test the seasonal short without conditioning on heat.

name: USDA Cattle on Feed Report Week → Feeder Cattle
rule: Without consensus estimates, compute monthly return of feeder cattle futures proxy during USDA Cattle on Feed report week (3rd Friday of each month) vs non-report weeks. If GF=F unavailable, try COW ETF. If no livestock data on yfinance, mark_failed.
entry_conditions: 3rd Friday of each month (USDA Cattle on Feed release date)
exit_conditions: 5 trading days after entry

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance GF=F or COW

backtest_approach: Identify 3rd Friday of each month 2015-2025. Compute 5-day return of feeder cattle proxy starting that day. Compare to average 5-day return for non-report weeks. Test via t-test of report-week vs non-report-week returns.

backtest_result.verdict: weak — report-week vs non-report-week difference not statistically significant (p=0.67)

name: China PMI Expansion Cross → Copper
rule: Hand-code months when China Manufacturing PMI crossed above 50 after 2+ months below: 2016-03, 2020-04, 2023-01, 2025-04. For each event: long HG=F (copper) for 10 trading days from the 1st of that month. Compute per-event and aggregate metrics.
entry_conditions: China PMI crosses above 50 after 2+ months below
exit_conditions: 10 trading days after entry

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance HG=F, SPY

backtest_approach: Hand-coded event dates. Long copper for 10 trading days per event. Compute per-event return and aggregate Sharpe/CAGR from event-driven PnL series.

backtest_result.verdict: promising direction (3/4 wins, avg +2.7%) but only 4 events — low statistical power

name: USDA Food Recall → Short Protein Processor
rule: Hand-code major Class I recalls at publicly traded protein processors. Short the named ticker from T+1 for 5 trading days. Events: 2018-10-04 JBSAY, 2019-04-12 TSN, 2021-11-09 TSN, 2022-04-16 JBSAY, 2024-07-19 JBSAY. If JBSAY data spotty, use TSN as sector proxy for all.
entry_conditions: Class I food recall announcement at a publicly traded protein processor
exit_conditions: 5 trading days after T+1

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance TSN, JBSAY, SPY

backtest_approach: Event study: short from T+1 for 5 days per recall event. Compute per-event return and aggregate stats.

backtest_result.verdict: failed — TSN actually rallied after most recall events (4/5 shorts lost); thesis rejected

name: Housing Permits/Completions Ratio → Long Aggregates
rule: Use FRED series PERMIT and COMPUTSA. Compute monthly ratio. When ratio crosses above 1.3: long equal-weight VMC+MLM+EXP for 6 months. Compare to SPY.
entry_conditions: PERMIT/COMPUTSA ratio crosses above 1.3
exit_conditions: 6 months (126 trading days) after entry

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance VMC, MLM, EXP, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED PERMIT, COMPUTSA

backtest_approach: Load FRED data for PERMIT and COMPUTSA. Compute ratio monthly. Identify cross-above-1.3 events. Long aggregates basket for 126 trading days. Compute metrics vs SPY benchmark.

backtest_result.verdict: strong — 11/12 events positive (avg +18.1% in 6m), t=2.53, +14% excess CAGR vs SPY

name: CDC Wastewater Viral Surge → Pharma
rule: Hand-code known viral surge events: 2021-12-01 Omicron, 2022-12-01 winter tripledemic, 2023-09-01 fall COVID wave, 2024-12-01 winter RSV/flu. For each: long equal-weight DGX+LH+MRNA for 30 trading days from surge start. Compute per-event and aggregate metrics vs SPY.
entry_conditions: CDC wastewater viral load spikes >2σ above seasonal baseline
exit_conditions: 30 trading days after entry

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance DGX, LH, MRNA, SPY

backtest_approach: Hand-coded event dates. Long pharma basket for 30 trading days per event. Compute per-event return and aggregate Sharpe/CAGR vs SPY.

backtest_result.verdict: failed — pharma basket (esp MRNA) fell during 3/4 viral surges; MRNA drag dominates

name: Jet Fuel Crack Spread → Short Airlines vs Long XLE
rule: Compute jet fuel crack proxy: FRED series WPU0572 (PPI kerosene-type jet fuel) minus DCOILWTICO (WTI). When 3-month rolling z-score of the spread > 1.5: short equal-weight UAL+DAL+LUV, long XLE; hold 60 trading days.
entry_conditions: 3-month z-score of jet-fuel-crack-proxy > 1.5
exit_conditions: 60 trading days
or z-score reverts below 0.5

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance UAL, DAL, LUV, XLE, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED DCOILWTICO (WTI crude)

backtest_approach: Compute monthly jet fuel PPI vs WTI spread. Z-score over 36mo rolling window. When z > 1.5, enter short airlines/long XLE pair. Track pair return over 60 trading days.
implementation_notes: FRED WPU0572 is monthly PPI — use as regime indicator not daily signal. If WPU0572 unavailable, use DJETNY (NY Harbor kerosene spot) or DJFUELUSGULF.

name: BNPL Delinquency → Short AFRM / Long JPM+WFC
rule: Regime trade: short AFRM vs long (JPM+WFC)/2 from Jan 2023 (when BNPL DQ started rising per CFPB) through present.

name: Scrap Steel / HRC Spread → Long EAF Mills
rule: Use FRED WPUSI019011 (steel PPI) as HRC proxy. When 6mo rolling return of steel PPI > 10% while NUE/STLD are flat/down (spread divergence), long NUE+STLD equal-weight for 120 trading days.

name: Class 8 Truck Order Trough → Long PCAR+CMI
rule: Hand-code Class 8 order trough months from ACT Research: 2009-05 (GFC), 2016-01 (industrial recession), 2019-10 (freight recession), 2023-01 (post-COVID normalization). Entry: 12 months after trough. Long PCAR+CMI equal-weight for 12 months.

name: Rental Vacancy Trough → Long Apartment REITs
rule: Use FRED RRVRUSQ156N. When quarterly vacancy rate hits local minimum (lower than both prior and next quarter) AND level < 5.5%: long EQR+AVB+MAA equal-weight for 12 months from the quarter following the trough.
fix_note: loosened vacancy threshold from <5.5% to <8.0% (typical US apt vacancy is 6-7%)

name: BDI Spike → Long Dry Bulk Shippers
rule: Use BDRY ETF as BDI proxy (or FRED if available). When BDRY 60-day return > +50%: long SBLK+GOGL equal-weight for 60 trading days.

name: Initial Claims Acceleration → Long TLT / Short XLY
rule: Load FRED ICSA weekly. Compute 4-week MA. When 4wk MA rises >15% from its trailing 26-week low AND level > 250k: long TLT, short XLY equal-weight. Exit when 4wk MA falls back below the 26-week low +10% (recovery confirmed). If both TLT and XLY unavailable for early periods, start from 2003.
entry_conditions: ICSA 4wk MA > 1.15 * trailing 26wk low
ICSA 4wk MA > 250000
exit_conditions: ICSA 4wk MA < 1.10 * trailing 26wk low (recovery)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance TLT, XLY, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED ICSA

backtest_approach: Daily pair PnL: long TLT return - short XLY return. Only in-position when claims signal is active.

name: Soybean Export Season Momentum (Oct-Jan)
rule: Long ZS=F (soybean futures) from Oct 1 through Jan 31 each year. This captures the peak US soybean export season when China/global buyers take delivery of the new-crop harvest. Compare to holding ZS=F year-round.
entry_conditions: October 1 each year
exit_conditions: January 31 each year

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance ZS=F, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: none (calendar-based seasonal)

backtest_approach: Compute Oct 1 - Jan 31 return of ZS=F each year 2010-2025. Compare to full-year ZS=F return and to same-period SPY. Build event-year series.
implementation_notes: Original idea needed USDA Export Inspections weekly data (not freely available in machine-readable format). Pivoted to seasonal proxy capturing the same export demand window.

name: Winter Wheat Drought Abandonment → Long KC Wheat
rule: Hand-code years when USDA winter wheat condition ratings showed poor/very-poor >35% by March (drought stress during dormancy). In those years: long KE=F from March 1, hold through May 31 (spans WASDE production cut). Known drought-abandonment years: 2011, 2013, 2014, 2018, 2022, 2023. Control: same trade in non-drought years.
entry_conditions: March 1 in drought-abandonment years (USDA poor/very-poor > 35% by March)
exit_conditions: May 31 (post-WASDE)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance KE=F, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: USDA Crop Progress winter wheat conditions (hand-coded drought years)

backtest_approach: Event study: compute KE=F Mar 1 - May 31 return in drought years vs non-drought years. Drought years hand-coded from USDA Crop Progress historical data.
implementation_notes: Original thesis used NASA SMAP soil moisture (geospatial processing heavy). Pivoted to USDA Crop Progress poor/very-poor ratings as proxy — same information content, available historically. KE=F is KC HRW wheat futures.

name: Great Lakes Heavy Ice → Long EAF Mills / Short BF Mills
rule: Hand-code heavy ice years (NOAA GLERL peak ice >60%): 2014, 2015, 2018, 2019. In each heavy-ice year: long NUE+STLD equal-weight, short CLF from Mar 1 through May 15 (covers delayed Soo Locks opening + pellet shortage window). Compare to same pair trade in light-ice years.
entry_conditions: March 1 in heavy-ice years (GLERL peak >60%)
exit_conditions: May 15 (Soo Locks fully operational + pellet shipments resume)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance NUE, STLD, CLF, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: NOAA GLERL peak ice cover (hand-coded by year)

backtest_approach: Event study: long (NUE+STLD)/2 - short CLF Mar 1 to May 15. Compare heavy-ice years (2014, 2015, 2018, 2019) to light-ice control years (2012, 2016, 2017, 2020, 2021, 2023). X (US Steel) is delisted; CLF (Cleveland-Cliffs) is the remaining integrated BF steel maker.
implementation_notes: X delisted (Nippon Steel acquisition). Use CLF as BF short leg. CLF acquired AK Steel (2020) and ArcelorMittal USA (2020) — now the dominant US blast-furnace operator. Pre-2020 CLF was a pure iron ore miner, which actually makes it a better proxy for pellet-shortage exposure.

name: Gulf Hurricane Season → Long Refiners (Jul-Oct)
rule: In hyperactive hurricane years (CSU Jun forecast >17 named storms): long equal-weight VLO+PSX+MPC from Jul 1 through Oct 31. Refiners capture crack spread spikes from Gulf crude shut-ins while their own refineries (Gulf Coast + Midwest) continue running on pipeline-delivered crude. Hand-coded hyperactive years: 2005, 2008, 2017, 2020, 2021.
entry_conditions: July 1 in hyperactive hurricane years (CSU Jun forecast >17 named storms)
exit_conditions: October 31

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance VLO, PSX, MPC, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: CSU June hurricane forecast (free); BSEE shut-in reports (free)

backtest_approach: Event study: refiner basket Jul 1 - Oct 31 return in hyperactive years vs non-hyperactive. Also compare to SPY same window. PSX only listed since 2012 — use VLO+MPC for pre-2012 events.
implementation_notes: PSX IPO'd Apr 2012. For 2005/2008 events use VLO+MPC only. MPC IPO'd Jul 2011 — for 2005/2008 use VLO+SUN (Sunoco, pre-2012 refiner)... actually just use VLO alone for pre-2012.

name: NHTSA Engineering Analysis → Short Auto OEM
rule: When NHTSA opens an Engineering Analysis on a model with >500K affected units: short the OEM for 60 trading days. Hand-coded EA events: 2019-01 TSLA (suspension), 2020-10 F (transmission), 2022-06 TSLA (Autopilot 830K units), 2023-03 GM (Bolt battery recall extension).
entry_conditions: NHTSA EA opened on model with >500K affected units
exit_conditions: 60 trading days

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance TSLA, F, GM, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: NHTSA investigations database (free, hand-coded)

backtest_approach: Event study: short the named OEM on EA opening date for 60 trading days. Compute per-event return and aggregate. Compare short return to SPY return same window.
implementation_notes: Small N (4 events). Some EAs don't lead to recalls (false positives). TSLA appears twice — weight events equally regardless of OEM.

name: Poultry Cold Storage Glut → Short TSN+PPC
rule: Hand-code months when USDA Cold Storage frozen poultry stocks exceeded 5yr avg by >15%: 2017-02, 2018-08, 2019-02, 2022-08, 2024-02. Short equal-weight TSN+PPC for 60 trading days from the Cold Storage report date (~22nd of month). Compare to SPY same period.
entry_conditions: USDA Cold Storage frozen poultry >15% above 5yr avg
exit_conditions: 60 trading days

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance TSN, PPC, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: USDA Cold Storage (hand-coded glut months)

backtest_approach: Event study: short TSN+PPC equal-weight on glut month report date for 60 trading days. 5 hand-coded events. Short return = -(stock return).
implementation_notes: PPC (Pilgrim's Pride) IPO was 2009 — data available for all events. Cold Storage report typically released ~22nd of each month.

name: SEMI B2B Inflection → Long Specialty Chem + Equipment
rule: When SEMI NA B2B crosses above 1.05 from a downcycle trough (prior 3+ months below 0.95): long equal-weight ENTG+AMAT+LRCX for 6 months (126 trading days). Hand-coded inflection dates: 2013-07, 2016-11, 2019-12, 2024-03.
entry_conditions: SEMI B2B crosses above 1.05 after 3+ months below 0.95
exit_conditions: 126 trading days (6 months)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance ENTG, AMAT, LRCX, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: SEMI B2B press releases (hand-coded inflection dates)

backtest_approach: Event study: long basket on inflection date for 126 days. 4 events. CCMP acquired by ENTG 2022 — use ENTG for all periods. Pre-2014 ENTG data may be thin (IPO 1999 but small-cap).
implementation_notes: CCMP delisted (acquired by ENTG Jul 2022). ENTG is now the dominant specialty consumables play. AMAT/LRCX are equipment — include to diversify the basket but the thesis is really about consumables volume lagging equipment orders.

name: CFPB Complaint Surge → Short Target Before Enforcement
rule: Hand-code dates when CFPB complaint surges led to enforcement. Short the company from complaint-surge detection (6-12mo before enforcement). Events: 2016-04 WFC (enforcement Sep 2016), 2022-01 SYF (consent order Nov 2022), 2023-06 SQ (enforcement Jan 2025), 2024-01 ALLY (consent order Mar 2025). Hold until enforcement announcement or 12 months.
entry_conditions: CFPB complaint volume for company >3σ above 12mo baseline for 2+ months
exit_conditions: Enforcement action announced OR 12 months

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance WFC, SYF, SQ, ALLY, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: CFPB Complaint Database (free API, hand-coded surge dates)

backtest_approach: Event study: short named company on complaint-surge date, hold 6 months (126 days). 4 events. Compute per-event short return vs SPY.
implementation_notes: Small N (4). The signal is hard to detect in real-time without parsing the CFPB API daily. But the complaint database is free and the surge→enforcement link is well-documented. Insider selling often co-occurs (check Form 4 as confirmation).

name: Rig Count -20% → Long Crude/XOP 6mo Later
rule: When Baker Hughes US oil rig count drops >20% from trailing 12mo peak: wait 6 months (DUC depletion window), then long equal-weight CL=F + XOP for 6 months (126 trading days). The 6mo wait captures the production lag — rigs drop immediately but production holds on DUCs before declining.
entry_conditions: Baker Hughes rigs crossed -20% from 12mo peak
Entry 6 months after the -20% crossing
exit_conditions: 126 trading days (6 months)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance CL=F, XOP, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: Baker Hughes rig count (hand-coded threshold crossing dates)

backtest_approach: Event study: entry 6mo after rig -20% threshold. Long CL=F + XOP equal-weight for 126 days. 5 events: 2009, 2015, 2016, 2020, 2024.
implementation_notes: XOP ETF started Jan 2006 — available for all events. CL=F has longer history. Use both in equal-weight basket. The key insight is the 6-month DELAY between rig decline and production response — this is the DUC depletion lag that the market consistently misprices.

name: Major Patent Cliff Year → Long Generic Pharma
rule: In years when >$20B of branded drug revenue faces patent expiry (hand-coded from FDA Orange Book): long TEVA+VTRS equal-weight from Jan 1 for 12 months. Generic pharma benefits from launch of high-value ANDAs. Cliff years: 2012, 2016, 2023. Non-cliff control years for comparison.
entry_conditions: Jan 1 of major patent cliff year (>$20B branded revenue expiring)
exit_conditions: Dec 31 (full calendar year)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance TEVA, VTRS, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FDA Orange Book patent expiry (hand-coded cliff years)

backtest_approach: Event study: long TEVA+VTRS Jan-Dec in cliff years vs control years. VTRS (Viatris) was Mylan pre-Nov 2020 — use MYL for pre-2020.
implementation_notes: VTRS spun out of Pfizer/Mylan Nov 2020. Use MYL ticker for pre-2020. TEVA data back to 2006. Small N (3 cliff years).

name: Auto Inventory Days-Supply Trough → Long Dealers
rule: Use FRED AISRSA (auto inventory/sales ratio). When the ratio hits a local minimum AND the level is below 0.40 (representing <40 days supply vs ~60 normal): long equal-weight AN+PAG+LAD for 6 months (126 trading days). The trough means dealers have maximum pricing power right now — margins are already fat but haven't hit earnings yet.
entry_conditions: FRED AISRSA hits local minimum (lower than both prior and next month)
AISRSA level < 0.40
exit_conditions: 126 trading days (6 months)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance AN, PAG, LAD, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED AISRSA (monthly, free)

backtest_approach: Load FRED AISRSA monthly. Find local minima below 0.40. Long dealer basket for 126 days from the month after the trough. Compare to SPY.
implementation_notes: AISRSA ratio of ~1.0 = ~30 days supply. Below 0.40 is extreme scarcity. Should fire during chip shortage era (2021-2022) and any prior inventory squeezes.

name: ISM New Orders − Inventories Spread > +10 → Long XLI
rule: Compute monthly ISM Manufacturing New Orders index minus Inventories index using FRED NAPMNOI and NAPMII. When the spread crosses above +10 (strong orders, lean inventories = restocking imminent): long XLI for 126 trading days. Markets focus on headline PMI; the internal spread is a purer demand signal.
entry_conditions: FRED NAPMNOI - NAPMII > +10 (crossing from below)
exit_conditions: 126 trading days (6 months)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance XLI, CAT, DE, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED NAPMNOI (ISM New Orders), NAPMII (ISM Inventories) — both monthly, free

backtest_approach: Load FRED NAPMNOI and NAPMII monthly. Compute spread. Identify months where spread first crosses above +10 from below. Long XLI for 126 days from the first trading day of the following month. Compare to SPY.
implementation_notes: FRED NAPMNOI and NAPMII go back to 1948 — extremely long history for backtest. The spread crosses +10 approximately 2-4 times per decade, typically at the start of restocking cycles. XLI ETF starts Sep 1998.

name: Fed ON RRP Drain Below $500B → Long SPY
rule: Use FRED RRPONTSYD (daily ON RRP balance). When the balance crosses below $500B for the first time after being above $1T: long SPY for 252 trading days (12 months). The drain signals liquidity flowing from the Fed facility back into the banking system and risk assets. Compare to unconditional SPY buy-and-hold.
entry_conditions: FRED RRPONTSYD crosses below $500B
Must have been above $1T within the prior 12 months (confirms a drain, not perpetually low)
exit_conditions: 252 trading days (12 months)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED RRPONTSYD (daily, free)

backtest_approach: Load FRED RRPONTSYD daily. Find dates where balance crosses below $500B from above. Long SPY for 252 days. Given RRP facility only large since 2021, this has very few events (possibly just 2024). Supplement with a broader test: SPY returns when RRP is declining >$100B/month vs stable/rising.
implementation_notes: The ON RRP facility was near zero before 2021, peaked at $2.6T Dec 2022, drained through 2023-2024. Very limited backtest history — the facility at scale is a post-COVID phenomenon. Consider also testing: monthly change in RRPONTSYD as a continuous signal (negative = draining = bullish).

name: La Niña Winter → Long Natural Gas Oct-Mar
rule: Hand-code La Niña winters from NOAA CPC ENSO advisories: 2007-08, 2008-09, 2010-11, 2011-12, 2016-17 (weak), 2017-18 (weak), 2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23. In La Niña years: long NG=F from Oct 1 through Mar 31. In El Niño years (2009-10, 2014-15, 2015-16, 2018-19, 2023-24): stay flat. Compare La Niña winter NG returns to neutral/El Niño winters.
entry_conditions: NOAA CPC La Niña Advisory/Watch issued by July
Long NG=F on Oct 1
exit_conditions: Mar 31

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance NG=F, UNG, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: NOAA CPC ENSO Advisory (hand-coded La Niña years)

backtest_approach: Event study: compute NG=F Oct-Mar return in La Niña years vs El Niño/neutral years. 9 La Niña winters since 2007. Use UNG as fallback if NG=F data is spotty on yfinance.
implementation_notes: NG=F on yfinance is the front-month Henry Hub contract — subject to roll yield drag. UNG ETF has the same issue. The signal is about seasonal demand, not the contango cost. For a cleaner test, compare La Niña vs El Niño returns rather than absolute returns to control for structural contango.

name: Existing Home Months-Supply < 3.0 → Long Homebuilders
rule: Use FRED MSACSR (monthly supply of existing homes). When the ratio crosses below 3.0 months for the first time in a cycle (after being above 3.5 for 6+ months): long equal-weight LEN+DHI+NVR for 252 trading days. Extreme scarcity of existing homes forces buyers to new construction, giving homebuilders pricing power. Compare to SPY.
entry_conditions: FRED MSACSR crosses below 3.0 months
Must have been above 3.5 within prior 6 months (confirms a new tightening cycle)
exit_conditions: 252 trading days (12 months)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance LEN, DHI, NVR, XHB, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED MSACSR (monthly, free)

backtest_approach: Load FRED MSACSR monthly. Identify months where ratio first crosses below 3.0 from above 3.5. Long homebuilder basket for 252 days. MSACSR data on FRED goes back to 1999. Key events likely: 2004-05, 2020-21, 2022.
implementation_notes: NVR has been public since 1993 but is pricey — equal-weight basket normalizes this. XHB ETF (started 2006) can serve as a broader alternative. The thesis is fundamentally long-side: scarcity = pricing power = margin expansion.

name: Conference Board LEI 6mo RoC Turns Positive → Long SPY
rule: Use FRED USSLIND (Conference Board LEI). Compute 6-month annualized rate of change: ((LEI_t / LEI_{t-6})^2 - 1) * 100. When this turns positive after 6+ consecutive months of negative readings: long SPY for 252 trading days. The positive inflection signals the recession/slowdown trough is past. Compare to unconditional buy-and-hold.
entry_conditions: FRED USSLIND 6-month RoC turns positive
After 6+ consecutive months of negative 6mo RoC
exit_conditions: 252 trading days (12 months)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED USSLIND (monthly, free, back to 1959)

backtest_approach: Load FRED USSLIND monthly. Compute 6mo annualized RoC. Find months where RoC first turns positive after 6+ negative months. Long SPY for 252 days. Very long history — should capture 1960s, 1970s, 1980s, 1990s, 2000s, 2010s, 2020s recessions. SPY only from 1993 — use ^GSPC for earlier periods.
implementation_notes: SPY starts 1993. For pre-1993, use ^GSPC (S&P 500 index from yfinance). USSLIND on FRED goes to 1959 — very long history gives statistical power. Expect ~8-10 events since 1960.

name: DXY 3-Month Spike > +8% → Long EEM After Rollover
rule: Use FRED DTWEXBGS (trade-weighted dollar, broad, daily). Compute rolling 63-day (3-month) return. When the 63-day return exceeds +8%: mark a DXY spike event. Wait until the 63-day return rolls below +4% (confirmed rollover). Then long EEM for 63 trading days (3 months). The thesis is mean reversion in EM equities after forced-selling exhaustion.
entry_conditions: FRED DTWEXBGS 63-day return exceeds +8% (spike event flagged)
Entry on the day 63-day return falls back below +4% (confirmed rollover)
exit_conditions: 63 trading days (3 months)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance EEM, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED DTWEXBGS (daily, free, back to 2006)

backtest_approach: Load FRED DTWEXBGS daily. Compute 63-day rolling return. Find spike events (>+8%) and subsequent rollovers (<+4%). Long EEM for 63 days from rollover confirmation. EEM data from 2003. DTWEXBGS from 2006.
implementation_notes: The 30-day wait from the original idea is replaced by a rollover confirmation (63d return < +4%) which is more mechanically precise. This ensures entry after the DXY has peaked, not during the spike.

name: SLOOS Net Tightening > +40% → Long TLT (Rate Cut Anticipation)
rule: Use FRED DRTSCILM (net % banks tightening C&I loan standards, quarterly). When DRTSCILM crosses above +40: long TLT for 189 trading days (9 months). Major credit tightening leads Fed rate cuts by 2-4 quarters as the credit contraction slows the economy. LONG-SIDE ONLY: original idea included short HYG; converted to pure long TLT to avoid short-side drag.
entry_conditions: FRED DRTSCILM crosses above +40 (net % tightening)
exit_conditions: 189 trading days (9 months)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance TLT, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED DRTSCILM (quarterly, free, back to 1990)

backtest_approach: Load FRED DRTSCILM quarterly. Identify quarters where net tightening first crosses +40 from below. Long TLT from the first trading day of the following quarter for 189 days. TLT from 2002. For pre-2002, use long-duration Treasury return proxy or just backtest 2002+.
implementation_notes: Original thesis was long TLT / short HYG pair. Converted to long-only TLT per pipeline rule (0/8 short-side wins). The TLT leg alone should capture the rate-cut anticipation premium. DRTSCILM data quarterly — low frequency signal, expect 4-6 events since 1990 (2001, 2007-08, 2020, 2022-23).

name: High-Rate Regime + Maturity Wall → Long VCSH (Short-Duration IG Outperformance)
rule: Use FRED DGS10 (10Y yield) and DGS2 (2Y yield). When DGS10 > 4.5% AND the yield curve is inverted (DGS2 > DGS10): long VCSH for 252 trading days. In a high-rate inverted-curve regime, short-duration IG credit earns higher carry with less duration risk, while long-duration issuers face refinancing pressure. Compare to LQD (long-duration IG) and SPY.
entry_conditions: FRED DGS10 > 4.5%
FRED DGS2 > DGS10 (curve inverted)
exit_conditions: 252 trading days (12 months)
OR DGS10 drops below 3.5% (rate regime change)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance VCSH, LQD, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED DGS10, DGS2 (daily, free)

backtest_approach: Load FRED DGS10 and DGS2 daily. Identify periods where DGS10 > 4.5% AND DGS2 > DGS10. Long VCSH for 252 days from entry. VCSH ETF from 2009. Need high-rate + inverted curve periods: 2006-2007, 2023-2024. Limited events post-GFC given low rates.
implementation_notes: Original thesis was short LQD / long VCSH. Converted to long-only VCSH per pipeline rule. VCSH carries positive yield regardless of market direction. The regime filter (high rates + inversion) ensures we only enter when refinancing stress is real. LQD tracked as benchmark for comparison, not traded.

name: Bankruptcy Filings Surge → Long Restructuring Advisors (HLI/LAZ/PJT)
rule: Use FRED TNBCBSL (total nonfarm business bankruptcy filings, quarterly) as proxy. When quarterly filings rise >30% YoY for 2+ consecutive quarters: long equal-weight HLI+LAZ+PJT for 252 trading days. Restructuring advisory fees surge with a 2-3 quarter lag after filings jump. Compare to SPY.
entry_conditions: FRED TNBCBSL YoY change > +30% for 2 consecutive quarters
exit_conditions: 252 trading days (12 months)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance HLI, LAZ, PJT, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED TNBCBSL (quarterly, free)

backtest_approach: Load FRED TNBCBSL quarterly. Compute YoY change. Identify quarters where YoY > +30% for 2+ consecutive quarters. Long restructuring basket for 252 days. HLI IPO 2015, PJT IPO 2015, LAZ available longer. Pre-2015 use LAZ only. Key event clusters: 2008-2009, 2015-2016 (energy), 2020, 2023-2024.
implementation_notes: HLI is the purest restructuring play (#1 by number of mandates). LAZ restructuring is ~20% of total revenue. PJT Partners spun from Blackstone in 2015. For pre-2015 events use LAZ alone. TNBCBSL on FRED may have limited history — check availability, may need ABI data as supplement.

name: STLFSI4 Spike > +1.0 → Long Gold (Flight to Quality)
rule: Use FRED STLFSI4 (St. Louis Fed Financial Stress Index, weekly). When STLFSI4 crosses above +1.0: long GLD for 42 trading days (2 months). Flight-to-quality drives gold higher during broad financial stress events. LONG-SIDE ONLY: original idea included short IWM; converted to pure long GLD per pipeline rule. Compare to SPY same period.
entry_conditions: FRED STLFSI4 crosses above +1.0 (stressed territory)
exit_conditions: 42 trading days (2 months)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance GLD, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED STLFSI4 (weekly, free, back to 1994)

backtest_approach: Load FRED STLFSI4 weekly. Identify weeks where index first crosses above +1.0 from below. Long GLD for 42 trading days. GLD from Nov 2004. For pre-2004, use gold price proxy from yfinance (GC=F). Events expected: 2008 (GFC), 2010 (Euro crisis), 2011 (US downgrade), 2020 (COVID), 2023 (SVB).
implementation_notes: Original thesis was long GLD / short IWM. Converted to long-only GLD. Existing signal AB-10 uses STLFSI4 differently (equity reduction); this is a distinct implementation targeting gold. STLFSI4 replaced STLFSI2 in 2023 — use STLFSI4 for backtest continuity.

name: Real Retail Sales YoY Negative → Long XLP (Staples Outperformance)
rule: Use FRED RRSFS (real retail and food services sales, monthly). Compute YoY change. When YoY turns negative for the first time after 12+ months positive: long XLP (consumer staples) for 126 trading days. Consumer staples outperform during consumer spending contractions as staples demand is inelastic. LONG-SIDE ONLY: original idea was short XLY / long XLP; converted to pure long XLP. Compare to SPY.
entry_conditions: FRED RRSFS YoY turns negative
After 12+ months of positive YoY readings
exit_conditions: 126 trading days (6 months)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance XLP, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED RRSFS (monthly, free, back to 1992)

backtest_approach: Load FRED RRSFS monthly. Compute YoY change. Find months where YoY first goes negative after 12+ positive months. Long XLP for 126 days. XLP from 1998. RRSFS from 1992. Expected events: 2001, 2008-2009, 2020 (brief). May also fire in 2022 when real retail sales declined due to inflation outpacing nominal growth.
implementation_notes: Original thesis was long XLP / short XLY pair. Converted to long-only XLP. The outperformance thesis should work on a standalone basis — staples have lower drawdowns during consumer contractions. XLP includes PG, KO, WMT, COST, PEP — defensive names.

name: Housing Starts Surge > +15% YoY → Long WOOD ETF 3mo Later
rule: Use FRED HOUST (housing starts, monthly). When HOUST YoY change exceeds +15% for 2 consecutive months: wait 63 trading days (3 months for framing phase lag), then long WOOD (iShares Global Timber & Forestry ETF) for 126 trading days (6 months). Lumber demand peaks during framing, 2-4 months after the foundation pour date implied by starts. Compare to SPY.
entry_conditions: FRED HOUST YoY > +15% for 2 consecutive months
Entry 63 trading days after the second consecutive month
exit_conditions: 126 trading days (6 months)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance WOOD, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED HOUST (monthly, free, back to 1959)

backtest_approach: Load FRED HOUST monthly. Compute YoY change. Find months where YoY >+15% for 2 consecutive months. Entry 63 days later. Long WOOD 126 days. WOOD ETF from Jun 2008. Pre-2008 could use LBS=F (lumber futures) if available on yfinance, otherwise backtest 2008+. HOUST has very long history.
implementation_notes: WOOD ETF includes Weyerhaeuser (WY), Rayonier (RYN), West Fraser — lumber producers + timber REITs. LBS=F (random-length lumber futures) is a purer play but may have spotty data on yfinance. Distinct from PL005 which uses permits/completions → aggregates (cement/stone); this is starts → lumber (different material, different construction phase).

name: Natural Gas Storage Deficit > 10% Below 5yr Avg in Oct → Long NG=F Oct-Jan
rule: Use FRED NGTRSTUS (weekly natural gas in underground storage). On or near Oct 1 each year, check if the current storage level is >10% below the 5-year average for that week. If yes: long NG=F from Oct 1 through Jan 31. Storage deficit entering winter = supply cushion is thin = prices must rise to balance. Compare deficit-year returns to surplus-year returns.
entry_conditions: FRED NGTRSTUS on Oct 1 is >10% below the 5-year average for that week
exit_conditions: Jan 31

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance NG=F, UNG, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED NGTRSTUS (weekly, free)

backtest_approach: Load FRED NGTRSTUS weekly. For each year, compute Oct 1 storage as % of 5yr avg. Classify years as deficit (>10% below) vs non-deficit. Compute NG=F Oct 1 - Jan 31 return for each group. T-test deficit vs non-deficit returns. Data from ~2010+ for 5yr avg calculation.
implementation_notes: NGTRSTUS data goes back to 2010+ on FRED. The 5-year rolling average is the industry-standard benchmark (used by EIA in their weekly report chart). Oct-Jan captures the core injection-season-end through peak-winter-withdrawal period. UNG ETF as fallback for NG=F.

name: Durable Goods Orders Surge > +10% Above 6mo Avg → Long XLI
rule: Use FRED DGORDER (manufacturers' new orders: durable goods, monthly). Compute ratio of current month to trailing 6-month average. When DGORDER exceeds the 6-month average by >10% for 3 consecutive months: long XLI for 126 trading days. Sustained durable goods strength signals capex cycle inflection. Compare to SPY.
entry_conditions: FRED DGORDER > 1.10 * trailing 6-month average
For 3 consecutive months
exit_conditions: 126 trading days (6 months)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance XLI, CAT, HON, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED DGORDER (monthly, free, back to 1992)

backtest_approach: Load FRED DGORDER monthly. Compute trailing 6mo MA. Find 3-month streaks where current/MA > 1.10. Long XLI for 126 days from the third month. XLI from 1998. DGORDER from 1992. Should fire at capex cycle inflections: late 2003, 2010, 2013, 2017, 2021.
implementation_notes: DGORDER includes volatile aircraft orders (Boeing). Consider also testing ADXTNO (ex-transportation durable goods) for a cleaner signal. CAT and HON tracked as individual proxies for industrials but XLI is the primary trade.

name: CPI Used Cars Declining > 5% YoY → Long TLT (Disinflation)
rule: Use FRED CUSR0000SETA02 (CPI used cars and trucks, monthly). When YoY change drops below -5%: long TLT for 63 trading days (3 months). Used cars ~3.5% CPI weight — a -5% YoY drag pulls headline CPI ~0.18pp lower, supporting disinflation expectations and bond prices. Compare to SPY.
entry_conditions: FRED CUSR0000SETA02 YoY < -5%
exit_conditions: 63 trading days (3 months)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance TLT, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED CUSR0000SETA02 (monthly, free)

backtest_approach: Load FRED CUSR0000SETA02 monthly. Compute YoY change. Find months where YoY first drops below -5%. Long TLT for 63 days. TLT from 2002. Used car CPI data from BLS goes back decades. Key periods: 2009 (crisis deflation), 2020 (brief COVID deflation), 2023-2024 (post-spike normalization).
implementation_notes: Manheim leads CPI used cars by 1-2 months, but Manheim is not on FRED. Using CPI used cars directly is 1-2 months late vs Manheim but still actionable for the TLT trade because the bond market prices CPI prints, not Manheim. The signal is about the CPI impact, not the used car market itself.

name: Construction Spending YoY > +10% for 3mo → Long CAT+DE+URI
rule: Use FRED TTLCONS (total construction spending, monthly). Compute YoY change. When YoY exceeds +10% for 3 consecutive months: long equal-weight CAT+DE+URI for 126 trading days. Sustained construction growth drives equipment demand with a 1-2 quarter lag. Compare to SPY.
entry_conditions: FRED TTLCONS YoY > +10% for 3 consecutive months
exit_conditions: 126 trading days (6 months)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance CAT, DE, URI, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED TTLCONS (monthly, free, back to 2002)

backtest_approach: Load FRED TTLCONS monthly. Compute YoY change. Find 3-month streaks of >+10% YoY. Long basket for 126 days. URI IPO 2006 — use CAT+DE for pre-2006 events. TTLCONS from 2002 so limited pre-2002 history. Expected firing: 2004-2005 (housing boom), 2012-2013 (recovery), 2021-2022 (post-COVID), 2023-2024 (IIJA/CHIPS spending).
implementation_notes: URI (United Rentals) is the purest construction equipment play — 100% rental fleet, volume directly tied to active jobsites. CAT sells equipment (order book lead time); DE construction division is smaller than ag. Equal-weight normalizes the different business models.

name: M2 YoY Reaccelerates Above +5% → Long GLD 12mo
rule: Use FRED M2SL (M2 money supply, monthly). Compute YoY change. When M2 YoY crosses above +5% after 6+ months below +3%: long GLD for 252 trading days (12 months). Monetary expansion drives gold with a 6-12 month lag as excess liquidity flows into hard assets. Compare to SPY.
entry_conditions: FRED M2SL YoY crosses above +5%
After 6+ months of M2SL YoY below +3%
exit_conditions: 252 trading days (12 months)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance GLD, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED M2SL (monthly, free, back to 1959)

backtest_approach: Load FRED M2SL monthly. Compute YoY change. Find months where YoY first crosses above +5% after 6+ months below +3%. Long GLD for 252 days. GLD from Nov 2004. For pre-2004, use GC=F (gold futures). M2SL has history to 1959 — long enough for multiple cycles. Distinct from P6 Howell M2/BTC signal which targets crypto, not gold.
implementation_notes: M2 was negative YoY in 2022-2023 (first time since 1930s). Reacceleration to +5% would be a significant regime shift. GLD is the cleanest gold exposure. GC=F (gold futures) for pre-2004. The thesis is distinct from existing P6 (M2 → BTC) — different asset, different mechanism (inflation hedge vs digital speculation).

name: NOAA Drought Outlook → Long Water Infra
rule: Hand-code years when NOAA seasonal drought outlook flagged 3+ Western states for drought development/persistence by June. Long AWK+XYL equal-weight for 6 months. Events: 2012, 2015, 2021, 2022.

name: Treasury Auction Tail >3bps → Long VIX Calls Proxy
rule: Hand-code 10Y/30Y auctions that tailed >3bps. Long VIXY for 20 trading days. Events: 2023-10-12 (30Y tail 5.3bps), 2023-11-09 (30Y tail 3.7bps), 2024-01-11 (10Y tail 3.1bps), 2025-01-08 (10Y tail 3.6bps).

name: SEMI B2B Crosses 1.0 from Below → Long SMH
rule: Hand-code months when SEMI NA B2B crossed above 1.0 from below (after 3+ months under). Long SMH for 6 months. Events: 2009-07, 2013-05, 2016-08, 2019-11, 2024-01.

name: Corn Planting >15pp Behind Avg by May 15 → Long ZC=F
rule: Hand-code years when USDA Crop Progress showed corn planting >15pp behind 5yr avg by May 15. Long ZC=F from May 15 to Jun 30. Events: 2013 (36% vs 65% avg), 2019 (49% vs 80% avg), 2022 (22% vs 49% avg).

name: CRE Transaction Volume Trough → Long Alt Managers 12mo Later
rule: Hand-code CRE transaction volume troughs (from MSCI RCA summaries). Entry 12 months after trough. Long BX+ARES+KKR equal-weight for 12 months. Events: entry 2010-06 (GFC trough Jun 2009), entry 2024-03 (rate-hike trough Mar 2023).

name: USDA Prospective Plantings Surprise → Corn/Soy Spread
rule: When USDA Mar 31 Prospective Plantings shows corn acres >2M above estimate AND soy below: long ZS=F for 30 days (soy benefits from scarcity). Events: 2017, 2019, 2021 (corn up/soy down surprises).

name: AAR Carloads YoY Positive Turn → Long XLI
rule: Use FRED RAILFRTCARLOADSD11 or proxy: when total carloads YoY turns positive after 12+ weeks negative, long XLI 6 months. Since AAR weekly not on FRED, proxy with INDPRO monthly (when INDPRO YoY turns positive after 6+ months negative). Events scan FRED INDPRO.

name: ISM Export Orders > 55 from Below 50 → Long Industrial Exporters
rule: Load FRED NAPMEI (ISM New Export Orders, monthly). When NAPMEI crosses above 55 after 4+ months below 50: long equal-weight HON+EMR+ITW+PH for 126 trading days. Markets focus on headline PMI; the export sub-index is a purer foreign demand signal.

name: Bank Credit YoY Reaccelerates → Long XLF
rule: Load FRED TOTBKCR (weekly bank credit). Resample monthly, compute YoY growth. When YoY crosses above +2% after 6+ months below +2%: long XLF for 252 trading days (12 months). Credit expansion = NIM + loan growth.

name: Vehicle Miles Traveled +3% YoY → Long Auto Parts Retailers
rule: Load FRED TRFVOLUSM227NFWA (monthly VMT). Compute YoY growth. When YoY > +3% for 3 consecutive months: long AZO+ORLY equal-weight for 126 trading days. More driving → more wear → parts demand lags 1-2 quarters.

name: SLOOS Easing for Small Firms → Long IWM
rule: Load FRED SUBLPDRCSC (SLOOS net % easing for small-firm C&I loans, quarterly). When the series crosses from net-tightening (positive values = tightening) to net-easing (negative values) after 4+ quarters of tightening: long IWM for 252 trading days (12 months). The credit-cycle trough is the signal — small caps recover fastest when banks start lending again.

name: ATA Truck Tonnage YoY Positive Turn → Long Transports
rule: Load FRED TRUCKD11 (ATA For-Hire Truck Tonnage, monthly). Compute YoY growth. When YoY turns positive after 6+ consecutive months of negative readings: long IYT (transport ETF) for 126 trading days (6 months). Distinct from AR-3 (Cass freight, different index) and PL52 (INDPRO proxy, different series).

name: Capacity Utilization Crosses 76% from Below → Long XLB
rule: Load FRED TCU (capacity utilization, monthly). When TCU crosses above 76% after 6+ months below 76%: long XLB for 126 trading days (6 months). Factories restarting = raw material demand recovering = materials stocks benefit.

name: New Home Months-Supply >8.0 → Long Homebuilders 12mo Later
rule: Load FRED MNEWSRSA (new home months-supply, monthly). When MNEWSRSA crosses above 8.0: wait 12 months, then long XHB+LEN+DHI equal-weight for 252 trading days. The contrarian delayed-buy: glut NOW → supply discipline → 12mo later inventory clears → pricing power returns.

name: Consumer Credit YoY Reaccelerates > +6% → Long XLY
rule: Load FRED TOTALSL (total consumer credit, monthly). Compute YoY growth. When YoY crosses above +6% after 6+ months below +3%: long XLY for 126 trading days (6 months). Consumers borrowing again at above-trend rates → discretionary spending recovers.

name: Retail Inventory-to-Sales Ratio Trough → Long WMT+TGT+COST
rule: Load FRED RETAILIRSA (retail inventories/sales ratio, monthly). Find local minima (lower than both prior and next month). Long WMT+TGT+COST equal-weight for 126 trading days from the month after the trough. Lean shelves → restocking orders → supply chain revenue boost.

name: Commercial Paper Outstanding Spike > +10% 4wk → Long GLD
rule: Load FRED COMPOUT (commercial paper outstanding, weekly). Compute rolling 4-week change. When 4-week change exceeds +10%: long GLD for 42 trading days (2 months). CP market stress signals backstage liquidity pressure that leads equity vol by 2-4 weeks. Gold benefits from flight-to-quality. Compare to SPY same period.
entry_conditions: FRED COMPOUT 4-week rolling change > +10%
exit_conditions: 42 trading days (2 months)

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED COMPOUT (weekly, free, back to 2001)

backtest_approach: Load FRED COMPOUT weekly. Compute rolling 4-week % change. Identify weeks where change first exceeds +10%. Long GLD for 42 trading days. GLD from Nov 2004. Expected events: 2007-08 (GFC), 2020-03 (COVID), 2023 (SVB era). For pre-2004 events use GC=F as proxy.
implementation_notes: COMPOUT includes both financial and nonfinancial CP. A surge means corporates scrambling for short-term funding. Distinct from PL055 (STLFSI4 → gold) — this is a specific funding-market stress signal, not a broad FSI.

name: Heavy Truck Sales Surge > +15% YoY for 3mo → Long KNX+WERN
rule: Load FRED HTRUCKSSAAR (heavy truck sales, monthly SAAR). Compute YoY change. When YoY exceeds +15% for 3 consecutive months: long equal-weight KNX+WERN for 126 trading days. Sustained truck purchases = fleet expansion → freight revenue growth with 2-3 quarter lag. Compare to SPY.

name: Durable Goods ex-Transport YoY Positive After Decline → Long XLI
rule: Load FRED NEWORDER (durable goods new orders ex-transportation, monthly). Compute YoY change. When YoY turns positive after 6+ months of negative readings: long XLI for 126 trading days. Strips Boeing noise for a cleaner manufacturing demand signal. Compare to SPY.

implementation_notes: NEWORDER = non-defense capital goods orders ex-aircraft. Cleaner than DGORDER because it strips Boeing's lumpy aircraft orders. Same thesis as PL059 but purer signal.

name: 10Y-2Y Un-Inversion After 12mo → Long XLI+XLF
rule: Load FRED T10Y2Y (10Y-2Y spread, daily). When T10Y2Y crosses above 0 after being below 0 for 12+ months: long equal-weight XLI+XLF for 252 trading days. After 12+ months continuously below 0
exit_conditions: 252 trading days (12 months)

name: ISM Services PMI Crosses 55 from Below 50 → Long XLY
rule: Load FRED NMFBAI (ISM Non-Manufacturing/Services PMI, monthly). When NMFBAI crosses above 55 after 3+ months below 50: long XLY for 126 trading days. Services = 70% of GDP; a strong expansion cross signals consumer demand recovery. Compare to SPY.

After 3+ months below 50

rule: Load FRED GDPNOW (Atlanta Fed GDPNow, biweekly). When the latest GDPNow reading exceeds the current Blue Chip consensus GDP estimate by >1.5 percentage points: long SPY for 42 trading days. The mechanical model is updating faster than human anchoring allows. Compare GDPNow history to consensus from FRED BCNFCGQR or similar. If consensus series not on FRED, proxy with SPY momentum regime filter: GDPNow > 3.0% as absolute threshold.
entry_conditions: FRED GDPNOW > 3.0% (absolute threshold proxy for exceeding consensus)
exit_conditions: 42 trading days (2 months)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED GDPNOW (biweekly, free)

backtest_approach: Load FRED GDPNOW. Use absolute threshold >3.0% as proxy for consensus beat (Blue Chip consensus not on FRED). Long SPY for 42 days when GDPNow first exceeds 3.0%. GDPNow started 2011. Limited history but captures 2014+2021+2023 strong-growth periods.
implementation_notes: Blue Chip consensus not freely available on FRED. Using absolute GDPNow > 3.0% as proxy (consensus tends to anchor around 2% trend growth). The true signal is the GAP vs consensus, but the proxy captures the same regime.

name: Private Resi Construction Spending 3mo Ann. > +15% → Long EXP+SUM
rule: Load FRED PRRESCONS (private residential construction spending, monthly). Compute 3-month annualized growth rate. When 3mo annualized exceeds +15%: long equal-weight EXP+SUM for 126 trading days. Active resi construction = immediate cement/concrete demand (foundations poured in month 1-2). Include SPY as benchmark.
entry_conditions: FRED PRRESCONS 3-month annualized growth > +15%
exit_conditions: 126 trading days (6 months)

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED PRRESCONS (monthly, free, back to 2002)

backtest_approach: Load FRED PRRESCONS monthly. Compute 3-month annualized growth = ((P_t/P_{t-3})^4 - 1). Find months where >+15%. Long basket 126 days. SUM IPO 2015. For pre-2015 use EXP alone. Expected firings: 2004-2005, 2012-2013, 2020-2021.
implementation_notes: Distinct from PL005 (permits/completions ratio → aggregates). This uses actual SPENDING dollars, not permits, and targets cement/concrete specifically. EXP = 50% cement + 50% wallboard. SUM = 100% aggregates/cement.

name: Northeast Building Permits > +20% YoY (National Flat) → Long JELD+AZEK+BLDR
rule: Load FRED PERMITNE (Northeast building permits, monthly) and FRED PERMIT (national). Compute YoY for both. When PERMITNE YoY > +20% AND PERMIT YoY < +5% (regional outperformance): long equal-weight JELD+AZEK+BLDR for 126 trading days. Regional demand surge in high-spec climate = premium building products demand.

FRED PERMIT (national) YoY < +5%
exit_conditions: 126 trading days (6 months)

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED PERMITNE, PERMIT (monthly, free)

backtest_approach: Load FRED PERMITNE and PERMIT monthly. Compute YoY for both. Find months where NE > +20% and national < +5%. Long basket 126 days. JELD IPO 2017, AZEK IPO 2020, BLDR IPO 2017. Limited ticker history. Pre-2017 track the condition without trading.
implementation_notes: Short ticker histories limit backtest power. BLDR has the longest track record of the three. Northeast building code requirements drive higher-spec product demand (energy efficiency mandates). Could supplement with FBHS (Fortune Brands) for longer history.

name: JOLTS Quits Rate Rises > +0.3pp from Trough → Long RHI
rule: Load FRED JTSQUR (JOLTS quits rate, monthly). Compute the trailing 6-month low. When the current reading exceeds that low by >0.3 percentage points: long RHI for 126 trading days. Rising quits = labor confidence returning = staffing demand surging. Include SPY as benchmark.

implementation_notes: HAYS not available on US exchanges/yfinance. RHI is the purest US staffing play. Every voluntary quit creates a vacancy that often gets filled through temp/staffing agencies first.

name: Avg Weekly Hours Mfg Crosses 41.0 from Below 40.5 → Long XLI

name: Continued Claims Decline 8+ Weeks from Peak → Long IWM
rule: Load FRED CCSA (continued claims, weekly). Compute trailing 26-week peak. When CCSA declines for 8+ consecutive weeks from a level that was within 5% of the 26-week peak: long IWM for 126 trading days. implementation_notes: Distinct from PL013 (initial claims acceleration → recession hedge). This is CONTINUED claims DECLINING → recovery signal. Opposite direction, different claims series. Small caps most sensitive because small businesses = 50% of US employment.

rule: Load FRED TEDRATE (TED spread, daily). When TEDRATE crosses below 0.30 after being above 0.50 for 3+ months: long KRE for 126 trading days. Interbank funding stress easing = regional banks' wholesale funding costs declining = NIM recovery. Compare to SPY.

name: Reserve Balances Surge > +20% in 3mo → Long SPY
rule: Load FRED WRESBAL (reserve balances at Federal Reserve, weekly). Compute rolling 13-week (3-month) % change. When 13-week change exceeds +20%: long SPY for 126 trading days. Massive reserves injection = liquidity that eventually flows into risk assets. Compare to unconditional buy-and-hold.

implementation_notes: WRESBAL replaced EXCSRESNW. Pre-2008, reserve balances were tiny (~$10B) — the signal is only meaningful in the post-GFC QE era. Backtest effectively starts 2008. Distinct from PL038 (RRP drain → equity liquidity) — this is RESERVE INJECTION, not RRP withdrawal.

rule: Load FRED DTWEXBGS (trade-weighted dollar, broad, daily). Compute trailing 126-day (6-month) peak. When DTWEXBGS drops >5% below that peak: long equal-weight HON+CAT+DE for 126 trading days. Weaker dollar = US goods cheaper overseas = export volume + FX translation tailwind. Compare to SPY.

rule: Load FRED BOPGSTB (goods trade balance, monthly). When BOPGSTB drops below -80 (i.e., deficit exceeds $80B): long equal-weight EXPD+CHRW+MATX for 126 trading days. Surging imports = physical goods volumes = logistics revenue. Compare to SPY.

MATX is Jones Act container shipping (US domestic intercoastal) — benefits from port congestion spillover.

name: WTI Backwardation (Front-6mo > $3/bbl) → Long XOP 90d
rule: Compute WTI backwardation proxy: use FRED DCOILWTICO (WTI spot, daily) vs yfinance CL=F (front-month). When spot-implied backwardation is steep (front-month well above trailing 6-month average by >$3): long XOP for 63 trading days. Steep backwardation = physical tightness = E&P earnings beats vs strip-based models. Compare to SPY.

implementation_notes: True backwardation requires comparing front-month vs deferred futures — not directly on FRED. Using spot vs 6-month MA as proxy: when spot is far above average, the curve is likely in backwardation. XOP is the best E&P ETF (market-cap weighted oil/gas E&P).

name: Henry Hub Below $2.50/MMBtu → Long EQT+AR+RRC 12mo
rule: Load FRED MHHNGSP (Henry Hub natural gas spot price, monthly). When MHHNGSP drops below 2.50: long equal-weight EQT+AR+RRC for 252 trading days. Sub-cash-cost pricing triggers producer shut-ins → supply curtailment → price recovery over 6-12 months. Self-correcting mechanism. Compare to SPY.

implementation_notes: Sub-$2.50 is the approximate marginal cash cost for Appalachian gas producers. EQT has publicly announced voluntary curtailments at these levels (2020, 2024). The self-correcting mechanism makes this a contrarian value signal — buy when others are forced to shut in.

name: FRED Corporate Profits YoY Turns Positive After 2Q Negative → Long SPY 12mo
rule: Load FRED CP (quarterly corporate profits after tax with IVA and CCAdj). Compute YoY % change each quarter. Entry: when CP YoY turns positive after 2+ consecutive quarters of negative YoY growth. Long SPY for 252 trading days (12 months). Exit after 252 trading days or if CP YoY turns negative again (stop-loss). Benchmark: SPY buy-and-hold.
entry_conditions: FRED CP YoY growth turns positive (>0%) after 2+ consecutive quarters of negative YoY
Signal evaluated quarterly when BEA releases NIPA corporate profits data
exit_conditions: Hold for 252 trading days (12 months)
Early exit if CP YoY turns negative again within holding period

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED CP (quarterly corporate profits after tax)

backtest_approach: Load FRED CP quarterly back to 1947 (or whenever SPY data starts ~1993). Compute YoY. Identify all transition events from negative->positive YoY. On the first trading day after each event, go long SPY for 252 days. Compute per-trade returns and aggregate Sharpe/CAGR/max_dd vs buy-and-hold SPY. Known events: ~2002Q1 (post dot-com), ~2010Q1 (post GFC), ~2016Q2 (post energy recession), ~2020Q4 (post COVID).
implementation_notes: FRED CP is quarterly with ~2 month lag. BEA advance estimate comes ~1 month after quarter end (late Apr for Q1, late Jul for Q2, etc). Use release date, not quarter date. CP series has IVA+CCAdj adjustments — use the adjusted series for cleaner signal.

name: FRED Private Nonres Construction YoY > +10% for 3mo → Long PWR+PRIM+ACM
rule: Load FRED PNRESCONS (monthly private nonresidential construction spending). Compute YoY % change. Entry: when YoY exceeds +10% for 3 consecutive months. Long equal-weight basket of PWR, PRIM, ACM plus SPY benchmark for 126 trading days. Exit after 126 days.
entry_conditions: FRED PNRESCONS YoY growth > +10% for 3 consecutive months
Signal evaluated monthly on construction spending release (1st business day of month, 2-month lag)
exit_conditions: Hold for 126 trading days (6 months)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance PWR, PRIM, ACM, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED PNRESCONS (monthly private nonresidential construction spending)

backtest_approach: Load FRED PNRESCONS monthly back to 2002. Compute YoY. Identify all 3-month streak entries where YoY > +10%. On the first trading day after the 3rd consecutive month confirmation, go long equal-weight PWR+PRIM+ACM for 126 days. Compute basket return vs SPY. Note: PRIM may have limited history (IPO ~2018); use available tickers only for their available period. PWR has data back to ~2003.
known_events: 2005-2006 (housing boom commercial)
2014-2015 (energy capex)
2022-2025 (reshoring/data center)
implementation_notes: PRIM IPO was 2018 — only use it from 2018 onward. ACM has data back to ~2014 (post-URS merger). PWR back to ~2002. For early period, basket may be PWR-only. Construction spending data has a 2-month lag (e.g., January data released in March).

name: FRED Real Disposable Income YoY Turns Negative → Long XLP 12mo
rule: Load FRED DSPIC96 (monthly real disposable personal income). Compute YoY % change. Entry: first month YoY turns negative (<0%) after 12+ months of positive YoY. Long XLP for 252 trading days. Measure XLP relative performance vs SPY over the holding period. Thesis: during real income squeezes, staples outperform discretionary/broad market.
entry_conditions: FRED DSPIC96 YoY turns negative (<0%) for the first time after 12+ months positive
Signal evaluated monthly on BEA personal income release (~last week of month, 1-month lag)
exit_conditions: Hold for 252 trading days (12 months)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance XLP, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED DSPIC96 (monthly real disposable personal income)

backtest_approach: Load FRED DSPIC96 monthly back to 1959. Compute YoY. Identify all transition events from positive->negative YoY after 12+ months positive. For each event, long XLP for 252 trading days and compute excess return vs SPY. XLP data starts ~1998; historical events before that can only test with sector proxies or be excluded. Key metric: XLP minus SPY total return over holding period.
known_events: 2001 (post dot-com)
2022 (inflation squeeze)
implementation_notes: Real disposable income can turn negative due to inflation surges (2022) OR income declines (2008). Both trigger trade-down behavior. COVID stimulus checks created a massive YoY distortion in 2020-2021 — may want to flag that event as anomalous. XLP inception ~1998.

name: FRED Advance Retail Sales 3 Consecutive Positive MoM → Long XRT 60d
rule: Load FRED RSAFS (monthly advance retail sales, seasonally adjusted). Compute MoM % change. Entry: when MoM is positive for 3 consecutive months. Long XRT (SPDR S&P Retail ETF) for 60 trading days. Exit after 60 days. Benchmark: SPY over same period.
entry_conditions: FRED RSAFS MoM change positive (>0%) for 3 consecutive months
Signal evaluated monthly on Census advance retail sales release (mid-month, ~2 week lag)
exit_conditions: Hold for 60 trading days (~3 months)

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED RSAFS (monthly advance retail sales, seasonally adjusted)

backtest_approach: Load FRED RSAFS monthly back to 1992. Compute MoM pct change. Identify all 3-month positive streak completions. On the next trading day after the 3rd month's data release, long XRT for 60 trading days. Compute return vs SPY. XRT inception ~2006; use only events from 2006 onward. Count events, win rate, avg return, Sharpe.
known_events: Multiple per cycle — consumer momentum streaks happen regularly
implementation_notes: XRT inception June 2006. For pre-2006 events, could substitute XLY as proxy but XRT is better (broader retail coverage, equal-weighted). RSAFS is seasonally adjusted — no need for seasonal detrending. The 3-month streak filter avoids whipsaws from single-month noise.

name: FRED Mortgage Apps Surge >20% from 13-Week Low → Long LEN+DHI+NVR (1mo lag)
rule: Use a mortgage application proxy: FRED MORTGAGE30US (30yr mortgage rate) declining >50bps from 13-week high as a proxy for application surge (lower rates = more applications). If FRED has a direct MBA purchase index (MORTAPPW or similar), use that instead. Entry: 21 trading days (1 month) after the rate decline threshold is crossed. Long equal-weight LEN+DHI+NVR for 126 trading days. Exit after 126 days. Benchmark: SPY.
entry_conditions: FRED MORTGAGE30US declines >50bps from trailing 13-week high (proxy for mortgage application surge)
OR if FRED MORTAPPW available: purchase index rises >20% from trailing 13-week low
Entry delayed by 21 trading days (1-month lag for applications-to-closings pipeline)
exit_conditions: Hold for 126 trading days (6 months)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance LEN, DHI, NVR, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED MORTGAGE30US (weekly 30yr mortgage rate) or FRED MORTAPPW (MBA purchase applications if available)

backtest_approach: Load FRED MORTGAGE30US weekly back to 1971. Compute 13-week trailing high. Entry signal when current rate is >50bps below that high, with 21 trading day delay. Long equal-weight LEN+DHI+NVR for 126 days. Compute basket return vs SPY. LEN/DHI have data back to ~2000; NVR to ~1993. If MORTAPPW not on FRED, the mortgage rate decline proxy captures the same dynamic (rate drops drive application surges with 0.85+ correlation).
known_events: 2003 (refi boom)
2012 (post-GFC recovery)
2019 (mid-cycle cut)
2020 (COVID rate cuts)
2024 (rate peak rollover)
implementation_notes: The 1-month entry delay is critical — it allows the applications-to-closings pipeline to build before entering. MORTAPPW may not be on FRED (MBA data is semi-proprietary). The mortgage rate proxy is a reasonable substitute with strong historical correlation to purchase applications. NVR has limited float and can be illiquid — consider substituting PHM or TOL if NVR data is spotty.

exit_conditions: August 15 each year (post-WASDE)

name: FRED NGTRSTUS Aug 1 Storage < 5yr Avg by >10% → Long NG=F Aug-Nov
rule: Load FRED NGTRSTUS (weekly natural gas storage). On August 1 each year, compute current storage level vs 5-year average for that week. If current storage is >10% below the 5-year average: long NG=F from Aug 1 through Nov 30. This targets the late-injection concern before winter. Benchmark vs SPY. Distinct from PL058 (Oct deficit, general winter) -- this is specifically summer injection shortfall, earlier entry.

exit_conditions: November 30 each year

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED NGTRSTUS (weekly natural gas storage)

2018 (production lag)

name: FRED PERMIT1 YoY Improving for 3 Consecutive Months → Long SHW+VMC+MLM+BLDR 63d
rule: Load FRED PERMIT1 (single-family building permits, monthly SAAR). Compute YoY % change. Entry: when the YoY rate improves (becomes less negative or more positive) for 3 consecutive months. Long equal-weight SHW+VMC+MLM+BLDR for 63 trading days. The YoY improvement signals the housing trough even if absolute YoY is still negative. Benchmark vs SPY and XHB.
entry_conditions: FRED PERMIT1 YoY rate of change improves (delta of YoY is positive) for 3 consecutive months
Signal evaluated monthly on Census permits release (mid-month, 1-month lag)
exit_conditions: Hold for 63 trading days (1 quarter)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance SHW, VMC, MLM, BLDR, XHB, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED PERMIT1 (single-family building permits, monthly)

backtest_approach: Load FRED PERMIT1 monthly back to 1959. Compute YoY, then compute month-over-month change in YoY (second derivative). Entry when 3 consecutive months of positive second derivative. Long basket for 63 days. SHW from ~1980, VMC from ~1990, MLM from ~1994, BLDR from ~2016 (IPO). For early period use available tickers only. Compare basket vs XHB and SPY.
known_events: 2009 (post GFC trough)
2011 (housing recovery)
2019 (rate cut relief)
2023 (post-rate-shock recovery)
implementation_notes: BLDR IPO ~2016 -- use only from then onward. The second-derivative signal (rate of change of rate of change) is more sensitive than absolute levels and fires earlier in the cycle. SHW is a mega-cap paint company -- lower beta than VMC/MLM but more liquid. XHB is the sector benchmark for relative performance comparison.

name: FRED DTWEXBGS 6-Month Return < -5% → Long EEM 63d
rule: Load FRED DTWEXBGS (broad trade-weighted dollar index, daily). Compute rolling 6-month (126 trading day) return. Entry: when 6-month return crosses below -5%. Long EEM for 63 trading days. Benchmark vs SPY. Distinct from PL046 (DXY spike → EM reversal) -- that was a mean-reversion trade after sharp dollar STRENGTH; this is momentum following dollar WEAKNESS.
entry_conditions: FRED DTWEXBGS 6-month rolling return crosses below -5% (dollar weakening >5% over 6mo)
Signal evaluated daily
exit_conditions: Hold for 63 trading days (1 quarter)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance EEM, VWO, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED DTWEXBGS (broad trade-weighted dollar index, daily)

backtest_approach: Load FRED DTWEXBGS daily back to 2006. Compute 126-day rolling return. Identify all dates where it crosses below -5%. Long EEM for 63 days from each signal (avoid overlapping trades -- skip signals within 63 days of prior entry). EEM data from 2003. Compute excess return vs SPY per trade and aggregate. Also test with VWO as alternative.
known_events: 2006-2007 (pre-GFC dollar weakness)
2017 (synchronized global growth)
2020 (post-COVID dollar decline)
2023 (dollar peak rollover)
implementation_notes: DTWEXBGS is daily but has some gaps (holidays/weekends). Use business day alignment with yfinance data. The signal may cluster (multiple daily crossings) -- use first crossing only and skip 63 days. Distinct from PL046 which was short-term DXY spike reversal; this is medium-term dollar weakness momentum.

name: FRED TLRESCONS 3 Consecutive Positive MoM → Long WSO+WMS 63d
rule: Load FRED TLRESCONS (total residential construction spending, monthly). Compute MoM % change. Entry: when MoM is positive for 3 consecutive months after a period of decline (at least 2 prior negative MoM months). Long equal-weight WSO+WMS for 63 trading days. Benchmark vs SPY and XHB. Plumbing/HVAC distributors benefit first from construction restart as they supply materials before framing/finishing trades.
entry_conditions: FRED TLRESCONS MoM positive for 3 consecutive months
Must follow at least 2 months of negative MoM (confirms inflection, not continuation)
Signal evaluated monthly on Census C30 release (1st business day, 2-month lag)
exit_conditions: Hold for 63 trading days (1 quarter)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance WSO, WMS, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED TLRESCONS (total residential construction spending, monthly)

backtest_approach: Load FRED TLRESCONS monthly back to 2002. Compute MoM changes. Identify sequences of 2+ negative MoM followed by 3+ positive MoM (inflection). Long WSO+WMS for 63 days from the 3rd positive month. WSO (Watsco, HVAC distributor) data from ~1990. WMS (Advanced Drainage Systems) data from ~2014 (IPO). For pre-2014, WSO-only basket. Compute vs SPY.
known_events: 2009 (post GFC trough)
2012 (housing recovery)
2020 (post COVID)
2023 (post rate shock)
implementation_notes: WMS (Advanced Drainage Systems) IPO was 2014. SWK (Stanley Black & Decker) from original thesis could substitute for broader tool exposure but is less pure-play plumbing/HVAC. WSO is the purest HVAC distribution play in US equities. Construction spending data has a 2-month lag. Verify FRED series name is TLRESCONS (may also be filed under PRRESCONS for private only).

rule: Use US Treasury Quarterly Refunding Announcement (QRA) dates: first Wednesday of Feb, May, Aug, and Nov each year. On the next trading day after each QRA date, check the FRED RRPONTSYD (overnight reverse repo facility usage) value as of the QRA date. If RRPONTSYD >= 200 (billion USD; series is in billions) AND the RRPONTSYD level has fallen by >= 50B over the prior 60 calendar days (i.e. the facility is being drained, indicating MMF rotation into bills), enter LONG SPY at the next session's close. Exit 30 trading days later at the close, or earlier if SPY gains >= +3% or stops out at -2.5%. One position at a time; if next QRA fires while still in a position, exit at next QRA's open and re-evaluate.
entry_conditions: Trade day = next NYSE session after a Quarterly Refunding Announcement (first Wed of Feb/May/Aug/Nov).
FRED RRPONTSYD on QRA date >= 200 (billion).
RRPONTSYD has fallen by >= 50 (billion) over prior 60 calendar days (rolling drain).
No existing open position from a prior QRA signal.
Enter at SPY close on the trade day.
exit_conditions: Time stop: 30 trading days after entry, exit at close.
Profit target: SPY cumulative return from entry >= +3% -> exit at that close.
Stop loss: SPY cumulative return from entry <= -2.5% -> exit at that close.
Hard override: if next QRA date arrives while still in position, exit at that day's close before any new signal evaluation.

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance: SPY (Adj Close), QQQ (Adj Close, reference only), BIL (Adj Close, reference only)
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED: RRPONTSYD (Overnight Reverse Repurchase Agreements: Treasury Securities Sold by the Federal Reserve)

backtest_approach: Backtest from 2014-01-01 (when RRP facility usage became meaningful) through present. Pre-compute the list of QRA dates: first Wednesday of Feb/May/Aug/Nov for each year. For each QRA date, take FRED RRPONTSYD level on that date (forward-fill if QRA on a non-publishing day), and the 60-calendar-day prior level for the drain check. Apply entry filter. If signal: long SPY at next NYSE close. Track daily P&L until time/profit/stop exit, or until next QRA arrives. Build daily return series (0 when flat). Benchmark vs buy-and-hold SPY over the same window. Report CAGR, Sharpe, max DD, win rate, avg holding period, n trades.
known_events: QRA dates 2024: 2024-01-31 (Wed before Feb), 2024-05-01, 2024-07-31, 2024-10-30 (note: actual QRA is first Wed of refunding month; some years it shifts a few days for holidays — use first Wed of Feb/May/Aug/Nov as deterministic proxy).
implementation_notes: Use 'first Wednesday of Feb/May/Aug/Nov' as the deterministic QRA date proxy — the actual QRA is published on those Wednesdays at 8:30 AM ET, so the next NYSE session close is the earliest realistic entry. RRPONTSYD is in millions USD on FRED — divide by 1000 to get billions for the 200B threshold (or compare in raw millions: 200000). Verify units when loading; harness.load_fred returns the raw series. RRPONTSYD only has meaningful usage from ~2014 onward (was near zero before), and went above 200B only from ~2021. Realistically ~4 QRAs/year so ~5 years of usable signal = ~20 candidate entries, of which perhaps 6-10 pass the >=200B & drain filter. Small sample size — report n trades carefully and flag if < 10. Long-only, single position, no leverage. If RRPONTSYD goes below the 50B drain delta only because it's already exhausted (level < 100B), the level filter (>=200B) blocks entry — good.

name: Electric Power Generation YoY 3M MA Inflection -> Long XLU (Utilities)
rule: Using FRED IPG2211A2N (Industrial Production: Electric and Gas Utilities, NSA, monthly; proxy for EEI weekly electric output) compute the 3-month moving average YoY growth rate. Signal fires on the first FRED release date where the 3M-MA YoY transitions from <= 0% in the prior month's value to >= +1.5% in the current month's value (an upward inflection through zero). On signal fire, at the next regular session open enter long XLU (equal-weight overlay with NEE, DUK, SO, AEP, EXC each receiving 1/6 of the gross long sleeve, XLU the remaining 1/6 -> use 50% XLU + 10% NEE + 10% DUK + 10% SO + 10% AEP + 10% EXC to over-weight the ETF and diversify single-name risk). Daily PnL = 0.5*XLU_ret + 0.1*(NEE_ret + DUK_ret + SO_ret + AEP_ret + EXC_ret). Exit at either (a) close of bar where cumulative-return-since-entry >= +5%, OR (b) 30 trading days after entry, whichever comes first. No intermediate stop. If a new signal fires while a position is open, ignore (only one open trade at a time).
entry_conditions: FRED IPG2211A2N 3-month MA YoY <= 0% in prior month's reading
FRED IPG2211A2N 3-month MA YoY >= +1.5% in newly released month's reading (inflection through zero)
No open position currently held
Enter long basket at next regular session open after release date
exit_conditions: 30 trading days after entry (close of bar 30)
OR cumulative return since entry >= +5% (close of that bar)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance: XLU, NEE, DUK, SO, AEP, EXC, SPY (daily Adj Close, auto_adjust=True)
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED series IPG2211A2N (Industrial Production: Electric and Gas Utilities, NSA, monthly index). Released ~mid-month for prior month. Use the FRED release date as the signal day; trade at next session open. Backtester should fetch via pandas_datareader or FRED CSV (https://fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv?id=IPG2211A2N). If unavailable, fallback to FRED ELECTPOWGEN or IPG22113N.

backtest_approach: Sweep FRED IPG2211A2N from 2005 to present. For each month, compute 3M MA of the index level and its YoY % change. Detect inflection: prior month YoY <= 0% AND current month YoY >= +1.5%. Treat the FRED release date (~mid-month following the data month) as t=0; enter at next session open of t+1. Construct daily PnL for the weighted basket from t+1 to exit. Aggregate non-overlapping trades (skip new signals during an open position). Report mean trade return, Sharpe (annualized, daily PnL series), CAGR, max drawdown, hit rate, t-stat. Benchmark vs SPY buy-and-hold. Approximate FRED release dates as the 15th of the month following the data month if exact release calendar not available.
implementation_notes: EEI Weekly Electric Output (the idea's original source) is paywalled / behind EEI member login; FRED IPG2211A2N is the closest free analog (Federal Reserve Industrial Production: Electric & Gas Utilities). The trade-off: monthly frequency reduces signal frequency vs weekly, but the YoY inflection logic is preserved. NEE/DUK/SO/AEP/EXC are the five largest regulated utility holdings in XLU; equal-weighted 10% each gives a satellite tilt while preserving XLU as the core 50% position. Use auto_adjust=True so dividends are included (utility dividends are a meaningful component of total return). Inflection must be a fresh transition through zero: do NOT re-fire if YoY stays positive month-to-month.

name: BTC-USD Stagnation Regime -> Short Public Miner Basket vs Long BTC (IBIT)
rule: Daily proxy for hashprice collapse using BTC-USD price stagnation (since network hashrate trends monotonically upward and block subsidy is fixed at 3.125 BTC post-Apr-2024 halving). Compute three conditions: (a) BTC-USD 30-day trailing average close < BTC-USD 180-day trailing average close * 0.95 (BTC in a -5%+ medium-term drawdown), (b) BTC-USD close has not made a new 60-day high for at least 30 consecutive trading days (range-bound regime), (c) BTC-USD 30-day realized volatility (annualized, log returns) < 60% (non-panic stagnation, not capitulation). On the first day all three conditions are simultaneously true AND no position is open, signal fires. At the next regular session open, short an equal-weight basket of {MARA, RIOT, CLSK, CIFR} sized to 50% gross short, and go long IBIT sized to 50% gross long (dollar-neutral pair: isolates miner-specific margin compression from BTC beta). Daily PnL = 0.5*IBIT_ret - 0.5*0.25*(MARA_ret + RIOT_ret + CLSK_ret + CIFR_ret). Exit at (a) 30 trading days after entry close, OR (b) BTC-USD makes a new 60-day high (regime break), OR (c) cumulative PnL <= -8% (stop loss), whichever first.
entry_conditions: BTC-USD 30d trailing mean close < 0.95 * BTC-USD 180d trailing mean close
BTC-USD has not made a new 60-day high for >= 30 consecutive trading days
BTC-USD 30d annualized realized vol (from log returns) < 60%
No open position currently held
Trade is restricted to post-2024-04-19 dates (post-halving regime only)
IBIT trading-history start date >= entry date (IBIT inception 2024-01-11)
Enter at next session open after signal fire
exit_conditions: 30 trading days after entry (close of bar 30)
OR BTC-USD makes a new 60-day high (regime break, exit at close)
OR cumulative PnL <= -8% (stop loss at close)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance: MARA, RIOT, CLSK, CIFR, IBIT, BTC-USD, SPY (daily Adj Close, auto_adjust=True). Note BTC-USD trades 7 days/week on yfinance; align to equity trading calendar by forward-filling BTC-USD on equity holidays and dropping BTC-USD weekend prints when computing entry signals (use only BTC closes on equity-session days).
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: none (live network hashrate / hashprice data is not on FRED or yfinance; BTC-USD price stagnation is the deterministic proxy for the hashprice compression regime under the assumption that hashrate trends monotonically upward post-halving as documented by Hashrate Index and blockchain.com)

backtest_approach: Restrict backtest window to 2024-04-19 (post-halving) through present. Build daily BTC-USD series aligned to equity trading calendar (forward-fill BTC on equity holidays). Compute the three signal conditions per day. Identify entry dates (no overlapping trades). For each entry, construct daily PnL of the dollar-neutral pair (long IBIT 50%, short 12.5% each of MARA/RIOT/CLSK/CIFR) from t+1 open to exit. Apply 30-day max hold, 60-day high regime-break exit, and -8% stop. Aggregate to daily strategy return series (cash on non-trade days). Report Sharpe (annualized), CAGR, max DD, t-stat, hit rate, average trade return. Benchmark vs SPY buy-and-hold over same window.
implementation_notes: Post-2024-halving regime only (block subsidy = 3.125 BTC). IBIT inception 2024-01-11 so it's available for the entire backtest window. CIFR (Cipher Mining) listed via SPAC in Aug 2021. MARA/RIOT/CLSK have history back to 2017+. The dollar-neutral pair (long IBIT, short miner basket) isolates the miner-equity-specific component vs BTC beta -- this is the key insight: miners should fall MORE than BTC during sustained stagnation because operating leverage compresses margins. Use auto_adjust=True. BTC-USD weekend data: drop Sat/Sun rows when computing signals (use Fri close to start the weekend, resume Mon close). Forward-fill miner equity prices on BTC-only days is not relevant since trades occur on equity sessions. Backtest window is short (~25 months) so report confidence intervals; small-sample warning.

backtest_approach: Event-study with pooled basket simulation. (1) Curate a historical list of 8-K Item 8.01 'clinical hold removed/lifted' filings 2015-2025 using EDGAR full-text search; expect ~30-80 events. (2) Map each filing to issuer's yfinance ticker; drop OTC pink/below-$50M-mcap names. (3) For each event, simulate T+1 open entry / T+15 close exit, mark to daily closes, compute per-event return.
