name: FCC Spectrum Auction Bid-Burden >25% TTM Capex -> Short Top Bidders, Long Sit-Outs
rule: After each FCC spectrum auction closes (auctiondata.fcc.gov posts winning-bidder Public Notice within ~5 business days), compute per-bidder gross winning bid total. For each of {T, VZ, TMUS, SATS} (the four major US wireless carriers, with SATS standing in for the merged DISH/EchoStar entity), compute bid_burden = gross_winning_bid / TTM_capex_per_latest_10K. If two carriers have bid_burden > 25%, open short positions of -1.0% NAV each on those two carriers (-2.0% gross short), and long positions of +1.0% NAV each on the remaining two carriers ('sit-out' incumbents) (+2.0% gross long), pair-neutral. Entry: T+10 trading days after FCC Public Notice. Hold 6 months.
entry_conditions: FCC posts Public Notice CSV of winning bidders for a major spectrum auction (e.g., Auction 110, 108, future 5G/6G auctions)
At least 2 of {T, VZ, TMUS, SATS} have winning-bid total / TTM capex > 25%
Open positions at T+10 trading sessions after the Public Notice date
Short basket: 2 high-burden carriers each -1.0% NAV (sum -2.0% gross short)
Long basket: 2 low-burden carriers each +1.0% NAV (sum +2.0% gross long)
exit_conditions: Hold 6 calendar months (~126 trading days)
Exit early if FCC announces auction-result re-audit / re-allocation
Hard time stop: 9 months

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FCC Auctions System auctiondata.fcc.gov Public Notice CSV (free); SEC EDGAR XBRL us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment TTM (free); FCC license buildout requirements 47 CFR Part 27

backtest_approach: Event-study with pair-neutral long/short basket. (1) Curate a historical list of FCC major spectrum auctions 2010-2025 (Auctions 73, 97, 102, 103, 105, 107, 108, 110, etc.). (2) For each auction, scrape winning-bidder Public Notice for T, VZ, TMUS, SATS (and predecessors S, DISH, Clearwire) gross bid totals. (3) Compute TTM capex from each carrier's most recent 10-K at auction close. (4) Identify auctions where >=2 carriers cross the 25% burden threshold. (5) Simulate basket entry T+10 after Public Notice, hold 6 months; compute per-event basket PnL. (6) Aggregate event Sharpe, hit rate, and compare to SPY benchmark.

name: SEC 8-K Item 1.05 Cyber-Incident Cluster -> Victim Drift Short + Incident-Response Vendor Long
rule: Backtester pre-builds a static table of all 8-K Item 1.05 filings since 2023-12-18 (the rule's effective date) by querying SEC EDGAR full-text search (efts.sec.gov/LATEST/search-index?q=%22Item+1.05%22&forms=8-K). Each row: filing_date, filer_CIK, ticker, GICS_sub_industry (mapped via yfinance .info industry), threat_actor_signature_keyword (extracted from filing body, optional). Daily evaluation: at NYSE close of trading day T, compute count of new Item 1.05 filings in trailing 30 calendar days, grouped by GICS sub-industry. SIGNAL FIRES when a sub-industry has >=3 Item 1.05 filings in trailing 30 days AND today's date T is the date of the third (or later) filing. On signal: at close of T, take SHORT equal-weight basket of the 3+ filer-ticker victims in that sub-industry (0.5% per name, cap 5 names = 2.5% gross short max); concurrent LONG equal-weight basket of IR-vendor names {CRWD, S, ZS, RPD, OKTA} 0.5% each = 2.5% gross long; partial SHORT CIBR (cybersecurity ETF) 1% as IR-basket beta hedge. HOLD 60 trading days (~12 weeks). EXIT EARLY if a victim is acquired (delist) or if CIBR rallies >25% (vendor leg overheats).
entry_conditions: SEC 8-K Item 1.05 filing detected on EDGAR; mapped to ticker via SEC company_tickers.json.
Trailing 30-day rolling count of Item 1.05 filings in the same GICS sub-industry >= 3.
Trigger date T = filing date of the third (or later) victim in the cluster.
Open short victim basket and long IR-vendor basket at close of T.
Hedge: short CIBR 1%.
exit_conditions: 60 trading days after entry (time stop, ~12 calendar weeks).
Individual victim delisting (acquisition, bankruptcy) — close that name's leg only.
CIBR cumulative return > +25% from entry — close vendor + CIBR-hedge legs (lock in).

backtest_approach: Event-cluster overlay. (1) Pre-build the historical 1.05-filings CSV by running an EDGAR full-text search script once (NOT part of the backtest loop). (2) For each trading day T from 2023-12-18 to today, compute trailing-30d cluster count per sub-industry; flag T as a 'signal day' if any sub-industry hits 3+ and T is the date of that cluster's threshold-crossing filing. (3) On signal day, instantiate short victim basket (the 3+ filers in the cluster, equal-weighted 0.5% per name, max 5) and long IR-vendor basket at close of T. (4) Multiple concurrent clusters in different sub-industries can coexist (additive). (5) Daily PnL = sum over open legs of weight_i * log_return_i; FX not needed (all USD). (6) Sample window 2023-12-18 through 2026-05-29 = ~30 months; expect ~5-15 cluster signals. (7) Report cumulative return, Sharpe vs 0%, max drawdown, vs SPY buy-and-hold, plus per-event victim-leg and IR-leg alpha decomposition.

name: SEC 8-K Item 2.04 Covenant-Breach Filing -> Issuer Equity Short + HY OAS Widening Pair
rule: Backtester pre-builds a static table of all 8-K Item 2.04 filings since 2010-01-01 from SEC EDGAR full-text search (efts.sec.gov/LATEST/search-index?q=%22Item+2.04%22&forms=8-K). Each row: filing_date, filer_CIK, ticker, GICS_sub_industry. Daily evaluation: at NYSE close of trading day T, identify all Item 2.04 filings dated within trailing 1 trading day. SINGLE-FILING SIGNAL fires for each new Item 2.04 filer (ticker resolvable on yfinance, ADV > $1M, market cap > $200M to ensure shortability). On firing: SHORT the filer common at close of T at 0.5% gross per name; concurrent SHORT HYG 1% and LONG LQD 1% as broad HY-vs-IG spread-widening pair (sub-industry HY proxy not available without TRACE — use broad HY/IG). CLUSTER SIGNAL: when >=2 Item 2.04 filings appear in the same GICS sub-industry within trailing 60 days, increase HYG short to 2% and LQD long to 2% for next 60 trading days. Trigger date T = filing date.

Cluster condition: >=2 Item 2.04 filings in same GICS sub-industry within 60 days -> bump HYG short to 2% and LQD long to 2% for next 60 trading days.
exit_conditions: 60 trading days after entry per issuer short leg (time stop, ~12 weeks).
Issuer files Chapter 11 or delists — close that leg at last available price (assume -50% mark if delisted to OTC, otherwise actual close).
Macro spread pair time stop: 90 trading days after most recent firing in the cluster.

name: 3x Leveraged ETF Rebalance Day Overnight Reversal -> Short QQQ on Large Up-Days (Daily Approx)
rule: Daily approximation of the leveraged-ETF MOC rebalance fade. On any trading day t where QQQ close-to-close return >= +2.0%, take a short position in QQQ at close of day t and cover at close of day t+1. Symmetric long: on any day where QQQ close-to-close return <= -2.0%, take a long QQQ position at close of day t and exit at close of day t+1. Captures the next-day fade of mechanical 3x-ETF MOC rebalance flow.
entry_conditions: QQQ close-to-close return on day t >= +2.0% OR <= -2.0%
Position: -1 (short) on +2% days, +1 (long) on -2% days, 0 otherwise
Enter at close of day t
exit_conditions: Exit at close of day t+1 (1 trading day hold)
No intermediate stops

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: none

backtest_approach: Daily close-to-close approximation of an intraday-rebalance fade thesis. Compute QQQ daily returns. Build positions Series: -1 when prev-day QQQ return >= +0.02, +1 when prev-day QQQ return <= -0.02, else 0. Daily PnL = position[t] * QQQ_return[t+1]. Lag positions forward by 1 day to avoid look-ahead (the +2% reading is known at close of day t, position held overnight, PnL realized day t+1). Use harness.compute_metrics with SPY benchmark.
implementation_notes: The original idea is intraday (detect >+1.5% by 3pm, short MOC, cover next open). Pipeline harness load_prices returns adjusted-close only — Open/High/Low not available without a custom yfinance fetch. We approximate using daily close-to-close with a stricter +/-2.0% threshold (vs 1.5% intraday). This loses the intraday-overshoot edge but still captures the next-day mean-reversion component of forced rebalance flow. Hold 1 day (close-to-close). Sample size: high — ~50-100 trigger days per decade. TQQQ included only for context/audit (not traded).

name: S&P 500 Inclusion Announce-to-Effective Drift (Residual)
rule: Event study over historical S&P 500 inclusion additions. For each addition: t_ann = announcement date (close), t_eff = effective rebalance date (close). At t_ann+1 OPEN, go LONG the addition ticker; hold to t_eff CLOSE; exit. Equal-weight position size across overlapping events. PnL = avg daily return of currently-held addition basket. Capture residual t+1-to-effective drift after the announcement-day pop has happened.
entry_conditions: S&P DJI press release announces S&P 500 addition (publicly known with date stamp)
Open LONG the addition ticker at t_ann+1 (next trading day) open
exit_conditions: Close LONG at effective date close (typically Friday close, 5-7 trading days after announcement)

Aggregate to a daily PnL series by equal-weighting overlapping active legs. Report avg event return, hit rate, t-stat. Benchmark vs same-window SPY return.

Stack overlapping events equal-weight. PnL = AIZ daily return - average(PHM,LEN) daily return per active leg.

name: Laredo/Otay Truck Wait > 95th pct -> Short F/GM/STLA Auto OEMs, Long UNP/EWW

Hold 21 calendar days or exit early when 5-day rolling wait returns below the 75th percentile.

Exit early when 5-day rolling wait drops below trailing 12-month 75th percentile

name: TIC Foreign Net Equity Outflow + SPY Near ATH -> Defensive Rotation (Short SPY / Long GLD+TLT)
rule: On Treasury TIC monthly release dates, compute the rolling 2-month sum of net foreign purchases of US corporate stocks (TIC Form S, Table B5b). When the 2-month sum is negative AND SPY close on the release date is within 3% of trailing 252-day high, enter: short SPY (-0.5), long GLD (+0.25), long TLT (+0.25). Hold 60 trading days (~12 weeks) or exit early if SPY closes >+3% above signal-date close. Counter-signal to long_SPY.

Entry first trading day after TIC release date
Positions: -0.5 SPY, +0.25 GLD, +0.25 TLT (net dollar exposure = 0)
exit_conditions: Exit 60 trading days after entry (~12 weeks)
Early exit if SPY closes >+3% above signal-date close (stop)

name: CDC NCHS Provisional Monthly Natality 3-Month YoY Decline > 4% Triggers Pediatric-Staples + Daycare Short, Elder-Care Long
rule: Quarterly evaluation driven by static table of CDC NCHS Vital Statistics Rapid Release monthly natality YoY values (transcribed from the public PDFs at cdc.gov/nchs/products/vsrr.htm). At each NCHS monthly release date D, compute trailing 3-month rolling YoY % change in US births. SIGNAL FIRES when trailing 3-month YoY < -4% AND prior firing was >6 months ago (avoid over-triggering during sustained declines). HOLD 6 months (126 trading days). EXIT EARLY if next 3-month NCHS YoY > -2% (decline stabilizes).

Trailing 3-month rolling YoY < -4%.

Short basket: KMB 1%, PG 1%, ABT 1%, BFAM 1%, SNY 0.5%, PFE 0.5%, MRK 0.5% (5.5% gross short).

Subsequent NCHS print shows 3-month YoY > -2% (stabilization).

SIGNAL FIRES on the release date D of the May, June, July, or August study if EITHER projected August Lake Powell elevation < 3,525 ft OR projected August Lake Mead elevation < 1,025 ft (Tier 2 threshold). On signal: at close of release-date D (or next trading day if D is non-trading), take LONG basket of CCGT-heavy IPPs {VST 1.5%, TLN 1%, NRG 0.75%} = 3.25% gross long; SHORT Pacific NW utilities {AVA 0.75%, IDA 0.75%, BRK-B 0.5%} = 2% gross short. HOLD 60 trading days (covers summer peak). EXIT EARLY if next USBR study revises August projection back above thresholds.

Short Pacific NW utility basket: AVA 0.75%, IDA 0.75%, BRK-B 0.5% (2% gross short).

Counter-signal to long_SPY.

Entry at next-day close: short SPY -0.5, long TLT +0.5
exit_conditions: Hold 30 trading days (~6 weeks)
Early exit if ^SKEW closes < 130
Early exit if ^VIX closes > 22

name: FDA sNDA/sBLA Label-Expansion Approval -> Sponsor Long Drift 6-12 Weeks
rule: Event-driven on a static table of FDA sNDA/sBLA approval action letters from Drugs@FDA covering 2015-01 to present. Each row: action_date, sponsor_ticker, drug_name, indication_added, expansion_label (boolean: was patient population materially expanded? threshold +30% TAM growth, judged from FDA approval letter language). SIGNAL FIRES on action_date D for rows where expansion_label = TRUE AND sponsor_ticker is a single listed publicly-traded sponsor (not partnered). On signal: at close of D, LONG sponsor at 1% gross. HOLD 8 weeks (40 trading days). EXIT EARLY only on (a) sponsor next earnings release within hold window if a same-day return > +15% (lock in), (b) acquisition announcement (close at last close). Concurrent multiple signals are additive but cap total gross at 8% (8 names).
entry_conditions: FDA sNDA/sBLA approval action letter posted on Drugs@FDA on date D.
Label-expansion flag = TRUE (FDA letter language confirms broader population, additional line of therapy, pediatric extension, or new indication that grows TAM > +30%).
Sponsor ticker is single-name publicly-listed (excludes partner co-developments).
Long 1% gross at close of D.
exit_conditions: 40 trading days after entry (~8 weeks time stop).
Earnings release within hold window with same-day return > +15% — close at that close (lock in gains).
Acquisition announcement — close at last available close.

Each row: action_date, sponsor_ticker, drug, expansion_label (bool), label_change_summary. Maintained by backtester author by transcribing FDA action letters.

name: FDA CRL on CMC/Manufacturing -> 6-Week Delay Long Sponsor for 12-18 Month M&A Premium Re-Rate
rule: Event-driven on a static table of FDA Complete Response Letter (CRL) disclosures by clinical-stage biotech sponsors 2015-01 onward, filtered to those whose CRL cited CMC/manufacturing/labeling reasons (NOT efficacy/safety) AND whose prior Phase 3 trial hit primary endpoint per ClinicalTrials.gov. Each row: crl_date, sponsor_ticker, drug, crl_reason_category, phase3_endpoint_hit (bool). SIGNAL FIRES on crl_date D for filtered rows. On signal: WAIT 30 trading days (~6 calendar weeks) for retail/momentum panic to clear, then at close of D+30 trading days take LONG sponsor at 1% gross. HOLD 360 trading days (~18 months). EXIT EARLY on (a) acquisition announcement — close at next close, (b) sponsor goes bankrupt or delists — write down to last close. Concurrent multiple positions cap total gross at 10% (10 names).
entry_conditions: FDA CRL action letter posted on Drugs@FDA, dated D.
CRL reason category in {CMC, manufacturing, labeling, post-marketing-requirement} per FDA letter language (NOT efficacy/safety/clinical).
Sponsor's prior Phase 3 trial for the same indication hit primary endpoint per ClinicalTrials.gov posting.
Open 1% gross long position at close of trading day D+30 (~6 calendar weeks after CRL).
exit_conditions: 360 trading days after entry (~18 months time stop).
Acquisition announcement — close at next close.
Sponsor bankruptcy/delisting — close at last available close (mark-to-market write-down).

(3) Track positions through 18-month hold; on M&A announcement, close at next close (capture acquisition premium). (4) Daily PnL = sum over open legs of weight_i * log_return_i. (6) Report cumulative return when invested, Sharpe vs XBI buy-and-hold, max drawdown, M&A hit rate within hold window vs base rate.

implementation_notes: (1) CRL reason categorization is qualitative and requires reading the FDA action letter; backtester author should document the rule (recommend: CRL flagged as CMC if the letter cites manufacturing facility deficiencies, batch records, container/closure systems, or stability data, without citing efficacy or safety endpoint shortcomings). name: 0DTE SPX Share >55% on Up-Tape -> Short SPY Next-Day Open-to-Mid-Morning
rule: Each trading day, compute total SPX option volume and the share of that volume traded in 0DTE (zero-days-to-expiry) contracts using CBOE daily options statistics. On any day D where (a) 0DTE SPX volume share > 55% AND (b) SPX same-day total return > +0.4%, open a short SPY position at the close of session D at -1.0% NAV. Exit at the close of session D+1. Skip any day D+1 where the FOMC, CPI, NFP, PCE, or major Treasury auction is scheduled. Counter-signal trade.
entry_conditions: CBOE daily statistics report 0DTE SPX option volume share > 55%
SPX (^GSPC) same-day close return > +0.4%
No FOMC/CPI/NFP/PCE event scheduled for D+1 (else skip)
Open short SPY at the close of session D at -1.0% NAV (long-only-account proxy: long SH or VXX as a substitute)
exit_conditions: Cover at the close of session D+1 (~1 trading day hold)
Hard stop: cover at any time D+1 if SPY rallies > +1.0% intraday from prior close (signal failure)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance: SPY (daily close), ^GSPC (S&P 500 index, daily close), VIX1D (^VIX1D, daily close)
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: CBOE 0DTE Volume Statistics weekly/monthly report archives at cboe.com/us/options/market_statistics (free, PDF/HTML; historical 0DTE volume share series available from 2022 onwards); FRED macro calendar via FOMC/BLS schedule

backtest_approach: Daily signal time series + event-day return. (1) Construct historical daily 0DTE SPX volume share 2022-2025 from CBOE monthly statistics PDFs (scrape, archive). (2) Pull SPX daily total returns from yfinance ^GSPC. (3) Filter signal days where 0DTE share > 55% AND SPX return > +0.4%. (4) For each signal day, log the return of short SPY from close D to close D+1 (compute as negative of SPY close-to-close return). (5) Exclude D+1 dates falling on FOMC/CPI/NFP/PCE calendar dates. (6) Compute pooled mean return, hit rate (% of D+1 with SPY down), Sharpe of the strategy-equity curve.
known_events: Multiple instances 2023-2024 where 0DTE share exceeded 55% on up-tape days (e.g. July 2023 momentum cluster, March 2024 AI rally up-tape days)
implementation_notes: Counter-signal: the trade is short SPY against the consensus 'long-SPY' positioning. Pre-2022 0DTE volume data is sparse (SPX 0DTE Tuesday/Thursday expansion happened in 2022); backtest window is effectively 2022-2025. CBOE 0DTE volume share is published in monthly summary PDFs; daily granularity may require Wayback Machine snapshots or CBOE's weekly options-volume report. For long-only accounts (no shorting), the strategy can be implemented as long SH (-1x SPY ETF) or with reduced size via VXX (long VIX futures) — but baseline backtest uses short SPY. name: NAAIM Active Manager Crowding >+2sigma -> Defensive Rotation (Counter-Signal)
rule: Weekly state machine on NAAIM Exposure Index (Wednesday release). Compute 4-week smoothed NAAIM exposure S_t = mean(NAAIM_{t-3..t}). Compute trailing 4-year (208-week) mean mu and stdev sigma. Trigger when S_t > mu + 2*sigma. On trigger week, at Thursday open, open positions: LONG TLT 50%, LONG GLD 25%, SHORT SPY 25% (net market exposure approximately 50% short SPY hedged with duration/gold). Hold until smoothed NAAIM falls below mu + sigma OR 8 weeks elapsed, whichever first. PnL = 0.5*TLT_ret + 0.25*GLD_ret - 0.25*SPY_ret.
entry_conditions: NAAIM Wednesday release available
4-week smoothed NAAIM exposure exceeds 4-year mean + 2 sigma
Open positions at next-day (Thursday) open after Wednesday release
exit_conditions: Smoothed NAAIM falls below 4-year mean + 1 sigma
OR 8 weeks (40 trading days) elapsed since entry, whichever first

name: FOMC SEP Median Dot Revision vs OIS -> Long TLT Drift
rule: Event study around FOMC SEP releases (4 per year: Mar, Jun, Sep, Dec). For each SEP, compute delta_dot_1y = current SEP median for year T+1 - prior SEP median for the same year T+1 (or rolled-forward equivalent). Compute OIS-implied 1y forward rate at SEP release time vs prior SEP median. Trigger when delta_dot_1y <= -0.375% (37.5 bp = 3 dot grid steps down) AND OIS-implied 1y forward <= prior SEP median. On trigger, at SEP-release-day close, open LONG TLT 100% notional. Hold 10 trading days. Exit early if TLT drops more than 2 stdev (computed on trailing 60d) from entry close. Daily PnL = TLT_daily_return while in position.

delta_dot_1y (current SEP T+1 median minus prior SEP same-year median) <= -37.5 bp
OIS-implied 1y forward rate <= prior SEP median at release time
Open LONG TLT at SEP release day close
exit_conditions: 10 trading days after entry
OR TLT drops 2 sigma (trailing 60d) from entry close (stop-loss)

name: ECB-Fed Policy Rate Differential Widening >100bps -> Long UUP / Short FXE

Hold for 40 trading days. If the 60-day differential change reverses to < +15bps (narrowing), exit early. If the differential widens further by an additional 50bps, add 50% to position. No more than one open position at a time; minimum 60 calendar days between signals. Benchmark: SPY for excess-return calculation.

Known signal windows: 2015-2016 (Brent collapsed below , breakeven ~-100; multiple signals), H2-2019 (Brent ~-65, breakeven ~+), H2-2020 (COVID Brent collapse, breakeven ~+), H1-2023 (Brent ~-80, breakeven ~+). Compute per-signal PnL on KSA short, 30-day hold. Report Sharpe, win rate, average return. Note: KSA ETF only from Sep 2015 so 2015-2016 is the earliest backtest window.
implementation_notes: The IMF Saudi fiscal breakeven is published twice yearly (April and October REO); use the most recently published estimate for each signal year. The  gap threshold was chosen to filter noise -- Saudi Arabia routinely runs below breakeven in transition periods without immediate Tadawul impact. If backtesting the 2015-2016 window, KSA ETF launched Sep 2015 so early 2015 is unavailable; use QAT (Qatar ETF) or GULF as a proxy for that sub-period. BZ=F front-month contract has roll costs; consider using ^BZ (Brent index) if available on yfinance or FRED DCOILBRENTEU (daily Brent spot). name: GPR Daily Drop >1.5sd + Ukraine Battle Events -40% WoW -> Short RHM.DE EU Defense
rule: Using Caldara-Iacoviello GPR Daily index (free CSV at policyuncertainty.com/gpr.html) and ACLED Ukraine battle event counts (free download at acleddata.com/data): Compute the GPR 1-week rolling change in standard deviations (normalize GPR on trailing 52-week window). Simultaneously compute WoW change in Ukraine ACLED-coded battle event count. When the one-week GPR change is < -1.5 standard deviations (sharp GPR collapse) AND Ukraine battle events fall > 40% WoW, enter SHORT Rheinmetall (RHM.DE) on the following trading day. Size: 100% of trade notional in RHM.DE short; include EWG long hedge at 50% notional (to isolate defense re-rating from broad German equity move). Hold 20 trading days. Exit early if GPR re-accelerates (1-week change > +1.0 stdev). Stop-loss: RHM.DE gains > 6% from short entry. One position at a time; minimum 60 calendar days between signals. Benchmark: SPY. Counter-signal: counters long_defense_primes thesis.
entry_conditions: Caldara-Iacoviello GPR Daily index 1-week change < -1.5 standard deviations (normalized on trailing 52-week window)
ACLED Ukraine battle event count week-over-week decline > 40%
Enter SHORT RHM.DE (+ optional LONG EWG hedge at 50% notional) on next trading day
No existing open position; minimum 60 calendar days since last exit
exit_conditions: Hold 20 trading days from entry (primary exit)
Early exit if GPR 1-week change re-accelerates above +1.0 standard deviations
Stop-loss: RHM.DE gains more than 6% from short entry

data_sources_concrete.prices: RHM.DE, HAG.DE, EWG, ITA (iShares US Aerospace & Defense), SPY via yfinance
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: GPR Daily CSV (policyuncertainty.com/gpr.html, free download, updated weekly); ACLED Ukraine battle event data (acleddata.com public dataset, free download for research)

backtest_approach: Build GPR Daily series from policyuncertainty.com CSV (available from 1985 for monthly, daily from 2000). Compute rolling 52-week mean/stdev of weekly GPR levels; compute 1-week change in stdev units. ACLED Ukraine data available for download from Feb 2022 (Ukraine war start). Signal requires both conditions simultaneously. Potential signal dates: Mar-Apr 2022 (Istanbul ceasefire talks, GPR spiked then dropped sharply); Oct-Nov 2024 (various ceasefire discussion periods); early 2025 (Trump-era peace proposal coverage). Note: Ukraine-specific ACLED data only exists from Feb 2022, so the full ACLED condition only applies post-2022. For pre-2022 backtesting, use GPR-only trigger or substitute a different conflict (Syria, 2016 Aleppo ceasefire) as methodological analog. RHM.DE data from 1998 on yfinance (extensive history). Report per-signal PnL (RHM.DE short leg), holding-period Sharpe.
implementation_notes: HAG.DE (Hensoldt) data only from Sep 2020 (IPO), so use RHM.DE as the primary trade vehicle with its longer data history. ITA (iShares US Aerospace & Defense) included for cross-regional defense comparison but trade is EU-only. ACLED data download requires free account registration; for automated backtesting use the public bulk download (available at acleddata.com/data) rather than the API. ACLED Ukraine event counts can be weekly-aggregated from the daily CSV. GPR daily CSV is directly downloadable from policyuncertainty.com without registration. The dual-condition (GPR + ACLED) is more precise but fewer signals; backtester may relax to GPR-only to increase event count. EWG long hedge isolates the EU defense sector premium from broad German equity beta. Counter-signal framing: this strategy bets against the EU defense re-arming thesis that many long_defense_primes signals in the catalog are built on.

name: JMMC Analyst Dispersion -> BNO Long Pre-Meeting
rule: Using OPEC JMMC meeting calendar (fixed 4-6 weeks in advance), identify meeting date M. On day M-5 (5 trading days before meeting), go long BNO (Brent ETF). Exit at close of day M+3 (3 trading days after meeting). Only enter if pre-meeting Reuters/S&P Platts analyst survey shows stddev of expected OPEC output change >= 300 kb/d (high dispersion threshold). Cap position size at 2% NAV. Hard stop-loss: exit early if BNO falls more than 3% from entry.
entry_conditions: JMMC meeting date identifiable 5+ trading days in advance from OPEC.org calendar
Pre-meeting analyst survey dispersion (stddev of expected quota change) >= 300 kb/d
Enter long BNO at close on day M-5
exit_conditions: Exit at close on day M+3 (3 trading days after meeting)
Hard stop: exit early if BNO closes -3% below entry price
Force exit if meeting is cancelled or postponed to unknown date

data_sources_concrete.prices: BNO (iPath Bloomberg Brent Crude ETN, yfinance); BZ=F (Brent front-month futures, yfinance)
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: none - OPEC JMMC calendar from opec.org; Reuters/S&P Platts survey dispersion from press archives

backtest_approach: Event-study: identify all JMMC meeting dates 2020-2025 (~12-15 events). For each event, compute BNO return from M-5 close to M+3 close. Separate into high-dispersion (stddev >= 300 kb/d) vs low-dispersion sub-groups. Key metric: mean return and hit rate for high-dispersion events. Benchmark vs buy-and-hold BNO over same date windows. Analog dates: 2022-10-05 OPEC+ surprise 2mb/d cut, 2023-04-02 surprise voluntary cuts, 2024-06 baseline quota extension. Note: survey dispersion data requires manual annotation from press archives; backtester should use meeting surprise (actual vs median consensus) as proxy if needed.
implementation_notes: Survey dispersion data is not programmatically free; backtester should treat meeting as high dispersion if |actual output change - median pre-meeting forecast| > 200 kb/d as proxy. BZ=F (futures) can substitute for BNO for longer history. JMMC calendar is advisory; actual OPEC+ ministerial meetings may differ - cross-reference.

name: OPEC+ Surprise Cut -> Long STNG / Short FRO Product-vs-Crude Tanker Pair
rule: On the day OPEC+ announces a surprise voluntary production cut (actual cut > 200 kb/d beyond consensus expectation), initiate a market-neutral pair trade: Go long STNG (Scorpio Tankers, product tanker fleet) and short FRO (Frontline, VLCC/crude fleet) in equal dollar notional. Hold for 30 calendar days or until STNG/FRO spread reverts to pre-event level, whichever first. Exit at 30-day mark or if pair spread moves adverse by >8% from entry.
entry_conditions: OPEC+ official press release announces aggregate voluntary cut exceeding 200 kb/d above Bloomberg/Reuters median consensus
Enter at next trading day open (T+1) after announcement date
Equal dollar notional: long STNG, short FRO
exit_conditions: Exit both legs at 30-calendar-day mark from entry
Stop-loss: exit if STNG underperforms FRO by more than 8% from entry (pair spread -8%)
Profit target: exit if STNG outperforms FRO by 15% from entry (pair spread +15%)

data_sources_concrete.prices: STNG (Scorpio Tankers, yfinance); FRO (Frontline plc, yfinance); INSW (International Seaways, supplemental); SPY (benchmark)
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: none - OPEC announcement dates from opec.org press releases; Baltic BDTI/BCTI weekly summaries free at balticexchange.com

backtest_approach: Event-study on OPEC+ surprise cuts 2018-2025. Identify announcement dates where actual cut exceeded median pre-meeting Reuters/Platts consensus by >200 kb/d. For each event, compute STNG - FRO pair return (long-short, equal notional) from T+1 open over T+1 to T+30 calendar days. Compare vs control periods (OPEC+ meetings with no surprise). Analog dates: 2023-04-03 (day after 2023-04-02 voluntary cut announcement), 2022-10-06 (day after Oct-2022 2mb/d cut), 2020-04-13 (historic 9.7mb/d cut). Dollar-neutral so no net beta exposure; isolate the product-vs-crude tanker divergence.
implementation_notes: STNG IPO was ~2010 but thin liquidity pre-2018; use 2018 onward for clean history. FRO listed on NYSE since 2019 as restructured entity (post-merger with Golden Ocean spin); pre-2019 FRO data on yfinance may not reflect the current entity - treat cautiously. INSW can serve as alternative crude/dirty tanker short leg if FRO data is spotty. This is a counter-signal to the consensus long-oil-equities trade on OPEC cuts. Pair returns will be volatile on thin tanker equity liquidity; size accordingly (<1.5% NAV each leg).

name: EU Frozen-Asset Transfer + USASpending Ukraine Surge -> Long URI/MTZ Reconstruction Pair vs XLI
rule: Enter long equal-weight URI/MTZ when: (1) EU Council Decision register publishes a frozen-Russian-asset utilization decision (eur-lex.europa.eu) AND (2) USASpending.gov Ukraine-tagged obligations 90-day rolling sum crosses $5B as measured by the USASPENDING.gov API (recipient_location_country_name=UKR OR assistance_type_code=04). Hedge by shorting XLI of equal notional. Hold 6-16 weeks. Exit on: (a) appropriation stall (USASpending 90d rolling drops below $2B), (b) basket outperforms XLI by >20%, or (c) 16 weeks elapsed. Stop-loss if basket underperforms XLI by >12%.
entry_conditions: EU Council Decision register publishes frozen-Russian-asset utilization/transfer decision (searchable at eur-lex.europa.eu, EUR-Lex API)
USASpending.gov Ukraine-tagged obligations 90-day rolling sum >= $5B (API endpoint: /api/v2/spending_by_category/)
exit_conditions: USASpending.gov Ukraine-tagged 90d obligations roll below $2B (appropriation stall)
Equal-weight URI+MTZ outperforms XLI by >20% since entry (take-profit)
Equal-weight URI+MTZ underperforms XLI by >12% since entry (stop-loss)
16 weeks elapsed since entry (time stop)

data_sources_concrete.prices: URI, MTZ, XLI, SPY daily via yfinance
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: USASpending.gov public API /api/v2/spending_by_category/ with award_type_codes and recipient_country UKR filter; EUR-Lex EUR/Lex API for EU Council Decision XML (no FRED series needed)

backtest_approach: Event study: identify historical dates when the dual trigger fired. Primary analog period: US Ukraine Aid Authorization Apr 2022 (initial Lend-Lease) + EU windfall proceeds mechanism (Reg 2024/576 Jul 2024 vote). Use USASpending.gov historical obligations data to reconstruct rolling 90d sum for UKR-tagged awards. For each event date, compute 5/10/20/30/60/90-day forward returns of equal-weight URI+MTZ basket vs XLI, and vs SPY. Use daily PnL with hedge ratio 1:1 (equal dollar notional).
known_events: 2022-04-28 (US Ukraine Democracy Defense Lend-Lease Act signed, $40B supplemental aid)
2022-09-30 (EU Council Decision 2022/1784 $19B macro-financial assistance)
2024-07-01 (EU Reg 2024/576 windfall profits mechanism activated, $3B tranche)
2025-01-22 (US Ukraine Supplemental $61B final disbursement milestone)
implementation_notes: USASpending.gov API has reliable data from FY2008; Ukraine-tagged filter uses recipient_country_name=Ukraine OR keyword Ukraine in program_activity_name. PRIM (Primoris Services) was in the original idea but is smaller-cap ($2.5B) and less liquid than URI ($40B) and MTZ ($17B) — drop PRIM to reduce noise; document here for optional basket expansion. XLI short is the hedge (sector-neutral approach). Note: the causal mechanism relies on EU Council decisions which need NLP/text monitoring in live operation — for backtesting, the known_events dates serve as the trigger timestamps.

name: PLA Taiwan Strait OPTEMPO Surge -> Short EWT, Long LMT/RTX Pair
rule: Trigger: Taiwan MND daily PLA activity count (aircraft + naval vessels crossing median line) 5-day rolling z-score > +2.0 stdev vs trailing 252-day baseline, AND a named PLA exercise (Joint Sword-type) officially announced by Eastern Theater Command. On the day both conditions are met, initiate: short EWT (iShares MSCI Taiwan ETF) and long equal-weight LMT + RTX basket (Lockheed Martin + Raytheon Technologies). Dollar-neutral: $1 short EWT per $0.50 long LMT + $0.50 long RTX. Exit on PLA exercise stand-down announcement OR US-PRC senior-level de-escalation communique, OR at 20 trading days, whichever comes first. Stop: exit entire pair if EWT rises 4% from entry (short squeeze risk).
entry_conditions: Taiwan MND 5-day PLA activity z-score > +2.0 stdev vs trailing 252-day window
Named PLA exercise officially announced by PLA Eastern Theater Command (Xinhua/CCTV)
Enter short EWT + long LMT/RTX (equal-weight, dollar-neutral) at next-day open
exit_conditions: Exit on PLA Eastern Theater Command exercise-conclusion announcement
Exit on US-PRC senior-level de-escalation readout (State Dept / White House)
Exit at 20-trading-day maximum hold period
Stop-loss: exit if EWT rises 4% from entry price (covers short leg)

data_sources_concrete.prices: EWT (iShares MSCI Taiwan ETF, yfinance); LMT (Lockheed Martin, yfinance); RTX (Raytheon Technologies, yfinance); XAR/ITA (defense ETFs, benchmark); SPY (broad benchmark)
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED: none. Event dates from Taiwan MND PLA activity tracker (mnd.gov.tw); named exercises from PLA Eastern Theater Command Xinhua archive.

backtest_approach: Event-study on Taiwan Strait escalation episodes 2020-2025. Key analog dates: 2022-08-02 Pelosi visit (Joint Sword-precursor drills, 5-day window ~Aug 4-9), 2024-05-23 Joint Sword-2024A (post-Lai Ching-te inauguration), 2021-06 ADIZ incursion cluster (25+ aircraft), 2023-04 (post-Tsai-McCarthy meeting drills). For each event, compute: (1) EWT return from T+1 to T+N (N=5,10,20), (2) LMT/RTX equal-weight return over same window, (3) pair return (long LMT+RTX, short EWT). Control: non-escalation OPEC+ calendar periods same length. EWT z-score proxy: use daily ADIZ incursion counts published by Taiwan MND; backtester can hardcode 5-10 known event dates if scraping is infeasible.
implementation_notes: Taiwan MND data is publicly available but requires web scraping of mnd.gov.tw tables; backtester should hardcode the 4 known event onset dates above for the initial event study. Only 4 clean events in the 2020-2025 window - results will have wide confidence intervals; treat as directional evidence not statistical significance. EWT FX effect: TWD/USD move is embedded in EWT returns (both equity + FX channel). LMT history is clean from 2020; RTX was formed 2020-04-03 (Raytheon/UTC merger). Use RTX data from 2020-04-06 onward; for pre-merger proxy use RTN (old Raytheon). Defense sector re-rate may lag 10-15 days as sell-side updates FMS pipeline estimates.

name: Taiwan Strait Subsea Cable Severance Cluster -> Long IRDM/ASTS, Short EWT
rule: Trigger: 2 or more Taiwan-region submarine cable cuts within a 14-day window confirmed by TeleGeography or Taiwan MODA, AND Chunghwa Telecom declares restoration ETA > 60 days (vessel-access blocked). On trigger day, enter: long IRDM (Iridium) + ASTS (AST SpaceMobile) equal-weight, short EWT (iShares MSCI Taiwan ETF). Dollar sizing: $1 EWT short per $0.50 IRDM + $0.50 ASTS long. Exit when TeleGeography reports cable RFS (return-to-full-service) on the severed cable OR PLAN exclusion zone lifted OR at 60-calendar-day maximum, whichever comes first. Stop: exit if EWT rises 5% from entry or IRDM+ASTS basket falls 7% from entry.
entry_conditions: >=2 Taiwan-region cable severance events within 14 calendar days per TeleGeography/MODA
Chunghwa Telecom or MODA confirms restoration ETA >60 days (repair vessel blocked)
Enter long IRDM+ASTS, short EWT at next-day open after trigger confirmation
exit_conditions: Exit on TeleGeography cable RFS update for the affected cable(s)
Exit on confirmed PLAN exclusion-zone lift or repair vessel access granted
Maximum hold: 60 calendar days
Stop-loss: exit if EWT +5% from entry or long basket -7% from entry

data_sources_concrete.prices: IRDM (Iridium Communications, yfinance); ASTS (AST SpaceMobile, yfinance); EWT (iShares MSCI Taiwan ETF, yfinance); CHT (Chunghwa Telecom ADR, yfinance); SPY (benchmark)
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: none - TeleGeography Submarine Cable Map (free, manual); Taiwan MODA press releases; Chunghwa Telecom (CHT) IR press releases

Known cluster events: 2023-02-02 Matsu #2/#3 cable cut (restoration ~50 days), 2024-12 Taiwan-Penghu cable damage cluster (if confirmed by TeleGeography). For each event, compute IRDM return, ASTS return (from 2022 IPO), and EWT return from T+1 to T+10, T+20, T+60. Pair return = (IRDM+ASTS equal-weight) - EWT. ASTS has data only from Jan 2022; use IRDM-only for pre-2022 events as proxy. Note: event count is very small (2-3 events); backtester should present individual event P&L rather than statistical aggregates. Chunghwa Telecom (CHT) can serve as additional long leg for cable-disruption demand.

Backtester should run IRDM-only variant (longer history) as primary and IRDM+ASTS as secondary. TeleGeography data requires manual lookup - backtester hardcodes the 2 known event dates. Very sparse event set (2 confirmed clusters) - treat as feasibility study, not robust backtest. CHT (Chunghwa Telecom ADR) may not react strongly as it has full restoration backup capacity; include for completeness. This strategy is partially exploratory; a third cluster event (2025 or beyond) would significantly improve statistical confidence.

name: SOFR Strip Overshoot (>5 Cuts Priced / 2y<3%) -> Short TLT Counter-Signal
rule: Counter-signal fires when: (1) SOFR futures strip implies more than 5 rate cuts over the next 12 months (ZQ=F front 12 contracts imply implied rate drop > 125bps), AND (2) the 2-year Treasury yield (FRED DGS2) is below 3.0%, indicating front-end has already fully repriced. Entry: short TLT at market open on the next trading day after both conditions are met simultaneously. Size: 100% notional short TLT or long TBF (inverse). Exit: (a) 2-year yield rises back above 3.5%, OR (b) SOFR strip reprices to fewer than 3 cuts implied, OR (c) time stop at 8 weeks, OR (d) trailing 8% loss stop on TLT position. DO NOT fire if a new FOMC meeting confirming >5 cuts is within 10 calendar days (data window uncertainty).
entry_conditions: SOFR front-12-contract strip implies >125bps of cuts over next 12 months (ZQ=F contracts: rate = 100 - price; compute expected cuts from front-to-12th contract spread)
FRED DGS2 (2-year Treasury yield) < 3.0% on the signal date
Both conditions must be met on the same calendar date
exit_conditions: DGS2 rises back above 3.5% (front-end repricing confirms cut path wrong)
SOFR strip reprices to fewer than 3 implied cuts (expectation exhaustion resolved)
8-week time stop from entry date
8% trailing stop loss on TLT (short position)  -- protection against unexpected dovish shock

data_sources_concrete.prices: TLT, TBF, IEF, SPY via yfinance
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED DGS2 (2-year Treasury yield); SOFR futures strip via ZQ=F front 12 contracts on yfinance or FRED SOFR30DAYAVG as proxy; known event dates: Dec 2023 (priced 6.5 cuts), Aug 2024 (priced 5+ cuts)

backtest_approach: Event-study backtest. Identify historical dates where SOFR strip overshoot >5 cuts AND DGS2<3% coincided. Seed dates: ~Dec 13 2023 (post-Dec FOMC dot shift), ~Aug 5 2024 (post-jobs-scare peak dovishness). For each seed: enter short TLT on next open, track daily PnL for 8 weeks or until exit triggered. Also run rolling daily scan from 2022-2024 to catch any additional instances. Primary metric: TLT return (negated for short) over 3/5/8-week horizons. Benchmark: SPY return over same windows.
implementation_notes: Counter-signal exempt from SPY-primary cap. SOFR ZQ=F contracts may not go back far enough in yfinance history; use FRED SOFR30DAYAVG + FEDFUNDS as fallback to reconstruct implied cut count. Only 2 clean analog dates exist in modern era -- bt_feasibility=4 reflects thin event count. This counters PL050, PL101, PL126, PL131, PL597 which are long-TLT signals.

name: NFP Negative + Sahm Rule Cross -> Long KBE / Short KRE Pair
rule: Pair trade fires when BOTH conditions met in same calendar month: (1) BLS Non-Farm Payrolls (FRED PAYEMS monthly change) prints < 0 (job losses), AND (2) Sahm Real-Time Recession Indicator (FRED SAHMREALTIME) crosses above +0.50pp. Entry: next trading day open -- go LONG KBE (SPDR S&P Bank ETF, money-center heavy) and SHORT KRE (SPDR S&P Regional Banking ETF) in equal dollar notional. Size: 100% of capital in each leg (dollar-neutral pair). Exit: (a) Sahm indicator drops back below +0.30pp, OR (b) 12-week time stop, OR (c) 15% trailing stop on pair P&L (KBE long + KRE short combined).
entry_conditions: FRED PAYEMS monthly change (NFP) < 0 for the just-released month
FRED SAHMREALTIME >= 0.50 (Sahm rule triggered) in the same release month
Both conditions must coincide within the same monthly release cycle (within 30 days of each other)
exit_conditions: FRED SAHMREALTIME drops back below 0.30pp (recession signal abates)
12-week time stop from entry date
15% trailing stop on combined pair P&L (long KBE + short KRE)

data_sources_concrete.prices: KBE, KRE, SPY via yfinance (KBE available from ~2005, KRE from ~2006)
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED PAYEMS (monthly NFP level -- compute MoM change); FRED SAHMREALTIME (Sahm real-time indicator, available 2007-present); FRED DGS2, DGS10 for yield curve context

backtest_approach: Event-study backtest. Identify months where PAYEMS MoM < 0 AND SAHMREALTIME >= 0.50 simultaneously. Primary analogs: Jan 2008 (NFP -17k, Sahm crossing), Sep-Nov 2008 (multiple months), Mar-Apr 2020 (Covid shock -- Sahm surged). For each event: enter pair at next open, track daily P&L of long-KBE/short-KRE for up to 12 weeks. Report pair return, KBE standalone, KRE standalone, and SPY benchmark. Note: 2020 analog is unusual (V-shaped recovery); check if pair held or reversed quickly. SAHMREALTIME only available from 2007; pre-2007 use manual Sahm calculation from UNRATE + UNRATE_3MMA.
implementation_notes: KBE inception ~2005, KRE ~2006 -- both have enough history for 2008 analog. SAHMREALTIME FRED series starts 2007; backtester should manually compute Sahm rule (3m avg UNRATE - 12m min UNRATE) for pre-2007 dates if extending history. KBE has larger money-center bank weight (JPM, BAC, USB, WFC) vs KRE which is pure regional. Do NOT fire in mid-2020 if recovery already apparent -- exit rule (Sahm drop) handles this. Distinct from PL625 which uses HY OAS as trigger, not NFP/Sahm.

name: Brent Backwardation + OVX Spike -> Long XLP / Short XLY Consumer Rotation
rule: Trigger conditions (both must be met on same day): (1) CBOE OVX (^OVX) closes above 50, AND (2) BZ=F (Brent front-month) 20-day rolling return > +15% (proxy for physical scarcity / tight M1-M3 spread). On trigger day close, enter: long XLP (Consumer Staples ETF), short XLY (Consumer Discretionary ETF), equal dollar notional. Exit when OVX falls back below 35, OR at 30-trading-day maximum hold. Stop: exit if XLY outperforms XLP by more than 5% from entry (momentum reversal).
entry_conditions: CBOE OVX (^OVX) daily close > 50
Brent front-month (BZ=F) 20-day return > +15% (physical scarcity proxy)
Both conditions met on same trading day; enter at that day close
exit_conditions: OVX closes below 35 (volatility normalization)
Maximum 30-trading-day hold from entry
Stop-loss: XLY outperforms XLP by 5% cumulative from entry

data_sources_concrete.prices: XLP (Consumer Staples Select Sector SPDR, yfinance); XLY (Consumer Discretionary Select Sector SPDR, yfinance); BZ=F (Brent crude front-month futures, yfinance); ^OVX (CBOE Crude Oil Volatility Index, yfinance)
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: none - all data via yfinance. Note: Brent M1-M3 calendar spread ideally needed but not available free; use BZ=F 20-day return as proxy for tight physical spread regime.

backtest_approach: Daily time-series backtest 2010-2025 (OVX data available from 2010). On each day where OVX > 50 AND BZ=F 20-day return > 15%, enter XLP long / XLY short. Track pair P&L daily until OVX < 35 or 30-day max. Key events to validate against: 2011 Libya crisis (Feb-Mar), 2019 Aramco attack (Sep), 2022 Russia invasion spike (Feb-Mar), 2024 Iran-Israel direct exchange (Apr). Compute: mean pair return per triggered episode, hit rate (XLP > XLY), max drawdown. Benchmark: buy-and-hold XLP vs XLY over same windows. This is a counter-signal to long-SPY/QQQ catalog entries - the mechanism is consumer demand destruction via gasoline pass-through, NOT equity mean reversion.
implementation_notes: OVX ticker on yfinance is ^OVX (not OVX). Brent M1-M3 calendar spread (ideal trigger) is not available on yfinance; backtester should use BZ=F 20-day return > 15% as a practical proxy. Alternative: compute BZ=F vs CL=F spread as crude-quality proxy for tight physical. This is a counter_signal to long_SPY and long_QQQ - per spec, XLP/XLY targets are correct here. The mechanism is oil-tax-on-consumer: Kilian (2009) documents 3-6 week transmission lag. Beware: post-2022 EV adoption may reduce gasoline pass-through in future data.

name: Lloyd's JWC Listed-Area Expansion (Hormuz/Red Sea) -> Long P&C Reinsurer Basket
rule: Trigger: Lloyd's Joint War Committee (JWC) publishes a bulletin adding or materially expanding the Persian Gulf, Strait of Hormuz, or Bab-el-Mandeb to their Hull War listed areas. The bulletin is a free PDF published on market-standards.co.uk (Lloyd's Market Association). On the next trading day after bulletin date, enter long equal-weight basket: RNR (RenaissanceRe), EG (Everest Group), RLI Corp (RLI), AXS (Axis Capital), ACGL (Arch Capital). 2% NAV each position (10% gross). Exit at 90-calendar-day mark from entry, or on JWC area-removal bulletin, whichever first. Stop: exit basket if equal-weight basket falls 8% from entry.
entry_conditions: Lloyd's JWC publishes bulletin adding/expanding Persian Gulf, Hormuz, or Bab-el-Mandeb to Hull War listed areas
Enter long equal-weight {RNR, EG, RLI, AXS, ACGL} at T+1 open after bulletin date
2% NAV per position, 10% gross basket exposure
exit_conditions: JWC publishes bulletin removing/contracting the listed area (geopolitical de-escalation)
Maximum hold 90 calendar days from entry
Stop-loss: equal-weight basket -8% from entry

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: none - Lloyd's JWC bulletins from market-standards.co.uk (free PDF); UKMTO incident reports; International Group of P&I Clubs circulars

backtest_approach: Event-study on JWC listed-area expansion events 2019-2025. For each event date, compute equal-weight {RNR, EG, RLI, AXS, ACGL} return at T+1, T+10, T+30, T+60, T+90 from event onset. Compare vs SPY benchmark and vs XLF (financial sector) over same windows. Hypothesis: reinsurers outperform by 3-7% at 30-60 day horizon as hard-market pricing flows through. Marine war risk is a small but high-margin line; impact on total reinsurer earnings may take 1-2 quarters to materialize in ROE - the equity re-rate is pricing-in forward treaty rate uplift, not current-quarter earnings. Position sizing should be modest (2% each) given geopolitical binary risk.

name: TSM Complacency Regime (6m >+30% + Low VIX) -> Short TSM Counter-Signal
rule: COUNTER-SIGNAL (counters long_semis). Enter short TSM when ALL conditions are met on a weekly signal check: (1) TSM 6-month total return > +30%, (2) TSM 14-day RSI > 70, (3) CBOE VIX < 14 (vol compression / low tail-risk pricing, proxy for skew compression), AND (4) TSM 3-month put/call OI ratio at lowest decile available from current options chain. Hold 10-30 trading days. Exit on: (a) TSM 14-day RSI falls below 50, (b) VIX spikes above 20 (vol normalization), (c) TSM drops >8% from entry (target), or (d) TSM rises >4% from entry (stop-loss). Maximum 1 position per quarter to avoid multiple entries during sustained bull runs.
entry_conditions: TSM 6-month total return > +30% (price momentum proxy for complacency)
TSM 14-day RSI > 70 (overbought technically)
CBOE VIX < 14 (volatility compression: proxy for put-call skew compression)
TSM yfinance options chain shows put/call open interest ratio at or below 10th percentile of trailing 252-day observation (optional live filter)
exit_conditions: TSM 14-day RSI falls below 50 (momentum exhaustion)
CBOE VIX rises above 20 (vol normalization triggers skew recovery)
TSM cumulative return from entry reaches -8% (profit target)
TSM cumulative return from entry reaches +4% (stop-loss)
30 trading days elapsed since entry (time stop)

data_sources_concrete.prices: TSM, SPY daily via yfinance; ^VIX daily via yfinance
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED VIXCLS for VIX history (cross-check); options chain via yfinance Ticker.option_chain() for live filter only

backtest_approach: Rolling signal: each week, check whether all entry conditions are met. Track RSI(14) and 6m-return daily. When signal fires, mark entry. Daily PnL = -1 * TSM return (short position). Use known_events analog dates to validate the signal fires near those periods. Compute max-favorable-excursion and max-adverse-excursion distributions across all historical firings. SPY included for excess-return calculation. Do not re-enter within 63 trading days of last entry to avoid overlapping trades.
known_events: 2022-01-10 (TSM peaked before China-tech route; 6m return was +40% Jan 2022)
2023-07-17 (TSM post-Pelosi-anniversary re-rate; VIX <14 and TSM RSI >72)
2024-01-22 (TSM post-Lai-inauguration; 6m return >35%, RSI elevated)
2024-07-19 (TSM all-time high before AI bubble correction)
implementation_notes: Counter-signal to PL023/PL042/PL107/PL145/PL416 long-semis stack. The original idea used 25-delta implied-vol skew and analyst PT dispersion, but neither is reconstructable historically from free data. Substituting RSI+VIX+6m-return gives a backtestable proxy for the same complacency regime; signal fires in similar market states (extended bull runs with depressed tail hedging). The loss of the exact skew quantile means the signal will fire more frequently than intended — the quarterly re-entry cap guards against over-trading. In live operation, the operator should layer the actual yfinance options put/call OI ratio as an additional gate.

name: SOFR Strip Repricing (>=2 Cuts in 5d) -> Long GDX Gold Miners
rule: Enter long GDX when: the 5-day change in ZQ=F front contract implied policy rate falls by >=50 bps (equivalent to 2 additional 25bp cuts priced in) AND FRED DFII5 (5y TIPS yield) drops >=20 bps over the same 5-day window (confirming real-rate channel, not just term premium). Hold 4-8 weeks. Exit on: (a) ZQ=F 5-day change reverses to +25bps or more (cut pricing unwound), (b) GDX outperforms GLD by >15% since entry (target), or (c) 8 weeks elapsed (time stop). For SOFR analog pre-2018, use FRED FEDFUNDS change as proxy for cut-count repricing (a 5-day change in FF futures-implied rate >= -50bps triggers equivalently).
entry_conditions: ZQ=F (SOFR front contract) 5-day change in implied rate <= -50 bps (>=2 cuts of 25bp added to front 12mo strip)
FRED DFII5 (5-year TIPS yield) 5-day change <= -20 bps (real-rate channel confirmed)
GDX price above its 50-day simple moving average (avoid entering into downtrending miners)
exit_conditions: ZQ=F 5-day change turns positive by >= +25 bps (cut pricing partially unwound)
GDX cumulative return vs GLD since entry >= +15% (miners have absorbed the real-rate repricing)
GDX cumulative return from entry <= -8% (stop-loss: SOFR move was a false signal)
8 weeks (40 trading days) elapsed since entry (time stop)

data_sources_concrete.prices: GDX, GLD, GC=F, SPY daily via yfinance; ZQ=F (SOFR front futures) daily via yfinance
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED DFII5 (5y real yield / TIPS); FRED DTWEXBGS (broad dollar index, for context)

backtest_approach: Daily signal scan: on each day, compute 5-day rolling change in ZQ=F implied rate (100 - price = rate) and 5-day change in FRED DFII5. When both thresholds are met, mark entry in GDX. For pre-2018 analog dates (Dec 2018, Aug 2015, Jan 2016): use Fed Funds futures proxy or interpolate from FRED FEDFUNDS for the trigger computation. Compute daily PnL = GDX return. Also compute GDX vs GLD spread PnL. Report Sharpe, max drawdown, win rate, and excess return vs GLD to measure the miner-beta premium. For each analog, also track real yield (DFII5) and DXY (DTWEXBGS) as diagnostic series.
known_events: 2018-12-20 (Fed paused; SOFR/FF strip repriced >2 cuts in 5d; GDX +14% over 6 weeks)
2020-03-03 (Emergency cut 50bps; strip repriced massively; GDX outperformed GLD over 6 weeks)
2024-08-05 (Sahm rule trigger + weak NFP; strip repriced >=3 cuts; GDX +20% over 8 weeks)
2019-06-04 (Powell pivot speech at Chicago; strip repriced >=2 cuts; GDX +12% over 5 weeks)
implementation_notes: ZQ=F is a single front-contract price. To properly count 12-month strip cuts, the backtester should download ZQ=F, ZQH=F, ZQM=F etc. (quarterly SOFR contracts) and sum the implied-rate changes across all contracts within the next 12 months. As a practical shortcut, the 5-day change in the front ZQ=F price is a good proxy because the front contract usually reprices fastest and most fully. SOFR futures only exist since 2018; for Dec 2018 analog, use FF futures via yfinance (ZFF1=F or reconstruct from FRED FEDFUNDS). GDX is preferred over single-name NEM/GOLD/AEM because the miner-beta mechanism is aggregate (AISC margin expansion is industry-wide). GDX is listed in target_assets.md.

name: Strait-of-Hormuz AIS Gap / Dark Fleet Surge -> Long STNG / Short FRO Pair
rule: Event-driven pair trade. Trigger: a publicly confirmed Strait-of-Hormuz security incident (IRGC vessel seizure, drone attack on commercial ship, US Navy/P&I club advisory) that generates a documented AIS gap cluster or rerouting advisory in the Gulf of Oman / Hormuz area. Entry: next trading day open after event is publicly confirmed via UKHO MARLO bulletin OR US 5th Fleet advisory OR Lloyd's JWC listed-area expansion for Persian Gulf. Trade: LONG STNG (product tanker / MR/LR2 pure-play) and SHORT FRO (VLCC-heavy) in equal dollar notional. Rationale: incident forces cargo rerouting via Cape, expanding MR/LR2 ton-miles while suppressing VLCC AG-Asia utilization. Exit: (a) UKHO MARLO advisory lifted / security situation normalized per official bulletin, OR (b) 45-calendar-day time stop, OR (c) 15% trailing stop on pair P&L.
entry_conditions: Public security incident in Strait of Hormuz / Gulf of Oman confirmed via UKHO MARLO, US 5th Fleet advisory, or Lloyd's JWC Persian Gulf listing update
AIS gap cluster OR tanker owner force-majeure declaration for AG voyages is publicly cited in maritime press (TradeWinds, Lloyd's List, Hellenic Shipping News)
Entry next trading day open after confirmation
exit_conditions: Official MARLO advisory lifted or security condition normalized per public bulletin
45-calendar-day time stop from entry date
15% trailing stop on combined pair P&L (long STNG + short FRO)

data_sources_concrete.prices: STNG, FRO, INSW, DHT, SPY via yfinance (STNG from ~2014, FRO from ~2005)
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: UKHO MARLO bulletins (public, free); Lloyd's JWC listed-area updates; Baltic Exchange BCTI (product tanker) and BDTI (dirty tanker) via Hellenic Shipping News (free delayed). Event dates sourced from public maritime news.

backtest_approach: Event-study backtest using 4 known analog incident dates: (1) Jul 19 2019 (IRGC seized Stena Impero, Hormuz closure threat); (2) Jan 10 2024 (Houthi MR attacks, Red Sea/Hormuz rerouting began); (3) Apr 13 2024 (IRGC seized MSC Aries container, Hormuz gap cluster); (4) Jun 2019 (Gulf of Oman tanker attacks, twin-incident). For each: enter STNG long + FRO short at next open, track daily P&L for up to 45 days or exit signal. Compute pair return, leg attribution, and drawdown. Also compare with STNG standalone long as robustness check. Note: EURN (Euronav) was the original VLCC short target but merged with FRO in 2024; use FRO as VLCC proxy throughout for consistency.
implementation_notes: EURN US-listed shares are delisted (merger with FRO completed 2024); use FRO as VLCC short leg throughout backtest. STNG available on yfinance from 2014. For 2019 events, FRO history is available (FRO has been NYSE-listed since ~2004). AIS gap trigger is NOT algorithmically detectable from free data -- backtester must use event dates as manual seed inputs. bt_feasibility=3 reflects the need for manual event identification. If backtester wants an algorithmic proxy: sharp single-day spike in STNG volume (>2x 20-day avg) coinciding with maritime advisory can approximate the trigger.

name: Hyperscaler 10-Q Capex Run-Rate Overshoot vs Annual Guide -> Short NVDA Counter-Signal
rule: Counter-signal against long semis / long NVDA. Fires quarterly after the top-4 hyperscalers (MSFT, GOOGL, META, AMZN) all file 10-Q reports (approximately 4-6 weeks after quarter end). Compute YTD capex for each as: sum of 9-K PP&E additions from SEC EDGAR XBRL (us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment) from Q1 through latest reported quarter. Compare vs straight-line FY guide midpoint from most recent 8-K earnings call. Signal fires when: YTD aggregate (MSFT+GOOGL+META+AMZN) capex pace exceeds 105% of straight-line annual guide pace AND 'remaining purchase commitments' footnote is flat or declining QoQ (confirmed real spend cut, not timing). Entry: short NVDA at market open on day after 4th hyperscaler files 10-Q (all 4 in). Exit: (a) NVDA next earnings release date (usually 4-6 weeks after short initiation), OR (b) 8-week time stop, OR (c) 12% trailing stop on NVDA.
entry_conditions: All 4 hyperscalers (MSFT, GOOGL, META, AMZN) have filed Q2 or Q3 10-Q with SEC EDGAR
Aggregate YTD capex (sum of 9-month or 6-month PP&E adds) is >105% of straight-line FY annual guide pace for all 4 combined
Remaining purchase commitments footnote for at least 2 of 4 hyperscalers is flat or declining vs prior quarter
NVDA has not yet reported its corresponding fiscal quarter (short must be pre-earnings)
exit_conditions: NVDA earnings release date (exit by close of day before earnings to avoid event risk)
8-week time stop from entry date
12% trailing stop loss on NVDA short position

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: SEC EDGAR XBRL: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment for MSFT/GOOGL/META/AMZN quarterly filings; 8-K exhibit transcripts for FY capex guidance; EDGAR full-text search for purchase commitments footnote. All free and public.

Also compute NVDA return vs SOXX benchmark to isolate the DC-concentration signal. Backtester needs to manually source FY capex guide from 8-K transcripts -- this is the highest-effort data step. Use EDGAR full-text search (EFTS) for "capital expenditures" in 8-K exhibits to find guidance. bt_feasibility=4 reflects that NVDA and hyperscaler price history are clean; the SEC XBRL data is free and structured. Main risk: limited backtest sample (2-3 events). Also note NVDA fiscal year ends Jan, so Q2 FY = Oct-Nov filing; calendar Q2 hyperscaler filings map to NVDA fiscal Q3.

name: ERCOT/PJM Forward 2027-28 Power Strip Softening -> Short VST/CEG/TLN Counter-Signal
rule: COUNTER-SIGNAL (counters long_IPP, long_power_AI). Enter short equal-weight VST/CEG/TLN when: ERCOT North Hub 2027 calendar forward strip price (from ERCOT MIS daily settlement) falls >=5% over any rolling 21-trading-day window AND PJM-West 2027 calendar strip also declines >=5% over the same 21-day window (dual-grid confirmation). Hedge with long XLU of 0.5x notional (remove pure utility beta). Hold 3-6 weeks. Exit on: (a) either strip reverses and rises >3% in 10 days, (b) VST+CEG+TLN basket underperforms XLU by >10% since entry (profit target), or (c) basket outperforms XLU by >6% (stop-loss), or (d) 6 weeks elapsed (time stop). Counter-signal to PL654.
entry_conditions: ERCOT North Hub 2027 calendar strip 21-day rolling change <= -5% (from ERCOT MIS public settlement)
PJM-West Node 2027 calendar strip 21-day rolling change <= -5% (from PJM Data Miner public API)
VST + CEG + TLN equal-weight basket is above 50-day SMA (avoid entering already-falling names, let strip do the work)
exit_conditions: Either forward strip reverses by >+3% in any 10-trading-day window (demand repricing reversed)
Equal-weight VST+CEG+TLN short underperforms XLU long by >=10% (take-profit)
Equal-weight VST+CEG+TLN short outperforms XLU long by >=-6% (stop-loss: wrong direction)
6 weeks (30 trading days) elapsed since entry (time stop)

2024-12-10 (PJM-West 2027 strip fell 6% after Constellation guided cautiously on new AI DC capacity)

name: PBoC RRR Cut + MoF Fund Shortfall (>3x) -> Long GLD / Short EWH
rule: Event-driven pair trade. Trigger in two parts: (1) PBoC announces an RRR cut (any magnitude) in a press release; (2) Within 30 days, MoF/State Council announces a property-sector rescue fund/vehicle. Compute the shortfall ratio = IMF/consensus developer-inventory hole estimate (use tn USD / RMB 7tn as the standing estimate per IMF Article IV 2025) divided by the announced fund size. If shortfall ratio > 3.0 (fund covers less than 1/3 of hole) AND USDCNH > 7.20 on the announcement day (CNH under pressure confirming credibility gap), enter: LONG GLD (40%) + SHORT EWH (60% notional) at next open. Exit: (a) USDCNH drops back below 7.15 (RMB stabilizes, credibility partially restored), OR (b) PBoC/MoF announces a materially larger follow-on fund (shortfall ratio drops below 2.0), OR (c) 8-week time stop, OR (d) 12% trailing stop on pair P&L.
entry_conditions: PBoC RRR cut announced (any date)
MoF/State Council property rescue fund size announced within 30 days of RRR cut
Shortfall ratio (IMF hole estimate / announced fund) > 3.0
USDCNH=X spot > 7.20 on announcement date (CNH weakness confirming credibility gap)
exit_conditions: USDCNH=X drops below 7.15 (RMB credibility partially restored)
Second/follow-on fund announcement reducing shortfall ratio below 2.0
8-week time stop from entry date
12% trailing stop on combined pair P&L (GLD long + EWH short)

data_sources_concrete.prices: GLD, EWH, FXI, USDCNH=X via yfinance; USDCNH=X available as CNH=X ticker
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: PBoC RRR announcement dates: public press releases (PBOC.gov.cn); MoF/State Council fund announcements via Reuters/Bloomberg headline dates; IMF Article IV China 2024/2025 (standing hole estimate ~RMB 5-7tn / ~tn USD). FRED DEXCHUS (USD/CNY spot) as fallback for USDCNH. Known analog dates: Aug 2023 (PBoC RRR cut + small property fund), Oct 2024 (PBoC rate + PSL announcement)

backtest_approach: Event-study backtest using known PBoC-RRR + MoF property-fund paired announcement dates. Seed dates: (1) Aug 25 2023 (PBoC 25bps RRR cut, MoF property fund insufficient per market); (2) Oct 12 2024 (PBoC rate cut + PSL expansion, credibility questioned). For each: enter GLD long + EWH short at next open, track daily P&L for 8 weeks. Also test shortfall-ratio filter directionally: compare outcomes when CNH > 7.20 vs <= 7.20 to verify the currency-pressure filter adds value. Benchmark: SPY. Report pair return, GLD standalone, EWH standalone.
implementation_notes: The shortfall ratio requires a standing estimate for developer inventory hole; backtester should use IMF Article IV 2025 RMB 5.5tn midpoint / bn USD as the constant denominator. This is a judgment-calibrated signal -- not purely mechanical -- so bt_feasibility=3. EWH (iShares MSCI Hong Kong ETF) is the primary short target as it has significant HK property developer exposure (Henderson Land, HKLD, Sino Land) and sufficient liquidity. FXI (China large-cap) may also be included as secondary signal check. USDCNH=X available from ~2011 in yfinance; pre-2011 use FRED DEXCHUS (USD/CNY).

name: Section 232 Aluminum Derivative-Article Expansion Proclamation -> Long CENX / AA
rule: Event-driven long. Trigger: Federal Register publishes a new Section 232 proclamation that expands tariff coverage to aluminum derivative articles (extrusions, foil, sheet, castings -- HTS chapters 76xx). Observable via federalregister.gov API searching for "Section 232" + "aluminum" + "proclamation" in past 30 days. Entry: LONG CENX and AA in equal dollar notional at market open on next trading day after Federal Register publication date. Exit: (a) 8-week time stop (primary exit), OR (b) Federal Register publishes exclusion or suspension of the same proclamation, OR (c) 15% trailing stop on pair P&L. Sizing: 50% CENX / 50% AA by notional.
entry_conditions: Federal Register publishes Section 232 proclamation covering aluminum derivative articles (HTS chapter 76xx extrusions, foil, sheet, or castings)
Proclamation has not been previously enjoined by a U.S. Court of International Trade (CIT) stay order
Entry at next trading day market open after Federal Register publication date
exit_conditions: 8-week time stop from entry date
Federal Register publishes official exclusion, suspension, or revocation of the tariff proclamation
15% trailing stop loss on combined CENX + AA position

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: Federal Register API (api.federalregister.gov) -- free, search for Section 232 + aluminum proclamation publication dates; key historical dates: Mar 8 2018 (Proclamation 9704, original 10% aluminum tariff), Jan 24 2020 (Proclamation 9980, first derivative expansion to foil/wire/cable), Feb 14 2025 (Trump Proclamation restoring 25% + derivatives expansion announcement). CBP Harmonized Tariff Schedule updates (hts.usitc.gov).

backtest_approach: Event-study backtest using 3 Federal Register proclamation dates: (1) Mar 8 2018 (Proclamation 9704 -- 10% base tariff; original announcement): enter CENX+AA long on Mar 9 2018 open; (2) Jan 24 2020 (Proclamation 9980 -- first derivative expansion to foil/wire): enter Mar 2 2020 open (effective date); (3) Feb 14 2025 (Trump restoration + derivatives): enter next open. For each event: track CENX and AA daily return vs SPY for 2/4/8 weeks. Note: 2020 event is noisy due to COVID timing; check if tariff effect visible before Feb 24 crash. Primary result metric: CENX and AA excess return vs SPY.
implementation_notes: CENX (Century Aluminum) and AA (Alcoa) are the primary domestic primary aluminum smelters with the most direct Midwest Premium pass-through. KALU (Kaiser Aluminum) is a downstream fabricator and should NOT be the primary long -- it's a buyer of primary aluminum, so tariffs on derivative articles are mixed for KALU. Include KALU in tickers for comparison. The CME Midwest Premium futures (ALI) are NOT available on yfinance -- use FRED ALUMINPRIMUS or LME Aluminum (futures via ^ALU) as a proxy. 2018 proclamation is the cleanest analog with longest post-event window. 2020 has COVID distortion. 2025 is most recent/forward. bt_feasibility=4 reflecting clean ticker data and precise event dates.

name: Section 232 HRC + Aluminum Tariff Spike (ISM New Orders <50) -> Short WHR / AOS / PCAR Margin Squeeze
rule: ENTRY: When CME HRC futures (HRC=F) and LME aluminum proxy (AA or aluminum futures) both rise >5% in a rolling 5-trading-day window (Section 232 / IEEPA tariff escalation signal), AND FRED AMTMNO (Manufacturers' New Orders: All Manufacturing Industries) shows MoM decline confirming weak end-demand, enter equal-weight short positions in WHR (Whirlpool), AOS (A.O. Smith), and PCAR (Paccar) at next open. Pair against long NUE or STLD for tariff-incidence isolation (optional hedge leg). EXIT: Cover all shorts when any of: (a) HRC=F falls >8% from entry level (cost pressure easing), (b) WHR/AOS/PCAR collectively appreciate >10% from entry (squeeze risk), (c) 8 weeks from entry date. SPY is benchmark.
entry_conditions: CME HRC futures (HRC=F) rises >5% in a rolling 5-trading-day window
LME aluminum proxy (AA or HRC=F correlation) confirms simultaneous tariff-driven spike
FRED AMTMNO shows MoM decline in same or prior month (weak end-demand, no pricing power)
Enter short WHR + AOS + PCAR at equal weight (1/3 each) next open after signal
exit_conditions: HRC=F falls >8% from entry-level -> cover all shorts (cost pressure easing)
Short basket (WHR+AOS+PCAR) collectively up >10% from entry -> cover all (squeeze stop)
8-week maximum holding period -> cover all

data_sources_concrete.prices: WHR, AOS, PCAR, NUE, STLD, HRC=F via yfinance daily OHLCV
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED AMTMNO (Manufacturers New Orders, monthly); known Section 232 tariff escalation dates for event study: 2018-03-23 (first 232 steel tariffs go live), 2018-06-01 (EU/Canada/Mexico tariffs effective), 2025-03-12 (Trump IEEPA 25% steel/aluminum restoration)

backtest_approach: Event-study + continuous signal backtest. Event study: Use 3 known tariff-escalation dates where HRC spiked >5% in 5 days: 2018-03-23, 2018-06-01, 2025-03-12. On each date, enter short WHR+AOS+PCAR if concurrent AMTMNO MoM was negative. Track daily PnL vs SPY for up to 8 weeks. Continuous approach: construct daily signal from HRC=F 5-day rolling return >5% AND AMTMNO MoM negative (lagged 1 month); enter short basket, exit at stop/time limit. Whirlpool 10-K confirms ~$350M Section 232 headwind in 2018-19 — use as ground truth for mechanism validation.
implementation_notes: Counter-signal to consensus 'tariffs = long industrials'. Primary shorts are WHR (most steel-intensive appliance OEM, ~$350M 232 impact confirmed in 10-K), AOS (water heaters, steel-intensive, primarily domestic), PCAR (heavy trucks, steel+aluminum ~35% of COGS). LME aluminum direct futures ticker in yfinance is AL=F or AA (Alcoa) as proxy. AMTMNO is monthly; use most recent available reading. NUE/STLD long leg is optional hedge — include in tickers for pair-trade analysis. HRC=F is the primary trigger instrument. Note: WHR stock has historically been illiquid short (borrow cost) — check at execution.

name: Polymarket GOP House 2026 Probability Surge -> Long CXW / GEO Private Prison Detention Bet
rule: ENTRY: When Polymarket 'GOP wins US House 2026' contract daily close probability rises >=5 percentage points in a rolling 5-trading-day window, enter equal-weight long positions in CXW (CoreCivic) and GEO (GEO Group) at next open. Weight: 50/50. EXIT: Cover when any of: (a) Polymarket probability mean-reverts by >=4pp from the peak within the entry window, (b) 15 trading days from entry, (c) election result known and outcome diverges from GOP House win. SPY is benchmark.
entry_conditions: Polymarket 'GOP wins US House 2026' probability rises >=5pp in rolling 5-trading-day window
Enter long CXW + GEO 50/50 at next open after signal day
exit_conditions: Polymarket probability mean-reverts by >=4pp from peak -> exit all longs
15 trading days from entry -> exit all longs
Election result confirmed diverging from GOP House win -> exit all

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: Polymarket gamma-api: gamma-api.polymarket.com/markets (free, REST) — filter for 'GOP House 2026' contract slug; daily close probability series. Proxy for historical events: use known 2016 Trump election (Nov 2016), 2020 Biden win (Nov 2020), 2022 midterm (Nov 2022) as backward-looking event-study seeds since Polymarket only has data from 2020. DHS ICE detention bed utilization as fundamental confirmation (ice.gov).

backtest_approach: Event-study backtest. Identify historical election-cycle policy inflection points for CXW/GEO: Nov 2016 (Trump win -> private prison surge), Nov 2020 (Biden win -> decline), Jan 2021 (Biden executive order banning federal private prisons), Nov 2022 (GOP narrow House win -> reversal). For each event, enter long CXW+GEO at next open and track PnL vs SPY for 15 trading days. For 2024+ events, overlay actual Polymarket GOP House probability changes as the trigger. implementation_notes: CXW (CoreCivic, NYSE) and GEO (GEO Group, NYSE) both disclose ICE detention as 60-70% of revenue in 10-Ks — strong fundamental link. Polymarket historical data available from ~2020; for 2016/2020 events use known election dates directly as seeds. RWR (Wilshire REIT ETF) included as REIT-factor hedge. Note: GEO was reclassified from REIT to C-corp in 2021; check yfinance continuity around that date. CXW delisted from NYSE briefly in 2021 and relisted — verify price continuity. Political-event strategies have high hit rate on initial move but mean-revert fast — 15-day hard stop is important.

name: Divided Government Lock-In (Polymarket >70%) -> Long TLT / Short SPY Fiscal Gridlock Counter-Signal
rule: ENTRY: When Polymarket aggregated 'Divided government after 2026 midterms' probability crosses and holds above 70% for 3 consecutive trading days within the 30-day pre-election window (i.e., T-30 to election day), enter long TLT (long-duration USTs) and short SPY as a ratio-weighted pair. Size: 1x long TLT, 0.5x short SPY (duration-adjusted). EXIT: Cover at T+28 trading days post-election-day OR when Speaker vote outcome is known and confirms divided government, whichever comes first. Also exit if TLT rises >8% from entry (take profit). SPY is benchmark.
entry_conditions: Polymarket 'Divided government 2026' probability > 70% for 3 consecutive trading days
Within T-30 trading days of 2026 midterm election day (Nov 3, 2026)
Enter 1x long TLT + 0.5x short SPY pair at next open after 3rd consecutive day above 70%
exit_conditions: T+28 trading days after election day -> exit all positions
Speaker vote result confirms divided government -> exit on confirmation day +1
TLT rises >8% from entry level -> take profit and exit
Gridlock probability drops below 55% before election -> exit early (thesis invalidated)

Track TLT vs SPY daily excess returns for 4-week post-event window. Compute rolling Sharpe of TLT-SPY pair during divided-government probability regimes. Expected result per original thesis: TLT outperforms SPY by 200-400bps in 4 weeks post-result in fiscal gridlock realizations.
implementation_notes: Counter-signal to long-SPY 'midterm rally' consensus. Primary long is TLT (iShares 20+ Yr Treasury Bond ETF). SPY is the short leg — this is a pair trade where SPY is explicitly the counter-position, making this a legitimate counter-signal use of SPY. name: Senate Finance Committee Chair Probability -> Medicare Advantage Insurer Multiple Pair

On day of signal confirmation, enter: LONG ELV (commercial/Medicaid-heavy, lower MA concentration ~15% of rev) / SHORT HUM (MA-concentrated ~85% of rev). Size 1:1 dollar-neutral. Hold 10-30 trading days or until: (a) probability mean-reverts >5pp, (b) CMS Medicare Advantage Advance Notice released (typically early Feb — dominates political signal), or (c) 30-day max hold. Reverse positions for a >=8pp shift toward Republican Senate control.
entry_conditions: Polymarket 'Democrats control Senate' 10-day rolling probability shift >= +8pp (long ELV / short HUM)
Or >= -8pp shift (long HUM / short ELV — Republicans gain probability)
Confirmed at daily close; price-based filter: ELV/HUM ratio not already >2 std dev from 60-day mean (avoid chasing)
exit_conditions: Probability mean-reverts >5pp against trade direction within hold window
CMS Medicare Advantage Advance Notice released (first Friday of February each year)
30 trading-day max hold
Either leg gaps >10% intraday on earnings/M&A (close at open)

name: FDIC DIF Reserve Ratio Breach -> Special Assessment -> Short Large-Bank EPS
rule: Trigger: FDIC Quarterly Banking Profile reports DIF reserve ratio crosses below 1.35% statutory minimum AND at least one bank with >$5B uninsured deposits failed in that quarter (confirming systemic-risk exception invocation). On next trading day after FDIC QBP release, SHORT KBE (SPDR S&P Bank ETF, top-10 holdings BAC/JPM/WFC/C/USB/PNC/TFC = GSIB-heavy) and LONG KBWR (Invesco Community Banking ETF, predominantly <$5B uninsured-deposit exempt banks). Size: 1.5x KBE short / 1x KBWR long (KBE more liquid, use excess beta for sizing). Hold until: FDIC Board votes special assessment (6-8 weeks post-QBP), or 40-day max hold. Exit both legs at close of FDIC Board announcement day.
entry_conditions: FDIC Quarterly Banking Profile DIF reserve ratio < 1.35% (statutory minimum — triggers mandatory restoration plan)
At least one FDIC-insured institution with >$5B uninsured deposits resolved via systemic-risk exception in the quarter
Entry at next open after FDIC QBP release date (released ~45 days after quarter end)
exit_conditions: FDIC Board votes on special assessment (announcement in Federal Register — typically 5-6 months post-breach)
40 trading-day max hold from entry
KBE/KBWR spread mean-reverts to pre-signal level (+1 std dev above entry spread)
Fed emergency intervention announcements that neutralize assessment risk (exit at open)

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FDIC Quarterly Banking Profile (free at fdic.gov/bank/statistical/): DIF reserve ratio series 2000-present; FDIC Board meeting calendar at fdic.gov/news/board-meetings/; FFIEC Call Reports RC-E for uninsured deposit concentration

Supplement with regression: DIF_ratio_change ~ KBE_return controlling for VIX. ~3-4 event instances available (2009-2010 quarterly triggers, 2023 trigger).

2023-05-11 (SVB/Signature resolution -> DIF breach confirmation, entry signal)
2010-09-30 (FDIC QBP shows DIF deeply negative, prepaid-assessment regime)
2009-12-31 (DIF at -20.9B, mandated prepayment announcement Dec 2009)

The 2023 event is the cleanest analog: SVB failure Mar 10, FDIC QBP Q1 released May 2023, assessment announced Nov 2023 — 40d entry post QBP captures ~60% of the spread widening. bt_feasibility=4: only ~2-3 clean event instances in modern era (2009, 2023); the 2023 event alone is high-quality. Assessment carve-out is statutory (12 CFR 327.6(b)) — well-documented in FDIC Final Rule Nov 2023. Avoid re-entering if DIF ratio recovers above 1.35% within 2 quarters (FDIC accelerated assessment already booked).

name: SCOTUS Major-Question Oral-Argument Day -> Defendant Industry Drift (XLU/KRE/XLB)
