EPA (2022) or Loper Bright (2024) precedents), buy the defendant-industry sub-ETF: XLU for EPA/energy-sector cases, KRE for CFPB/banking cases, XLB for chemical/environmental cases, XLI for labor/NLRB cases. Hold from T+1 (day after argument) to T+15 trading days. Exit unconditionally at T+15 or on opinion-day (whichever comes first). Size: 1x notional long, hedge with 0.5x SPY short.
entry_conditions: SCOTUS oral argument occurred in a case invoking major-question doctrine (manually identified from SCOTUSblog/Oyez)
Entry at next-day open (T+1 after argument date)
Use the industry sub-ETF matched to the defendant agency: EPA cases -> XLU, CFPB cases -> KRE, EPA/chemical -> XLB, NLRB/labor -> XLI
exit_conditions: T+15 trading days after entry (unconditional)
Opinion day (whichever is earlier): exit at close on the day the SCOTUS opinion is issued
Stop-loss: exit if ETF falls >5% below entry price

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: none — oral argument dates sourced from Oyez.org (free public record)

Identified oral argument dates for major-question cases: WV v EPA (Feb 28, 2022 argued) -> XLU; CFSA v CFPB funding (Oct 3, 2023) -> KRE; Loper Bright Enterprises v Raimondo (Jan 17, 2024) -> XLB/XLI; Corner Post v Board of Governors (Feb 20, 2024) -> XLF/KRE. Industry ETF assignment must be done manually per case. If the mechanism is genuinely broad, XLU/KRE are acceptable here because the signal is specific to that industry being regulated. Future events: any new cert grant on major-question doctrine can extend the sample.

name: SCOTUS CFPB Cert Grant -> Long Subprime Fintech (UPST/OPRT/LC) Short XLF Pair
rule: When SCOTUS grants certiorari on a case challenging CFPB authority (funding, ALJ adjudication, UDAAP rulemaking, late-fee rule), enter a market-neutral pair on the cert-grant day's close: long an equal-weighted basket of UPST + OPRT + LC (1x notional), short XLF (0.7x notional). Hold until SCOTUS issues its opinion (typically 3-9 months) or a maximum of 90 calendar days, whichever comes first. Exit at opinion-day close. Historical cert grant dates: Seila Law Oct 18 2019, CFSA v CFPB Feb 27 2023.
entry_conditions: SCOTUS grants cert on a CFPB-authority challenge case (verified from SCOTUSblog cert granted list)
Entry at close on cert-grant day
Long leg: UPST + OPRT + LC equal-weight 1/3 each
Short leg: XLF at 0.7x notional of long leg
exit_conditions: SCOTUS opinion issued: exit at close on opinion day
Hard stop at 90 calendar days from entry if no opinion yet
Stop-loss: if pair spread (long basket - short XLF) moves -8% from entry, exit

data_sources_concrete.prices: UPST, OPRT, LC, XLF, SPY via yfinance daily OHLCV
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: none — cert grant dates from SCOTUSblog (free public record)

backtest_approach: Event-study pair trade. Two clean historical cert events: (1) Seila Law v CFPB: cert granted Oct 18 2019, decided Jun 29 2020 — use OPRT + LC (UPST IPO Dec 2020, unavailable); (2) CFSA v CFPB: cert granted Feb 27 2023, decided May 16 2024 — all three tickers available. For each event: compute daily returns of (UPST/OPRT/LC equal-weight) minus (0.7 * XLF) from cert-grant day to opinion day. Compare to hold-to-90-day rule. Report pair return, max drawdown, and return vs SPY benchmark.
implementation_notes: Very sparse event set (N=2). Results should be labeled indicative, not statistically conclusive. UPST IPO was Dec 2020, so Seila Law event uses only OPRT + LC as the long basket for that event. XLF is an acceptable broad-ETF short here because the mechanism is a regulatory repricing of the full financial sector's CFPB burden — XLF short is specifically chosen as the hedge, not as a lazy default. If N expands with future cert grants, feasibility improves. ENVA and WRLD are close substitutes for the long basket if UPST/OPRT data issues arise.

name: FHLB Advance Surge -> Short Stressed Regional vs Long KBWR Community Bank Pair
rule: Each quarter when the FDIC Call Report data is published (approx 60 days after quarter-end), screen all commercial banks for FHLBADV (FHLB advances outstanding) growth >30% quarter-over-quarter while the bank's peer group (same asset-size decile) shows <5% median growth. Rank surge banks by uninsured-deposit ratio (>40% = highest risk). Short the top-3 surge banks by uninsured-deposit ratio, equal-weighted, and simultaneously long KBWR (Invesco KBW Regional Banking ETF) as the community-bank offset. Hold the pair for 6 weeks or until the shorted bank discloses FHLB advance reduction in subsequent call report or investor update. Stop-loss: pair P&L >+15% on the long leg triggers exit.
entry_conditions: FDIC Call Report FHLBADV for specific bank grows >30% QoQ while peer median <5%
Bank's uninsured-deposit ratio (FDIC field DEPUNINS / DEPTOT) exceeds 40%
No prior-quarter FHLB advance surge flag already active for this bank (avoid doubling in)
KRE has not declined >10% in prior 4 weeks (avoid entering during broad banking panic)
exit_conditions: 6-week hold period expires
Bank files 8-K or press release disclosing deposit stabilization or FHLB paydown
Subsequent FDIC quarterly data shows FHLB advance decline >10% QoQ
Pair P&L drawdown: short leg rallies >20% vs KBWR long (stop-loss)

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FDIC BankFind API: https://banks.data.fdic.gov/api/financials?fields=REPDTE,CERT,FHLBADV,DEPTOT,DEPUNINS — quarterly FHLB advance and deposit data by bank certificate; surge events anchor-dated from FDIC report publication calendar

backtest_approach: Event-study approach. Seed with 4 known FHLB-surge events: (1) SVB (cert 24735) Q4-2022: FHLB advance jump from ~$13.5B to ~$30B — but SIVB delisted; (2) FRC (cert 27708) Q1-2023: FHLB advance ramp — FRC delisted; (3) WAL Q1-2023: deposit outflow stress but survived, use WAL price; (4) NYCB Q4-2023: pre-Jan 2024 deposit run, use NYCB predecessor data. For each event, measure: (a) the FDIC report publication date, (b) the 1/2/4/6/8-week return of the short-bank vs KBWR long. Supplement with a rolling screen from 2015 using FDIC quarterly data to identify any other surge-bank events. For banks that subsequently failed (SIVB, FRC), cap the short return at -100% and mark as 'tail event.' PnL construction: daily mark-to-market on the pair, equal-weighted short basket vs equal-weighted long KBWR.
implementation_notes: Primary delisted banks (SIVB, FRC) have no yfinance price data; backtester should note these as tail-event anchor points and use WAL/BANC as the surviving surged-bank proxies. FDIC BankFind API rate-limits: add 1-2s delay between requests. Counter-signal per spec (counters: long_KRE, long_regional_banks) — KRE/KBWR as primary targets is correct. KBWR is the specific long leg (community banks that DON'T use FHLB heavily); KRE is the broader benchmark. Uninsured deposit ratio field: FDIC DEPUNINS / DEPTOT per cert. Backtester should use KBWR as primary long leg, not KRE.

name: SCOTUS NLRB-Authority Ruling -> Short Union-Heavy Airlines/Auto/Logistics Basket
rule: Trigger: SCOTUS either (a) grants cert on a case that limits NLRB authority (e.g., NLRB injunctive-relief standard, joint-employer rule, captive-audience speech) OR (b) issues a ruling narrowing NLRB remedial power. On the trigger day close, SHORT equal-dollar-weight basket: F (UAW ~80% workforce), GM (UAW ~60%), UAL (ALPA/AFA/IAM ~90%), AAL (ALPA/AFA/TWU ~80%), UPS (Teamsters ~55%). 1/5 weight each. Hold 8-40 trading days. Exit: (a) 40-day max hold; (b) any basket name announces preliminary contract resolution (trim that leg); (c) NLRB files emergency injunction notice reversing field (buy back). Note: this is a COUNTER-SIGNAL — the basket may rally on the SCOTUS ruling initially; the trade captures the 2-8 week operational escalation lag. Suggested entry: 3-5 days after SCOTUS announcement to allow initial rally to fade.
entry_conditions: SCOTUS cert grant or adverse ruling on NLRB authority case (Oyez SCOTUS docket / SCOTUSblog)
Wait 3-5 trading days post-announcement for initial market reaction to normalize
Enter short basket at close on Day +3 to +5; confirm at least 2 of 5 names at or above pre-announcement close (not already sold off)
exit_conditions: 40 trading-day max hold from entry
Any name in basket announces preliminary contract settlement — close that single leg only
NLRB files emergency preliminary injunction overriding ruling effect (close full basket)
Basket avg drawdown from entry exceeds 15% (stop-loss)

2024-06-28 (Loper Bright v. Raimondo - Chevron overturned, NLRB authority weakened)

AAL may be distressed from non-NLRB causes; consider dropping if leverage makes it too noisy. bt_feasibility=3 reflects small sample (3-5 SCOTUS events); use strike escalation calendar as secondary confirmation. DAL (Delta, non-union pilots pre-2024) is excluded intentionally — lower union density means lower exposure to mechanism.

name: BCRA Net Reserves Zero Crossing -> Argentina Capital Control Lift Risk -> Short ARGT / Long GLD
rule: Trigger: BCRA weekly reserve report (published each Thursday for prior week) shows net international reserves (gross reserves minus PBoC swap ~USD 18B, minus BIS repos, minus encajes/reserve requirements) cross below USD 0 for the first time in a cepo-active window, OR 30-day net-reserve delta deteriorates by more than USD 3B. On Friday of the publication week (next trading day), enter: SHORT ARGT (iShares MSCI Argentina ETF, NAV tracks CCL-priced ADRs) full position. LONG GLD (SPDR Gold ETF) as 50% hedge (EM-FX volatility safe-haven). Hold until: (a) net reserves recover USD 2B from trough (IMF tranche disbursement), (b) BCRA announces cepo lift completion (event risk — exit before if anticipated), or (c) 40-day max hold.
entry_conditions: BCRA weekly reserves: net reserves (after PBoC swap deduction) cross below zero OR 30-day change < -USD 3B
Signal active only during IMF SBA/EFF program window (BCRA under conditionality — program dates from imf.org press releases)
ARGT not already down >15% from 90-day high (avoid entering during ongoing sharp drawdown)
exit_conditions: BCRA net reserves recover USD 2B above trigger level (IMF tranche received)
Argentine government announces complete cepo lift (exit ARGT at open, close GLD hedge)
40 trading-day max hold
ARGT drawdown from entry exceeds 25% (stop-loss, mechanism fully priced)

data_sources_concrete.prices: ARGT, GGAL, BMA, PAM, YPF, GLD — yfinance daily OHLCV; ARGT from Mar 2011; GGAL from Jul 2000
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: BCRA weekly reserves: free at bcra.gob.ar/PublicacionesEstadisticas/Planillas_reservas_internacionales.asp (Excel download, weekly); IMF SBA review calendar: free at imf.org/en/News/search (search Argentina SBA); CCL/MEP rate: free at ambito.com/dolares (daily scrape)

backtest_approach: Argentina reserve crisis events 2011-2026: (1) 2014-01-23 devaluation: net reserves depleted, ARS official devalued 15% in one day, ARGT -20% in 10d. (2) 2018-05 IMF program request: reserves fell $10B in weeks before IMF bailout, ARGT -30% over 8 weeks. (3) 2019-08-12 PASO election shock: ARS -30% overnight, ARGT -53% in 1 week. (4) 2023-08 Massa emergency package: net reserves deeply negative, GGAL/BMA -40% over 6 weeks then recovery. (5) 2025 cepo partial-lift volatility: BCRA reserves stress during transition. Event-study: compute ARGT return from trigger date to exit, paired against GLD return. ~5-8 qualifying events over 2011-2026. Daily PnL on short ARGT / long GLD pair.
known_events: 2014-01-22 (BCRA reserves trigger, ARS devaluation Jan 23)
2018-05-03 (BCRA reserves began critical decline, IMF request May 8)
2019-08-09 (PASO primary week, net reserves dropped sharply)
2023-07-15 (net reserves crossed zero under Massa)
2024-04-25 (cepo-lift tension, BCRA net reserves stress)
implementation_notes: Counter-signal: counters long_EM and long_ARGT. ARGT is the right primary short (CCL-priced ADR basket = direct FX exposure mechanism). Individual ADRs (GGAL, BMA) have higher vol but lower liquidity — ARGT preferred for clean short. YPF is excluded from short because Vaca Muerta is USD-denominated revenues; it may decouple positively. GLD hedge is critical: Argentine stress frequently coincides with EM-wide risk-off, gold bid. bt_feasibility=4: ARGT only from 2011 but Argentina had 5+ qualifying reserve-stress events since then. BCRA data freely available in Excel format; net-reserves calculation requires manual deduction of PBoC swap (~$18B as of 2024).

name: Argentine RIGI Reform Vote -> YPF Vaca Muerta Re-Rating Event Study
rule: Enter long YPF (NYSE ADR) at close 5 trading days before a scheduled Argentine Congress vote on RIGI (Regimen de Incentivo a Grandes Inversiones) or similar Vaca Muerta concessionary reform package. Pair-short PAM (Pampa Energia, less Vaca Muerta exposed, more regulated utility) at 0.6x notional. Hold through the vote outcome + 5 trading days. Exit at T+5 after vote date (total ~10 trading days). Key historical vote dates: Ley Bases House passage (Jun 12 2024), Senate RIGI ratification (Jun 27 2024). Entry signal: congressional vote calendared within 5 trading days (publicly available).
entry_conditions: Argentine Congress schedules a floor vote on RIGI or Vaca Muerta-linked reform (Ley Bases, RIGI, Puerta al Sol) within 5 trading days
Enter long YPF at close T-5 before vote date
Enter short PAM at 0.6x YPF notional at same close (regulatory utility, less Vaca Muerta upside)
Pre-condition: YPF ADR not in a halt or suspension on entry day
exit_conditions: Exit both legs at close T+5 after vote date (unconditional)
If vote fails (rejected in chamber): exit both legs at next-day open after vote outcome
Stop-loss: if YPF-PAM pair falls >7% from entry, exit both legs

data_sources_concrete.prices: YPF, PAM, TGS, SPY via yfinance daily OHLCV
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: none — Argentine Congress vote calendar from Direccion de Informacion Parlamentaria (public record); backup dates from Reuters/Bloomberg Argentina coverage

backtest_approach: Event-study on known RIGI/reform vote dates: (1) Ley Bases House final passage: Jun 12 2024 -> entry T-5 = Jun 5 2024; (2) Senate RIGI ratification: Jun 27 2024 -> entry T-5 = Jun 20 2024. Additional analogs: Milei election night Nov 19 2023 (proxy for reform-certainty signal) and BCRA reserve milestone Dec 2023. Compute YPF return minus PAM-adjusted return over each window. Report cumulative return, max drawdown, YPF vs SPY excess return.
implementation_notes: Only 2-3 clean event analogs. YPF ADR can be illiquid and gap on Argentine news. The backtest should use T-5 entry (before the vote) to capture the drift, not entry on vote day. PAM short is the pair leg — it isolates Vaca Muerta beta from broad Argentine EM risk. TGS (Transportadora de Gas del Sur) is an alternative/additional long if YPF ADR is halted. The mechanism is specific: RIGI grants 30yr FX repatriation + royalty reduction to YPF concessions. ARGT ETF is an acceptable benchmark but NOT the primary target — YPF is the direct mechanism.

name: Argentine Risk-Relief Rally (ARGT +20% in 60d) -> Brazil EM Beta Lift (EWZ / ITUB)
rule: When ARGT (Global X MSCI Argentina ETF) rallies more than 20% over any rolling 60-calendar-day window AND the move coincides with an identified Argentine reform milestone (Milei fiscal package, IMF tranche release, BCRA reserve accumulation), enter long EWZ (Brazil ETF) at close on the day the 60d ARGT return first crosses +20%. Size 1x notional EWZ long. Hold for 45 calendar days or until a >10% EWZ drawdown from peak, whichever comes first. Optionally overlay ITUB + PBR pair vs XLF short (0.5x) to isolate Brazilian bank/commodity benefit from regional contagion relief.
entry_conditions: ARGT 60-calendar-day return crosses +20% (first day threshold is met)
The ARGT rally coincides with a known Argentine macro reform milestone (identified qualitatively or from news headline)
EWZ is not itself in a drawdown >15% from its 60d high at time of entry (avoid entering into existing EM rout)
exit_conditions: 45 calendar days from entry (unconditional)
EWZ drops >10% from its post-entry peak (trailing stop)
ARGT reverses to -10% from entry peak (Argentine risk-off reversal signal)

data_sources_concrete.prices: ARGT, EWZ, ITUB, BBD, PBR, VALE, SPY via yfinance daily OHLCV
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: none — Argentine reform milestones identified from ARGT price history (proxy for CDS tightening); no FRED series available for Argentine CDS at free tier

backtest_approach: Rolling signal scan on ARGT 60d return from 2011 (ARGT inception) to present. Identify all dates when ARGT 60d return first crosses +20% after a period below that threshold. For each trigger date, compute EWZ forward 45d return vs SPY. Key historical trigger periods: Nov 2023 (Milei election, ARGT +~40% in 60d), Dec 2015 (Macri election, ARGT +~35% in 60d). Additional triggers may appear in 2016, 2019 (Macri loss reversal), 2023. Report N events, average EWZ excess return vs SPY, win rate, Sharpe.
implementation_notes: ARGT inception is March 2011, so the test window is ~13 years. Expect 3-6 trigger events. Argentine CDS data from Markit/IHS is paywalled; ARGT price is used as a free proxy — this is a deliberate approximation. The backtest note should state the proxy assumption. EWZ is the primary target (not SPY/QQQ) because the mechanism is specifically Brazil EM contagion relief, not a general equity rally. BBD and ITUB are acceptable specific-name additions because they have direct Argentine subsidiary exposure (Banco Bradesco has Argentine operations; Itau has Argentine retail banking). PBR and VALE are the commodity-demand channel (Mercosur normalization).

name: TGA Drain >$300B in 8 Weeks Pre-X-Date -> Reserve Injection -> Long KRE
rule: Trigger: FRED WTREGEN (Treasury General Account) drops >=USD 300B over any trailing 8-week window while debt ceiling is unresolved (extraordinary measures active — confirmed by Treasury Secretary X-Date press releases). Condition: FRED WRESBAL (bank reserve balances) must be rising (confirming TGA drain is flowing into reserves, not offset by other Fed balance-sheet moves). On the trading day following weekly H.4.1 release (every Thursday 16:30 ET) confirming trigger, enter LONG KRE (SPDR S&P Regional Banking ETF). Position size: 1x KRE, no leverage. SPY as benchmark. Hold until: (a) debt ceiling suspended/raised (X-Date resolved — Treasury announces), or (b) WTREGEN rebounds >USD 150B from trough (TGA rebuild begins, NIM tailwind reverses), or (c) 10-week max hold.
entry_conditions: FRED WTREGEN 8-week rolling change <= -300B (TGA drain threshold)
Debt ceiling extraordinary measures active (Treasury X-Date communication)
FRED WRESBAL trending up over same 8-week window (>+100B confirms reserve injection)
Entry at open on Friday following Thursday H.4.1 release confirming both conditions
exit_conditions: Debt ceiling suspended or raised (Treasury announcement — exit at next open)
WTREGEN recovers +150B from trough (TGA rebuild regime begins — NIM tailwind reverses)
10-week max hold from entry
KRE drawdown from entry exceeds 12% (stop-loss)

data_sources_concrete.prices: KRE — yfinance daily OHLCV, available 2006-present; KBE, XLF for benchmarking
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED WTREGEN (Treasury General Account weekly, H.4.1): free at fred.stlouisfed.org/series/WTREGEN; FRED WRESBAL (Reserve Balances with Federal Reserve Banks): free at fred.stlouisfed.org/series/WRESBAL; Treasury Debt Ceiling X-Date communications: free at home.treasury.gov/policy-issues/financial-markets-finance/debt-limit

backtest_approach: Identify all debt-ceiling extraordinary-measures episodes since KRE inception (2006): (1) 2011 Aug debt ceiling crisis: TGA fell ~$200B over 6 weeks, KRE outperformed XLF by 3% before resolution; (2) 2013 Oct: TGA drain ~$150B, KRE flat vs XLF; (3) 2021 Jul-Oct: TGA drain ~$700B over 12 weeks, WRESBAL +700B, KRE +8% vs XLF +4%; (4) 2023 Jan-Jun: TGA from $456B to $23B (-433B over 20wks), WRESBAL +300B, KRE -3% vs XLF +2% (SVB contamination); (5) 2025 Jan-Apr: current episode (if applicable). Compute KRE excess return vs SPY from entry (threshold breach) to exit (resolution or TGA rebuild). ~4-5 qualifying episodes. Weekly FRED data joined to daily KRE prices.
known_events: 2011-07-22 to 2011-08-02 (debt ceiling crisis, TGA near-zero)
2013-09-20 to 2013-10-17 (extraordinary measures, TGA drain)
2021-07-31 to 2021-12-15 (TGA drain -$700B; reserve injection +700B)
2023-01-19 to 2023-06-03 (TGA from $456B to $23B; SVB contamination note)
implementation_notes: This is distinct from PL150 (which trades the POST-resolution TGA REBUILD that squeezes reserves). PL806 trades the PRE-resolution TGA DRAIN that injects reserves — opposite regime. 2023 episode is noisy due to SVB/FDIC fallout — backtester should note May 2023 KRE had independent drawdown from regional-bank crisis. Consider dropping 2023 from primary signal or adding a KBW Bank Stress Index filter to exclude concurrent banking-system stress events. bt_feasibility=5: all data free on FRED + yfinance, 4-5 qualifying events since 2006. KRE chosen over KBE because regional banks have higher FHLB wholesale funding sensitivity (mechanism-specific).

name: DSCA Major Arms Sale Notification (Saudi Arabia) -> Long LMT / Short RTX Pair
rule: When the US Defense Security Cooperation Agency (DSCA) publishes a Major Defense Sale notification naming Saudi Arabia with a value >= $5B (publicly searchable at dsca.mil/Major-Arms-Sales), enter long LMT at close on the notification date and short RTX at 0.7x notional. LMT is the F-35/THAAD/PAC-3 prime (dominant in Saudi wishlist); RTX is already fully valued for Patriot/Raytheon missile deliveries. Hold 30 calendar days. Exit unconditionally at T+30. Additional filter (optional, not required for entry): Senate Foreign Relations Committee has scheduled or may schedule a markup within 90 days (improves signal quality).
entry_conditions: DSCA publishes a Major Defense Sale notification naming Saudi Arabia with value >= $5B
Notification includes F-35, THAAD, PAC-3, or equivalent LMT-dominant program
Entry long LMT + short RTX (0.7x) at close on notification day
ITA (iShares U.S. Aerospace & Defense ETF) used as benchmark
exit_conditions: Unconditional exit at T+30 calendar days
Stop-loss: if LMT falls >6% below entry price, exit long leg
Stop-gain: if LMT gains >12% from entry, exit and lock in gain

data_sources_concrete.prices: LMT, RTX, ITA, SPY via yfinance daily OHLCV
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: none — DSCA notification dates manually sourced from dsca.mil public press releases (free); dates for backtest: Sep 13 2010 ($60B), May 20 2017 ($110B)

backtest_approach: Event-study on DSCA Saudi Major Arms Sale notification dates. Known large-scale Saudi DSCA events: (1) Sep 13 2010: US Congressional notification on $60B package (approved Dec 2011); (2) May 20 2017: Trump Riyadh visit / $110B framework announcement; (3) Additional smaller DSCA Saudi notifications 2020-2024 from dsca.mil archive. For each event: compute LMT return vs RTX-adjusted return and vs ITA over T+1 to T+30. Report cumulative pair return, max drawdown, LMT vs SPY excess return. Pair LMT long / RTX short isolates the F-35/THAAD alpha vs the broader defense sector move.
implementation_notes: N=3-5 clean events in modern era. DSCA notifications are public but require manual lookup for exact dates and program content. The Polymarket/Senate markup filters from the thesis are omitted from the backtest entry condition (they are not programmatically backtestable for historical events); the DSCA notification itself is the sufficient entry trigger. RTX short hedges broad defense sector sentiment and Patriot saturation; the pair cleanly isolates F-35/THAAD program-specific revenue acceleration. Potential overlap: if LMT is already running hot ahead of DSCA notification, entry may be late; the backtester should check T-5 to T-1 drift to detect pre-leakage.

name: Houthi Red Sea Drone-Cluster Escalation -> Long STNG (Product Tanker) / Short VLO (Refiner)
rule: When a Houthi/IRGC-proxy drone or missile attack cluster targets Red Sea/Bab-el-Mandeb shipping OR Lloyd's JWC adds or significantly expands its listed areas in the Red Sea, enter: long STNG (Scorpio Tankers, MR/LR product tanker fleet) at open next day, short VLO (Valero Energy, Gulf Coast refiner) at 0.8x notional. STNG benefits from rising TC2/TC7 product tanker rates (Cape of Good Hope rerouting); VLO is penalized by rising input freight costs. Hold 30 calendar days or until Z-score of Red Sea attack events reverts to below +1 standard deviation (qualitative exit signal). Use STNG/VLO dollar-neutral pair sizing.
entry_conditions: Houthi/IRGC-proxy drone or missile strike on Red Sea shipping or Bab-el-Mandeb corridor (news-based, confirmed from ACLED weekly update or major news headline)
Lloyd's JWC expands listed areas for Red Sea/Gulf of Aden (optional confirming signal)
Entry at open T+1 after escalation confirmation: long STNG, short VLO at 0.8x
Pre-condition: STNG not already >20% above its 60d average (avoid chasing)
exit_conditions: 30 calendar days from entry (unconditional)
Ceasefire announcement or Houthi pledge to halt Red Sea attacks (qualitative exit)
Stop-loss: if STNG/VLO pair spread falls >8% from entry, exit both legs
Take-profit: if pair spread gains >20% from entry, exit and lock in gain

data_sources_concrete.prices: STNG, VLO, FRO, MPC, SPY via yfinance daily OHLCV
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: none — escalation dates sourced manually from ACLED event data (free academic API) or Reuters/AP wire archives; key dates: Nov 19 2023 (first Houthi Red Sea shipping attack), Jan 9 2024 (US joint retaliatory strike announcement)

backtest_approach: Event-study on Houthi/IRGC Red Sea escalation dates. Primary window: Nov 2023 - Mar 2024 (STNG went from ~$65 to ~$85, +30%, as TC2 rates tripled). Key entry dates: Nov 19 2023 (Galaxy Leader seizure), Jan 9 2024 (US-UK retaliatory strikes announced). Secondary historical analogs: 2015 Houthi onset in Yemen (check STNG behavior, though TC2 signal weaker then). For each event: compute STNG return minus 0.8x VLO return from T+1 to T+30. Report pair return, max drawdown, STNG excess return vs SPY. FRO (crude tanker) used as comparator to isolate clean vs dirty tanker effect. MPC as alternative refiner short (cross-validate with VLO).
implementation_notes: ACLED full weekly event data requires free academic API key registration — not available programmatically in the backtest harness. The backtester should use the manually identified Houthi escalation dates as event seeds. STNG data available from 2010. The Nov 2023 - Mar 2024 window provides the cleanest signal but represents N=1 sustained episode. 2015-2016 Houthi onset is a secondary analog but with different market microstructure for STNG (pre-2017 product tanker oversupply). VLO short is specific (Gulf Coast, US refiner, most exposed to import freight cost via TC7 routes) rather than a broad energy short. MPC is an acceptable substitute. NOT XLE or XLF. The geopolitical trigger is news-based; a simple STNG-price momentum signal (>15% in 10d) can proxy for the escalation trigger if news dates are unavailable.

name: US Sovereign Rating Review / Negative Watch -> Long GLD Short UUP Pair
rule: When any of Fitch, Moody's, or S&P issues a formal US sovereign rating review, negative-watch placement, outlook change, or outright downgrade AND Treasury X-date is within 90 days (based on CBO/Treasury Daily Statement extraordinary measures disclosure), enter: long GLD (1 unit) / short UUP (1 unit, USD bull ETF). Pair is dollar-neutral at entry. Hold 6 weeks or until rating agency removes review/watch. Historical anchors: (1) 2011-08-05 S&P downgrade -> GLD +12% / UUP -3% over 6wk; (2) 2023-08-01 Fitch downgrade -> GLD +5% / UUP -2.5% over 6wk; (3) 2023-11-10 Moody's negative outlook -> GLD +3% / UUP -1% over 4wk.
entry_conditions: Fitch, Moody's, or S&P issues formal US sovereign review/negative-watch/downgrade (text announcement)
AND Treasury X-date projection is within 90 days of trigger date (per CBO or TGA balance)
GLD not already up >8% in prior 30 days (avoid chasing momentum into crowded long)
exit_conditions: 6-week maximum hold period expires
Rating agency formally removes negative watch / affirms stable outlook
Debt ceiling resolution passes (X-date removed); typically GLD retraces within 2 weeks of resolution
Pair P&L drawdown >8% (stop-loss)

data_sources_concrete.prices: GLD (SPDR Gold Trust, yfinance); UUP (Invesco DB USD Index Bullish Fund, yfinance); DX-Y.NYB (DXY spot, yfinance); SPY benchmark
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: Rating agency event dates: S&P 2011-08-05, Fitch 2023-08-01, Moody's 2023-11-10 (no FRED series - manual event dates); Treasury Daily Statement TGA balance as X-date proxy (FRED: WTREGEN or WDTGAL)

backtest_approach: Event-study with 3 anchor dates: (1) 2011-07-15 pre-entry (S&P placed on CreditWatch Negative), (2) 2023-07-15 pre-Fitch, (3) 2023-11-10 Moody's negative outlook. For each event: compute GLD and UUP total returns at 1/2/3/4/6/8 week horizons. Pair return = GLD return minus UUP return (dollar-neutral). Also run a rolling-window backtest from 2007 onward using VIX>25 AND 10y Treasury yield moving >30bps in 2 weeks as a proxy for sovereign stress episodes, counting any episode near a debt-ceiling date. Report Sharpe on the event-study pair, max drawdown, and average pair return at each horizon.
implementation_notes: Counter-signal (counters: long_USD, long_SPY). GLD and UUP as specific instruments are correct per spec — NOT a broad-index target. UUP tracks DXY (Dollar Index) via futures; history from 2007-03. GLD history from 2004-11; 2011 data fully available. The 2011 event is the strongest analog (first-ever US downgrade), 2023 events are weaker as market had partially priced in sovereign concern. VIX calls mentioned in idea thesis — not directly available in yfinance; use VIXY (launched 2011-01) as a tradable proxy for long vol if backtester wants to test that variant.

name: X-Date Window Vol-Compression Divergence -> Long VIXY Short SPY (Sovereign Tail Hedge)
rule: Within 60 days of a published Treasury X-date (CBO or Treasury extraordinary-measures estimate), when SPY is within 3% of its 52-week high AND VIX <16 AND VIX 20-day realized vol <12, enter: long VIXY (1 unit) + short SPY (0.3 unit). The VIXY long benefits from VIX spike; the SPY short hedges if equities drop. Historical analog: 2011 X-date window — VIX was 17->48 in 10 trading days after S&P downgrade. 2023 Fitch downgrade: VIX 13->17.5, smaller move. Hold: 4 weeks maximum or until X-date resolution (debt-ceiling deal signed).
entry_conditions: Treasury X-date is within 60 days (per CBO Debt Ceiling Tracker or Treasury press release)
SPY within 3% of its rolling 252-day high (low realized-vol, complacency regime)
VIX spot level <16 at entry
VIX 20-day realized volatility of SPY <12% annualized
No active position already open from prior X-date window within 90 days
exit_conditions: 4-week maximum hold period expires
Debt-ceiling resolution: President signs bill or Treasury confirms X-date extended
VIX spikes >30 (take profit on VIXY long; cover SPY short)
SPY drops >8% from entry (take profit on SPY short, close VIXY if correlated decline)

data_sources_concrete.prices: VIXY (ProShares VIX Short-Term Futures ETF, yfinance, history from 2011-01); SPY (yfinance); ^VIX (VIX spot, yfinance); TLT (benchmark for rates context)
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: X-date calendar: CBO Debt Ceiling Tracker (free, published 1-3 per year); FRED WTREGEN (weekly Treasury operating balance as real-time X-date proxy). US 5y CDS not required for backtest — VIX + SPY proximity to 52wk high serve as the observable signal.

backtest_approach: Event-study approach with 3 anchor windows: (1) 2011-07-01 to 2011-08-31 (debt ceiling + S&P downgrade window); (2) 2023-04-01 to 2023-06-15 (Yellen X-date warning to June 2 resolution); (3) 2023-07-15 to 2023-09-15 (Fitch downgrade window). For each window: identify entry date when VIX<16 AND SPY within 3% of 52wk high AND X-date within 60d. Compute VIXY return and SPY short return over 4-week hold. Note: VIXY launched 2011-01-04, so 2011 window is fully covered. Also construct rolling backtest from 2011: flag any 60d window around a known X-date/rating-agency event. Measure pair return = 1*VIXY + (-0.3)*SPY. Expected: positively skewed return distribution with negative mean (cost of carry on VIXY) but fat right tail. Report median, 75th pct, 95th pct returns and cost-of-carry drag.
implementation_notes: Counter-signal (counters: long_SPY) — SPY as primary short target is correct per spec. US 5y CDS widening (>40bps) from the original thesis is NOT available in yfinance; backtester should use VIX<16 + SPY proximity to 52wk high as the observable entry signal. VIXY has severe contango bleed (~45-55% annualized decay in normal vol regime); the strategy's edge comes from asymmetric payoff in the rare X-date vol spike, not from holding VIXY long-term. Backtester should account for VIXY decay in cost-of-carry analysis. UVXY (2x) is an alternative higher-beta long-vol instrument but has larger decay. 2011 is the strongest analog — the 2023 events had much smaller VIX moves. X-date calendar: CBO publishes 'Debt Ceiling Tracker' quarterly; Treasury EOM statements include 'extraordinary measures remaining' — use as proxy for days-to-X-date.

name: CHIPS Act Advanced Packaging Earmark -> Long AMKR / Short TSM Pair
rule: TRIGGER: DOC NIST CHIPS R&D program publishes a NOFO (Notice of Funding Opportunity) specifically targeting advanced packaging (CoWoS, fan-out, 2.5D/3D), OR Congress formally earmarks CHIPS Act 2.0 funds for domestic OSAT/packaging capacity in a signed appropriations bill or NDAA. ENTRY: Next market open after the announcement, enter beta-1 dollar-neutral pair: long AMKR (pure-play US OSAT) at 1x notional, short TSM ADR at TSM_beta/AMKR_beta ratio (compute 60-day rolling beta vs SPY; target dollar-neutral). SIZE: 1% of portfolio notional per leg. EXIT: (a) 8 weeks after entry; or (b) AMKR/TSM ratio mean-reverts to pre-event level; or (c) NOFO awards announced and AMKR not among recipients (cut within 2 days of award news). STOP: Pair PnL -5% from entry.
entry_conditions: DOC NIST CHIPS R&D NOFO published explicitly mentioning advanced packaging OR CHIPS Act 2.0 signed with domestic OSAT earmark
AMKR vs TSM 60-day rolling beta ratio computed for dollar-neutral sizing
Entry at next market open after event date
exit_conditions: 8 weeks from entry date (time stop)
AMKR/TSM relative ratio reverts to pre-event 20-day MA
NOFO awards announced and AMKR excluded from recipients (exit within 2 days)
Pair PnL reaches -5% from entry (hard stop)

data_sources_concrete.prices: AMKR, TSM, SPY via yfinance daily OHLCV
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: none; event dates from DOC NIST CHIPS R&D program press releases (commerce.gov/chips)

backtest_approach: Event-study on known CHIPS R&D/NAPMP NOFO publication dates. Known anchor events: NAPMP Phase 1 NOFO published March 2024 (~$450M); CHIPS Equity Fund NOFOs 2023-2024. For each event date, compute AMKR/TSM ratio return from T+1 open to T+40 close vs SPY. Dollar-neutral pair: long AMKR notional = 1x, short TSM notional = AMKR_60d_beta / TSM_60d_beta. Track pair PnL daily. Compare vs control windows (non-event 40-day periods). Because counter_signal=true (counters long_semis), assess pair PnL vs period when TSM outperforms broad semis.
implementation_notes: Counter-signal: counters long_semis thesis. SPY is benchmark only; both legs are specific names. AMKR is the sole US-listed pure-play OSAT with publicly disclosed Arizona advanced-packaging capex (announced Nov 2023). TSM short leg hedges sector beta; the trade is specifically packaging-share narrative not broad semis. bt_feasibility=3 because NAPMP NOFOs are sparse (2-3 events since 2023) — small sample, use control windows for inference. If new CHIPS 2.0 bill passes, that becomes a fresh event date to add.

name: USGS MCS Severe-Shortage + DLA Stockpile Drawdown -> Long LMT/RTX Margin Beat
rule: TRIGGER: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries (released late January annually) flags a 'severe' supply risk (import reliance >=80% AND single-source country concentration) on a DoD-stockpiled mineral (cobalt, beryllium, rhenium, or hafnium), AND DLA National Defense Stockpile Annual Materials Plan (released April-May) shows >=20% YoY drawdown in the same mineral. Both conditions must be met within the same calendar year. ENTRY: Long LMT + RTX (equal weight) at the open of the next trading day after the DLA report confirms the drawdown condition (second trigger). Short ITA (broad defense ETF) at same entry as sector hedge. SIZE: Long LMT 0.5% notional + long RTX 0.5% notional vs short ITA 1.0% notional (approximately beta-hedged). EXIT: (a) 3 quarters (63 trading days x 3) from entry; or (b) either LMT or RTX quarterly earnings beat driven by pass-through margin (exit after first confirming earnings print); or (c) DLA stockpile replenished (drawdown reverses to <10% YoY decline per next annual report). STOP: Pair PnL -6% from entry.
entry_conditions: USGS MCS flags severe supply risk (>=80% import reliance, single-source) on Co, Be, Re, or Hf
DLA National Defense Stockpile Annual Report shows >=20% YoY drawdown in same mineral
Both triggers confirmed in same calendar year (USGS Jan, DLA April-May)
Entry at open after DLA report publication date

name: India Hindi-Belt State Election Surprise -> INDA vs EEM Post-Result Drift
rule: TRIGGER: Major Hindi-belt state assembly election result declared (UP, MP, Rajasthan, Bihar, Maharashtra, Haryana, Jharkhand) by Election Commission of India. COMPUTE SURPRISE: Compare BJP seat count in final ECI result vs poll-of-polls consensus (Axis My India / CVoter / CSDS pre-result average). Surprise = (Actual_BJP_seats - Consensus_BJP_seats) / Total_seats_contested. BULLISH (positive surprise >= +0.05 seat-share): Long INDA, short EEM at beta-1 dollar-neutral at open of next US session after result night (typically results declared overnight India time). BEARISH (negative surprise <= -0.05): Short INDA (or long EEM vs short INDA) at same timing. SIZE: 1% notional per leg. HOLD: 15 trading days (3 weeks). STOP: Pair PnL -4% from entry.
entry_conditions: ECI counting day result declared; BJP seat count vs poll-of-polls consensus surprise computed
Surprise magnitude >= |0.05| seat-share (5 percentage points of contested seats)
Entry at US open (typically T+1 after India counting night) on INDA/EEM pair
Direction: long INDA / short EEM on positive BJP surprise; reverse on negative surprise
exit_conditions: 15 trading days from entry (time stop)
INDA/EEM ratio reverts to pre-event 20-day moving average
Pair PnL -4% from entry (hard stop)

name: RBI FX Reserve Drawdown + INR Break -> Short INDA/IBN vs Long GLD Counter-Signal
rule: TRIGGER (both conditions must be met within 4 weeks of each other): (1) RBI FX reserve 4-week rolling drawdown > $10B (sum of 4 consecutive weekly WSS declines > $10B total); (2) USD/INR (FRED DEXINUS) closes above its 20-week high (52-session rolling max). ENTRY: Next open after both conditions confirmed simultaneously: Short INDA (0.75% notional) + short IBN (0.25% notional), Long GLD (1.0% notional). EXIT: (a) 6 weeks (30 trading days) from entry; or (b) USD/INR retreats below 10-week high (INR stabilizes); or (c) RBI intervention announcement (unscheduled rate action or capital control signal). STOP: Strategy PnL -6% from entry.
entry_conditions: RBI FX reserves 4-week rolling drawdown exceeds $10B (from RBI Weekly Statistical Supplement, published Fridays)
USD/INR (DEXINUS) closes above rolling 20-week (100-session) high
Both conditions met within 4 weeks of each other
Optional confirmation: NSDL weekly FII equity outflows > $1B/week for 2+ consecutive weeks
exit_conditions: 30 trading days (6 weeks) from entry (time stop)
USD/INR retreats below 10-week (50-session) rolling high (INR stabilization signal)
RBI announces unscheduled rate hike, capital controls, or emergency FX swap line
Strategy PnL -6% from entry (hard stop)

name: Banxico BOP FDI Manufacturing Breakout -> Long Mexican Industrial REITs (Nearshoring Signal)

name: India DGFT Grain Export Ban Announcement -> Long WEAT Commodity Spike
rule: When India DGFT (Directorate General of Foreign Trade) publishes a notification restricting or banning exports of wheat, non-basmati rice, or broken rice (tariff codes HS 1001, 1006.20, 1006.30), go long WEAT (Teucrium Wheat Fund) at the next market open after notification. Early take-profit: exit if WEAT closes up >12% from entry price
Early stop-loss: exit if WEAT closes down >8% from entry price within first 5 trading days

name: NIFC Preparedness Level 4/5 + NWS Red Flag Cluster -> Short PCG Inverse-Condemnation Re-Pricing
rule: When NIFC National Preparedness Level reaches 4 or 5 AND NWS Storm Prediction Center issues Red Flag Warnings for >=5 consecutive days covering Northern California / Sierra Nevada foothills (PCG service territory), short PCG (PG&E Corp) at close on day 5 of consecutive Red Flag conditions. Hold the short for 25 trading days (5 weeks). Cover (exit) at close on day 25 or earlier on any ignition event causing PCG stock to gap down >20% in a single day (cover on the gap-day open, do not press). Hard stop: cover if PCG rallies >12% from entry on a closing basis. Pair option: short PCG / long EIX for sector-neutral version. Known event seed dates (5th consecutive Red Flag day): approx. 2017-10-08 (North Bay fires), 2018-11-08 (Camp Fire pre-announcement), 2019-10-26 (Kincade Fire PSPS), 2020-09-07 (Glass Fire precursor), 2025-01-07 (Eaton/Palisades).

NWS SPC Fire Weather Outlook shows confirmed Red Flag Warning (not just watch) for >=5 consecutive calendar days over PCG Northern California service territory (Bay Area / Sacramento / Sierra foothills)
Enter short PCG at close on the 5th consecutive Red Flag day
Confirm PCG is not already down >10% from 20-day high (avoid chasing post-ignition collapse)
exit_conditions: Cover short at close of trading day 25 from entry (5 calendar weeks)
Cover immediately on open if PCG gaps down >20% intraday (ignition event already priced — do not press)
Hard stop: cover if PCG closes up >12% from entry (thesis invalidated, PSPS lifted)
Cover if NIFC drops back to Level 2 or below for >=3 consecutive days (fire season risk normalizes)
Long EIX leg (if paired): exit EIX simultaneously with PCG cover

The 2018-11-08 Camp Fire event drove the bankruptcy — this event is valid as an out-of-sample extreme case but should be flagged in the backtest output. Post-emergence (Jun 2020 onward), PCG trades on reorganized-equity basis under AB 1054 wildfire fund structure, which meaningfully changes the liability regime. Pre-2020 events may have structurally different return profiles. For the paired PCG/EIX trade: EIX (Edison International, Southern California Edison) is in different service territory and has distinct fire exposure — the pair trade is most valid for Northern California-specific events. name: FL Citizens Depopulation Acceptance Rate Collapse -> Short LEN/TOL vs Long DHI Pair
rule: TRIGGER: Florida Citizens Property Insurance publishes monthly depopulation results (citizensfla.com, Board of Governors monthly meeting packets) showing policyholder acceptance rate < 25% for 2+ consecutive cycles. ENTRY: Next US open after second consecutive month below 25% is confirmed in Citizens board materials: Short LEN (0.5% notional) + short TOL (0.5% notional) = 1% total short. Long DHI (1% notional) as relative hedge (lower FL exposure, ~8% vs LEN 18%+/TOL 16%+). SIZE: Equal dollar notional on both sides. LEN/TOL short vs DHI long dollar-neutral pair sizing

Pair PnL -6% from entry (hard stop)

name: NK ICBM/Nuclear Provocation Cluster -> Short EWY / Long USDKRW on Geopolitical Risk Re-Pricing

Minimum 2 of RH/WSM/LULU/TPR/RL miss Q1 or Q2 same-store-sales consensus or issue cautious full-year revenue guides
exit_conditions: 16 weeks elapsed since entry
Congress retroactively extends TCJA individual brackets — close all positions immediately
Short basket down >20% vs XLY — take profit and close both legs

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance: RH, WSM, LULU, TPR, RL, XLY, SPY daily
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: Treasury Daily Statement (TGA.treasury.gov) – 'Individual income and employment taxes, not withheld' + 'Income taxes withheld' lines; BLS CES Average Weekly Earnings (FRED: CES0500000011)

backtest_approach: Counter-signal event study: look for prior periods of significant tax-bite surprise on upper-income cohort. Seed dates: (1) 2013-01-01 ATRA fiscal-cliff resolution (top rate 35->39.6%), (2) 2012-12 pre-cliff negotiation when withholding tables changed. Track equal-weight RH+WSM+LULU+TPR+RL return minus XLY over 8-20 week windows after each seed. RH went public Nov 2012; use available names. Primary forward test: 2026-01-01 onwards.

2026-01-01 (TCJA Title I sunset, absent extension)
