RH IPO Nov 2012, LULU listed 2007, WSM listed long-term, RL listed long-term, TPR (then Coach) listed long-term. In 2013 event, can use: WSM, LULU, RL, TPR (Coach). RH available from Nov 2012. The 2026 event is the primary thesis and will be a forward walk.

name: Opportunity Zone Renewal Legislative Markup: Long REXR/TRNO vs Short IYR (OZ-Exposed Industrial REIT)
rule: When (1) Congress advances TCJA-related real estate tax provisions (monitor via Senate Finance Committee schedule — use news proxy: REXR or TRNO 5-day return > +3% on above-average volume as institutional pre-positioning signal) AND (2) REXR and TRNO both outperform IYR (broad REIT ETF) by >=3pp over the same 10-day window, enter: long equal-weight REXR+TRNO, short IYR. Notional: equal-dollar. Hold 30 trading days or until spread compresses -5% from entry. Take profit if REXR+TRNO basket outperforms IYR by +10%.
entry_conditions: REXR 5-day return > +3% on volume >= 1.5x 30-day avg (institutional pre-positioning proxy for OZ tax news)
TRNO 5-day return > +3% on volume >= 1.5x 30-day avg
REXR+TRNO equal-weight 10-day return outperforms IYR 10-day return by >= 3pp
exit_conditions: Equal-weight (REXR+TRNO) outperforms IYR by +10% cumulative from entry (take profit)
30 trading days elapsed since entry (time stop)
Spread compresses: IYR outperforms REXR+TRNO by -5% from peak (stop loss)

data_sources_concrete.prices: REXR, TRNO, IYR, VNQ, SPY via yfinance daily OHLCV
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: none — OZ legislative event cannot be systematically scraped from free sources; use REXR/TRNO price-volume breakout as proxy signal

backtest_approach: Rolling price-volume event study from 2018-01-01 (post-TCJA OZ program launch). On each day, compute REXR 5-day return, TRNO 5-day return, IYR 5-day return, volume ratios. Flag qualifying entry days. Construct long equal-weight REXR+TRNO / short IYR spread, record 30-day forward excess return. Key analog dates: 2019-04-17 (Treasury OZ Reg finalization), 2020-02 (OZ extension via SECURE Act), 2021-01 (OZ reform proposals), 2022-09 (Inflation Reduction Act energy OZ provisions), 2026-12 (potential OZ 2.0 expiry/renewal). REXR available from 2013; TRNO from 2010 — enough history for 10+ analog periods.
known_events: 2018-12-12: TCJA OZ final designations — industrial REIT breakout
2019-04-17: Treasury OZ final regulations release
2020-01-01: SECURE Act OZ deadline extension
2022-08-16: IRA energy community OZ bonus credits signed
implementation_notes: FNCO (mentioned in original idea) does not trade on yfinance — replaced with IYR (iShares US Real Estate) as the broad REIT benchmark hedge. REXR and TRNO are Sunbelt/industrial-focused REITs with documented OZ-census-tract property exposure. The legislative catalyst cannot be automated — treat as price-triggered breakout on high-volume days. bt_feasibility=3 because true OZ-specific events are few; price-momentum proxy broadens the signal set. Backtester should note this is a catalyst-type strategy: high hit rate near legislative dates, noise otherwise.

name: Panama Canal Slot Auction Premium Spike: Long MATX (Jones-Act Pacific Monopoly Beneficiary)
rule: When ACP daily slot auctions report supplementary clearing prices > $500,000 (proxy: SCFI Asia-USEC spot rate monthly index rises > 15% in 4 weeks), enter long MATX. Use SCFI/FBX data as leading indicator — when Asia-USEC all-water rates spike (implying Panama Canal diversion), MATX CLX+ express yields expand and Jones-Act Hawaii/Alaska pricing power increases. Hold 25 trading days. Take profit if MATX gains +20% from entry; stop if MATX loses -10% from entry.
entry_conditions: MATX 20-day trailing return > 0% (not in downtrend)
ZIM 20-day trailing return > +15% (proxy for ocean freight rate spike from Panama congestion; ZIM is global container carrier sensitive to SCFI rates)
SPY 20-day return > -5% (avoid buying into broad market selloff)
exit_conditions: MATX gains +20% from entry (take profit)
25 trading days elapsed (time stop)
MATX loses -10% from entry (stop loss)
ZIM 10-day return drops below -15% (freight rate reversal, thesis broken)

data_sources_concrete.prices: MATX, ZIM, SPY via yfinance daily OHLCV; MATX available from 1973 (very long history); ZIM available from 2021-01-28
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: none — SCFI/FBX freight rate indices are not freely available via yfinance; use ZIM price as proxy for freight rate conditions

backtest_approach: Rolling event study from 2021-02-01 (ZIM availability) using ZIM as Panama/SCFI freight rate proxy. On each day, compute ZIM 20-day return and MATX 20-day return. Flag entry days meeting conditions. Record MATX 25-day forward return. Primary analog: Aug-Dec 2023 Panama Canal drought (Gatun Lake fell to record lows, ACP cut slots from 36 to ~22/day, supplementary auction prices spiked to $2M+; MATX went from ~$72 to ~$128 in 6 months). Secondary analog: 2021 Suez Canal blockage (MATX benefited from global container dislocation). For pre-ZIM history (2015-2020), use FBX monthly index correlates or HarpexIndex proxy if available.
known_events: 2023-08-01: ACP begins slot reductions — Gatun Lake at 82ft declining
2023-11-01: ACP maximum congestion — slots reduced to 22/day
2024-01-15: ACP slot auction prices peak ~$2M/slot
2024-04-01: Gatun Lake recovery begins — drought ends
2021-03-23: Suez Canal blockage (Ever Given) — secondary freight rate analog
implementation_notes: MATX is the cleanest single-name for this trade — it is the only Jones-Act expedited Pacific carrier with both Hawaii domestic exposure (inelastic demand) and China-USEC express service (direct Panama Canal reroute beneficiary). ZIM is used as a real-time freight rate proxy because SCFI is not in yfinance; this introduces noise but is the best free-data solution. HMM (Korean shipping) delisted from yfinance in 2018 — do not use. Consider adding SBLK (dry bulk) as secondary confirmation if available. bt_feasibility=4 because the 2023-24 Panama drought is a clean analog with excellent price data.

name: Black Sea War-Risk Spike → ADM Long / BG Short Pair
rule: When Lloyd's JWC lists or significantly expands the Black Sea as a Joint War Committee area AND hull/cargo war-risk premia for Odessa/Pivdennyi/Chornomorsk exceed 5% of insured value (proxied by shipping-press / Reuters/Bloomberg coverage of Lloyd's JWC actions dated ≥ that week), enter long ADM / short BG in a 1:1 dollar-neutral pair. Hold for 6 weeks or until either: (a) war-risk premia normalize below 1.5% (JWC narrows), (b) 15% adverse move on the spread (stop loss), or (c) 20% favorable spread widening (take profit). Use quarterly earnings blackout windows to avoid reporting risk — avoid entering within 5 days of ADM or BG scheduled earnings dates.
entry_conditions: Lloyd's JWC publishes Black Sea area listing or materially expands coverage (observable via Reuters/Lloyd's bulletins)
Marine hull war-risk premia for Black Sea grain ports exceed 5% of insured value (sourced from shipping press, Marsh/Ascot quotes)
Ukrainian seaborne grain export tonnage has fallen ≥20% MoM vs. prior 3-month average (Ukrainian Ministry of Agrarian Policy data or proxy via USDA WASDE Ukraine export revision)
ADM-BG 30-day relative return spread is within ±5% (not already extended)
exit_conditions: Lloyd's JWC narrows or removes Black Sea listing (de-escalation event)
War-risk premia fall below 1.5% (sourced from same press coverage)
6-week maximum hold elapsed
Spread moves adversely ≥15% (stop loss)
Spread moves favorably ≥20% (take profit)

data_sources_concrete.prices: ADM, BG, SPY via yfinance daily OHLCV
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: USDA WASDE Ukraine export revisions (free PDF release, monthly); Lloyd's JWC bulletins (free public press releases)

backtest_approach: Event-study approach seeded by historical Lloyd's JWC Black Sea listing dates. Known JWC Black Sea listing events: Feb 2022 (Russia invasion), subsequent expansions Nov 2022, Jul 2023 (Grain Deal collapse). For each event date T, construct ADM/BG dollar-neutral return spread over T+1 to T+42 (6 weeks). Track spread daily, apply stop/take-profit logic at 15%/20% thresholds. Benchmark: compare ADM-BG spread return vs. SPY-neutral basis. At least 2-3 usable analog events from 2022-2023 exist. Supplement with USDA WASDE Ukraine export revision dates as secondary signal confirmation.
implementation_notes: War-risk premium data (5% threshold) is NOT directly available via FRED or yfinance — backtester must use Lloyd's JWC listing/expansion dates as the observable proxy trigger (publicly announced, dateable). ADM's Constanta terminal acquisition was 2022-2024, so pre-2022 analog may understate current ADM advantage. Liquidity on BG is adequate (avg vol ~1M shares/day); ADM is similar. USDA WASDE Ukraine export revisions are a confirmatory signal only — not the primary trigger. bt_feasibility=3 because the event set is small (2-3 distinct JWC escalation events since 2022).

name: Red Sea Houthi Ceasefire → Short War-Risk Reinsurers (RNR/AXS)
rule: This is a COUNTER-SIGNAL to existing long reinsurer positions in the catalog. When ACLED Red Sea / Bab-el-Mandeb maritime incident count drops ≥75% over a rolling 60-day window vs. the prior 60-day peak AND Suez Canal Authority (SCA) monthly transits recover to ≥70% of pre-Nov-2023 baseline (proxy: Suez transit data from SCA or Lloyd's shipping analytics), enter SHORT RNR and AXS in equal dollar weight, long PGR and TRV as hedge (personal/auto lines insulated from marine). Hold for 8 weeks or until: (a) transit recovery stalls <50% baseline for 2 consecutive weeks (thesis broken), (b) 10% adverse spread move (stop), or (c) 15% favorable spread compression (take profit). De-risk before January 1 reinsurance renewal window (Dec 15 – Jan 10) — Lloyd's renewal pricing is the key catalyst.
entry_conditions: ACLED Bab-el-Mandeb / Southern Red Sea maritime attacks: 60-day rolling count ≤25% of prior 60-day peak
Suez Canal Authority monthly transits ≥70% of pre-Nov-2023 baseline (proxy: SCA monthly data or shipping press reports)
Lloyd's JWC has narrowed or is formally reviewing Southern Red Sea listed area designation
RNR and AXS 12-month trailing P/E both above 12x (hard-market multiple still embedded — mean-reversion potential)
exit_conditions: Suez transit recovery stalls (<50% pre-Nov baseline for 2 consecutive weeks)
New major Houthi attack on commercial vessel resumes >5 incidents/month
Lloyd's JWC re-lists or expands Southern Red Sea (escalation reversal)
8-week maximum hold elapsed
Spread moves adversely ≥10% (stop loss)
Spread moves favorably ≥15% (take profit)

data_sources_concrete.prices: RNR, AXS, PGR, TRV, SPY via yfinance daily OHLCV
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: ACLED maritime events database (free public download); SCA transit data (free monthly bulletin at suezcanal.gov.eg)

backtest_approach: Event-study approach seeded by historical Red Sea de-escalation episodes. Primary analog: shipping press announced early 2024 ceasefire rumors and JWC narrowing discussions (multiple ~2-4 week windows). Also usable: pre-Nov 2023 period (baseline normal) compared to post-escalation — construct short RNR/AXS vs. long PGR/TRV spread behavior across the Nov 2023 escalation onset and any subsequent partial de-escalation windows. This is partially a structural short thesis: if the hard-market tailwind from war-risk normalizes, compare RNR/AXS forward P/E vs. PGR/TRV across 2023-2025. Daily returns on 4 tickers; form equal-weight short (RNR+AXS) vs. equal-weight long (PGR+TRV). Track excess return vs. SPY for benchmark-neutral analysis. bt_feasibility=4 because the base period (pre-Nov 2023 / post-Nov 2023) provides a viable structural comparison even if event dates are limited.
implementation_notes: This is explicitly a COUNTER-SIGNAL to existing long reinsurer signals (PL123, PL240, PL714, PL781, PL820). Backtester should note correlation with those signals — this runs as a hedge/counter position. ACLED data requires download (free but not API-streamable); proxy via shipping press headlines for trigger. RNR and AXS have adequate liquidity (daily vol >500K shares each). The hard-market multiple normalization thesis is structural; even without full Suez recovery, EPS estimate cuts at January renewal season can drive underperformance. PGR/TRV hedge chosen because they benefit from continued high auto/personal-lines rates — decoupled from marine war-risk.

name: SNB-Fed Rate Gap >250bps + EUR/CHF <0.93 – Long FXF / Short EWL Pair
rule: ENTRY: When (a) Fed Funds upper target minus SNB policy rate >250bps, AND (b) EUR/CHF weekly close <0.93, AND (c) SNB sight deposits (weekly) expanding at >CHF 5B/week for at least 2 consecutive weeks (intervention active), THEN go long FXF and short EWL with 1.5:1 notional (long FXF : short EWL). EXIT: Close when SNB sight-deposit weekly growth rate drops to <CHF 1B for 2 consecutive weeks (intervention fatigue), or after 6 weeks, or when Fed cut cycle begins (first 25bp cut after the entry date) — whichever comes first.
entry_conditions: Fed Funds upper target (FRED: DFEDTARU) minus SNB 3-month LIBOR target midpoint (FRED: IRSTCB01CHM156N) > 250 bps
EUR/CHF (EURCHF=X) weekly close below 0.93
SNB weekly sight deposits (SNB.ch statistical data) expanding >CHF 5B/week for 2+ consecutive weeks
exit_conditions: SNB sight-deposit weekly growth <CHF 1B for 2 consecutive weeks (intervention fatigue signal)
6 weeks elapsed since entry
Fed delivers first rate cut post-entry (25bp or more)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance: FXF, EWL, EURCHF=X, SPY daily
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED: DFEDTARU (Fed upper target), IRSTCB01CHM156N (SNB policy rate); SNB.ch weekly sight-deposit release (SNB Statistical Data Portal, table snb_sight_deposits)

backtest_approach: Event-study on SNB intervention episodes: (1) Sep 2011 CHF cap introduction (EUR/CHF floor at 1.20), (2) Jan 2015 SNB cap removal (inverse, but documents FXF sensitivity), (3) 2022 SNB surprise hike + intervention reversal. For each episode, track FXF cumulative return minus EWL over 2-6 week windows starting from the documented sight-deposit expansion trigger date. Rate-gap trigger best satisfied in 2022-23 period; use 2022 episode as primary backtest seed.
known_events: 2011-09-06 (SNB sets EUR/CHF 1.20 floor, sight deposits surge)
2022-06-16 (SNB surprise 50bp hike + intervention; sight deposits begin declining)
implementation_notes: WCS data is unavailable on free yfinance; this strategy relies on EURCHF=X and FRED for trigger, not WCS. SNB sight deposit data is free weekly from SNB.ch but requires HTTP scrape or manual download — backtester should use FRED SNBRESM027NCHF (SNB total reserves as proxy) if direct sight-deposit series is unavailable. bt_feasibility=4 because only 2-3 clean analog dates exist.

name: BoC-Fed Gap >100bps + WCS Discount >$20 – Long UUP / Short EWC Counter-Signal
rule: ENTRY (counter-signal vs long_SPY): When ALL of: (a) Fed Funds upper target minus BoC overnight rate >100bps, (b) WCS-WTI differential < -$20/bbl on 4-week MA (use WCS proxy: XEG.TO underperformance vs XLE), (c) CAD=X (USD/CAD) above 1.38 (loonie weakening), AND (d) SPY is in uptrend (SPY 20d MA > 50d MA — counter-signal fires only when US narrative is still bullish), THEN go long UUP and short EWC at 1.5:1 notional. EXIT: Cover at the earlier of (a) 10 weeks, (b) BoC hike closes gap below 100bps, (c) WCS-WTI discount narrows above -$15, or (d) EWC down >12% vs UUP (take profit).
entry_conditions: Fed Funds upper target (FRED: DFEDTARU) minus BoC overnight rate (FRED: IRSTCB01CAM156N) > 100 bps
WCS-WTI proxy: XEG.TO 4-week return minus XLE 4-week return < -5% (proxies for WCS discount widening relative to WTI)
CAD=X (USD per CAD, inverted) above 1.38 — loonie in weakening regime
SPY 20-day MA > 50-day MA — US narrative still bullish (counter-signal diagnostic)
exit_conditions: 10 weeks elapsed since entry
BoC rate hike closes Fed-BoC gap below 100 bps
CAD=X drops back below 1.33 (CAD restrengthens, thesis invalidated)
EWC down >12% vs UUP (take profit)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance: UUP, EWC, CAD=X, XEG.TO, XLE, SPY daily
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED: DFEDTARU (Fed upper target), IRSTCB01CAM156N (BoC overnight rate); EIA WTI weekly spot (FRED: DCOILWTICO)

backtest_approach: Counter-signal event study: seed dates when Fed-BoC gap crossed +100bps while SPY was trending up: (1) mid-2023 (BoC paused at 5.0%, Fed at 5.25-5.5%), (2) 2015 (BoC cut to 0.5% while Fed on hold). Track equal-weight UUP long + EWC short excess return vs SPY over 4-10 week windows after each trigger date. For 2015 event: EWC and UUP have sufficient history. Use FRED IRSTCB01CAM156N for BoC rate history.
known_events: 2023-07-12 (BoC final hike; Fed-BoC gap at peak after BoC paused)
2015-07-15 (BoC second emergency cut; gap widens as Fed preparing liftoff)
implementation_notes: This is a counter_signal (counters: long_SPY); UUP/EWC pair as primary targets is correct. True WCS price data (Western Canadian Select) not freely available on yfinance — use XEG.TO vs XLE relative performance as a proxy for WCS-WTI differential (both are strongly correlated). StatCan household debt-service ratio is quarterly with ~3-month lag; too slow for entry trigger — excluded from entry conditions. bt_feasibility=4 due to limited analog dates.

name: NAR Affordability <70 + First-Time Buyer Collapse – Short UWMC/RKT Originator Pair vs Long MBB
rule: ENTRY: Go short equal-weight UWMC + RKT and long MBB at 2:1 notional (short originators : long MBB) when ALL of: (a) NAR Housing Affordability Composite Index (FRED: COMPHAI) most recent monthly print <70, (b) MBA Weekly Applications purchase-app YoY <-15% for 3 consecutive weeks, (c) MBA purchase/total apps share >85% (refi effectively extinct), AND (d) FHLMC primary-secondary spread (PMMS rate minus current-coupon MBS yield) is compressing (widening spread = GoS margin pressure). EXIT: Cover at the earlier of (a) 12 weeks, (b) NAR HAI rebounds above 80, (c) Fed cuts rates 50bp+ (refi-wave catalyst, exit short originators), or (d) UWMC+RKT down >25% vs MBB on pair basis (take profit).
entry_conditions: NAR Housing Affordability Composite Index (FRED: COMPHAI) monthly print <70
MBA Weekly Purchase Applications YoY < -15% for 3 consecutive weeks (Bloomberg/MBA.org source)
MBA purchase-app share of total applications >85% (refi-extinct regime)
FHLMC PMMS 30-year rate minus current-coupon MBS par yield (primary-secondary spread) widening on 4-week trend
exit_conditions: 12 weeks elapsed since entry
NAR HAI rebounds above 80 (affordability recovering)
FOMC cuts 50bp or more (refi-wave catalysts; short-originator thesis inverted)
UWMC+RKT pair down >25% vs MBB (take profit)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance: UWMC, RKT, MBB, SPY daily
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED: COMPHAI (NAR Affordability Index), MORTGAGE30US (PMMS rate), RRVRUSQ156N (rental vacancy); MBA Weekly Applications (mortgage bankers association, requires subscription or public summary)

backtest_approach: Event-study on NAR HAI troughs: seed dates when COMPHAI fell below 70 or historically comparable affordability stress: (1) 2022 Q3–Q4 (COMPHAI approached historical lows ~80s range as rates surged — use threshold proxy), (2) 2006-2007 (pre-GFC trough, but UWMC/RKT not yet public — use surrogate LEND or sector ETF IAK). Primary backtest: 2022 rate-shock period. Track UWMC+RKT equal-weight return minus MBB over 4-12 week windows. Note: both UWMC (IPO 2020) and RKT (IPO Aug 2020) have history from 2020 onwards only.
known_events: 2022-06-15 (FOMC 75bp hike; mortgage rates above 6%; affordability trough begins)
2022-10-27 (NAR HAI lowest reading; purchase apps near 25-year lows)
implementation_notes: bt_feasibility=3: Both UWMC and RKT IPO'd in 2020; only ~2 years of trading history for the 2022 affordability cycle. Single-event backtest with very limited history — treat as primarily forward-looking/structural thesis. LEND (LendingTree) could extend history to 2014 but mechanism differs (lead-gen vs originator). NAR HAI data is FRED COMPHAI (monthly, free). Primary-secondary spread calculation requires PMMS + MBS pricing data.

name: Census HVS Rental Vacancy YoY Surge + Multifamily Glut – Short CPT/MAA vs Long EQR Coastal Pair
rule: ENTRY (counter-signal vs long_multifamily_reits): When ALL of: (a) Census HVS rental vacancy rate YoY change >+100bps for 2 consecutive quarters (FRED: RRVRUSQ156N), (b) Census 5+ unit completions rolling 4-quarter sum >1.5x 10-year average (FRED: COMPU5MUSA), AND (c) Zillow ZORI national YoY rent growth turns negative or < +1%, THEN go short equal-weight CPT + MAA and long EQR at 1.5:1 notional (short Sun-Belt : long coastal EQR). EXIT at the earlier of (a) 18 weeks, (b) HVS vacancy rate YoY improvement to <+50bps, or (c) CPT+MAA pair down >20% vs EQR (take profit).
entry_conditions: FRED RRVRUSQ156N (rental vacancy rate) YoY change >+100bps for 2 consecutive quarterly readings
FRED COMPU5MUSA (5+ unit completions, monthly SAAR) rolling 4-quarter sum > 1.5x the trailing 10-year average
Zillow ZORI national rent index YoY growth <+1% (approx: ZRI monthly data from Zillow Research)
exit_conditions: 18 weeks elapsed since entry
HVS rental vacancy YoY improvement returns to <+50bps (supply absorption underway)
5+ unit completions rollover below 1.2x 10-year average (pipeline tightening)
CPT+MAA pair down >20% vs EQR (take profit)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance: CPT, MAA, EQR, AVB, SPY daily
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED: RRVRUSQ156N (rental vacancy rate, quarterly), COMPU5MUSA (5+ unit completions, monthly SAAR); Zillow Research: ZORI national data (free CSV download at zillow.com/research/data)

backtest_approach: Event-study on multifamily supply glut episodes: (1) 2015-2016 (Sun-Belt supply surge; RRVRUSQ156N vacancy rose from 7.1% to 7.7% by Q4 2016), (2) 2023-2025 (current episode: vacancy rising again as completions peak). For each period, track CPT+MAA equal-weight return minus EQR over 8-20 week windows. CPT has history from 1993, MAA from 1994, EQR from 1993 — all have full history for both episodes.
known_events: 2016-Q1 (HVS rental vacancy rate peak; Sun-Belt completions surge)
2024-Q1 (Sun-Belt completions at historical peak; vacancy rate rising YoY)
implementation_notes: This is a counter_signal (counters: long_multifamily_reits, long_homebuilders); CPT/MAA as short targets is correct. AVB included in tickers list for potential use as supplemental short or for correlation analysis. Zillow ZORI is free but requires HTTP download; FRED RRVRUSQ156N is the cleanest free vacancy proxy. bt_feasibility=4 because all tickers have 25+ year histories and 2 analog periods exist.

name: RBA-Fed Rate Gap Narrowing + Iron-Ore Stable → Long EWA
rule: When the Fed-RBA policy rate differential (DFEDTARU minus IR3TIB01AUM156N on FRED) falls below +150bps from a prior peak above +150bps (i.e., gap is narrowing), AND CFTC AUD non-commercial net positioning is ≤ -40,000 contracts (net short extreme, weekly CFTC COT data), AND iron-ore 62%Fe SGX is above $100/t (proxy: Australian Bureau of Statistics or Trading Economics monthly), enter LONG EWA and LONG AUDUSD=X. Exit after 6 weeks OR when gap narrows to within +50bps of Fed rate OR if AUDUSD appreciates >7% (take profit) OR if AUDUSD depreciates >3% from entry (stop loss).
entry_conditions: FRED DFEDTARU minus IR3TIB01AUM156N (RBA cash rate) was above +150bps and is now narrowing (most recent monthly diff < prior month diff AND prior diff > +150bps)
CFTC IMM AUD net non-commercial position ≤ -40,000 contracts (weekly COT, free at cftc.gov)
Iron-ore 62%Fe SGX price above $100/t (proxy via monthly ABS mineral prices or Reuters spot quote)
exit_conditions: Fed-RBA gap narrows to within +50bps (rate differential nearly closed)
AUDUSD=X appreciates ≥7% from entry (take profit)
AUDUSD=X depreciates ≥3% from entry (stop loss)
6-week maximum hold elapsed
CFTC AUD net positioning swings to net long +20,000 contracts (short squeeze complete)

data_sources_concrete.prices: EWA, FXA, AUDUSD=X via yfinance daily OHLCV; SPY as benchmark
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED IR3TIB01AUM156N (RBA 3M interbank rate, monthly proxy for cash rate); FRED DFEDTARU (Fed funds target upper, daily); CFTC COT Legacy Report AUD futures (free weekly, cftc.gov)

backtest_approach: Event-study seeded by historical Fed-RBA gap peak-and-turn dates. Identifiable historical analogs: (1) 2015-2016: Fed hiking while RBA cut; gap narrowing on subsequent RBA pause. (2) 2018-2019: Fed paused then cut (pivot); RBA lag-cut followed. (3) 2022-2023: Fed hiked aggressively; RBA hiked less; gap peaked ~2023 Q2 at +150bps. For each gap-peak-and-turn event, track EWA return and AUDUSD=X return from T+1 to T+42 (6 weeks). Filter each entry by CFTC AUD positioning ≤-40k contracts to ensure positioning-driven squeeze dynamics. Benchmark: EWA return vs. SPY on a USD basis. At least 3-4 usable analog windows exist from 2015-2024.
implementation_notes: IR3TIB01AUM156N is the FRED series for Australia 3-month interbank rate (close proxy for RBA cash rate target). It is monthly frequency — use lagged monthly reading for signal calculation. CFTC COT AUD positioning is weekly — can be obtained free from cftc.gov legacy reports. Iron-ore price is NOT available on FRED; proxy via SCO=F yfinance (SGX iron ore futures, may have data gaps) or use monthly ABS commodity price index. For backtest feasibility, assume iron-ore >$100 as a binary filter using spot price approximation from quarterly USGS/ABS data. EWA has good liquidity (avg vol >1M USD/day). FXA included in tickers as a pure AUD/USD hedge leg for dollar-neutral construction if needed.

name: MBA Purchase 5-Year Low + Rate Lock-In >300bps → Short Homebuilders
rule: This is a COUNTER-SIGNAL to existing long-homebuilder signals in the catalog. When: (1) FRED MORTGAGE30US (30Y PMMS) is above 7.0%, AND (2) FRED MORTGAGE30US minus a reasonable proxy for outstanding coupon (use 4.0% as fixed threshold representing the avg outstanding mortgage coupon as of 2022-2024) exceeds 300bps (i.e., >3%), AND (3) FRED HSN1F (new home sales, monthly, seasonally adjusted) falls to its lowest reading in 5 years (60-month rolling minimum), enter SHORT ITB (homebuilder ETF) and/or short equal-weight DHI and LEN (highest spec exposure), long PHM and NVR as partial hedge (lower incentive intensity). Primary target: short ITB. Exit after 8 weeks OR when MORTGAGE30US falls below 6.5% (affordability relief) OR HSN1F recovers >10% from the 5-year-low print (thesis broken) OR ITB position gains ≥20% (take profit) OR ITB position loses ≥10% (stop loss).
entry_conditions: FRED MORTGAGE30US (Freddie Mac 30Y PMMS, weekly) ≥ 7.0% for 8+ consecutive weeks
Rate lock-in gap: MORTGAGE30US minus 4.0% (proxy avg outstanding coupon) ≥ 3.0% (300bps) — this is automatic when MORTGAGE30US ≥ 7.0% given the 4% threshold
FRED HSN1F (new home sales, seasonally adjusted annual rate) is at a 5-year (60-month) rolling minimum
No existing short signal on homebuilders already active in the portfolio
exit_conditions: FRED MORTGAGE30US falls below 6.5% (affordability improving, thesis weakens)
FRED HSN1F recovers more than 10% above the 5-year-low print
ITB short gains ≥20% from entry (take profit)
ITB short loses ≥10% from entry (stop loss)
8-week maximum hold elapsed

data_sources_concrete.prices: ITB, XHB, DHI, LEN, PHM, NVR, SPY via yfinance daily OHLCV
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED MORTGAGE30US (Freddie Mac Primary Mortgage Market Survey 30Y fixed, weekly); FRED HSN1F (new single-family home sales, monthly seasonally adjusted); FRED HOUST (housing starts, monthly, secondary confirmation)

backtest_approach: Signal-based daily backtest using FRED data to construct entry dates. MORTGAGE30US is available weekly on FRED from 1971; HSN1F is monthly. Identify all historical weeks where MORTGAGE30US ≥ 7.0% AND HSN1F is at a 5-year rolling minimum. Primary identifiable windows: (1) 2023 H2: MORTGAGE30US peaked near 8%, new home sales collapsed to 2023 lows. (2) 2018-2019: MORTGAGE30US briefly above 5% (lower bar, but lock-in gap was different). Most relevant analog is 2022-2023 given the 7%+ threshold. For each qualifying entry date, track ITB short return from T+1 to T+56 (8 weeks). Compare ITB short return vs. SPY as benchmark. Track stop/take-profit at 10%/20% thresholds. Counter-signal note: correlate with PL041, PL070, etc. long signals to measure pair-trade dynamics.
implementation_notes: This is explicitly a COUNTER-SIGNAL to catalog long-homebuilder signals: PL041, PL070, PL106, PL140, PL147, PL170, PL415, PL466, PL675, PL677. The 4.0% outstanding coupon proxy is a simplification — actual FHFA NMDB average coupon is not on FRED as a clean series. Use 4.0% as a fixed threshold for the lock-in gap calculation in the backtest. The MORTGAGE30US ≥ 7.0% threshold alone captures the lock-in dynamic given the 4% proxy. MBA Weekly Purchase Application index (actual trigger) is NOT available on FRED free tier — use HSN1F (new home sales monthly) as the demand-destruction proxy. HSN1F may lag MBA purchase index by 2-4 weeks; note this as timing caveat. DHI and LEN are the primary short targets within the sector; ITB/XHB provides cleaner execution. NVR is included as a long hedge leg (asset-light model, less spec inventory exposure).

name: 45V Treasury Final-Rule Policy Relaxation -> Long APD + CMI Pair
rule: Event trigger: Federal Register publication of 45V final rule (IRS/Treasury). Score relaxation index on 3 pillars: +1 if temporal-matching extended to annual (>=24 mo deferral from 2028), +1 if ERCOT treated as single deliverability zone, +1 if pre-2024 PPAs grandfathered. If score >= 2: Enter long APD + long CMI pair at next open after rule text is parseable (same-day Federal Register XML). Size equal-dollar APD:CMI 60:40 weighting (APD has larger H2 revenue exposure). Hedge 20% of notional short SPY. Exit after 16 weeks or when APD/CMI combined excess return vs SPY exceeds +15%, whichever is first. Stop-loss: exit if combined position loses 8% vs SPY within 4 weeks. Backtest anchor dates: 2022-07-27 (IRA Senate reconciliation vote, confirmed positive H2 policy), 2023-10-13 (DOE H2Hub interim awards). Negative control: 2023-12-22 (45V NPRM with restrictive three-pillar language) should show negative excess returns.
entry_conditions: Federal Register XML for 45V final rule is published (search federalregister.gov/documents API for document_number matching IRS-2023-XXXX, type=rule)
Relaxation score >= 2 (temporal-matching deferred >=24mo AND/OR ERCOT single-zone AND/OR pre-2024 PPA grandfathering)
Enter at next market open after rule text confirms relaxation score
exit_conditions: Holding period reaches 16 weeks (112 calendar days)
APD + CMI combined excess return vs SPY exceeds +15%
Stop-loss: combined position underperforms SPY by 8% within first 4 weeks
Negative rule event: if final rule is MORE restrictive (score <= 0), do not enter or reverse existing position

data_sources_concrete.prices: APD, CMI, LIN, PLUG, SPY via yfinance daily OHLCV
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: none (event-driven; Federal Register XML is free at federalregister.gov/api/v1/documents)

backtest_approach: Event study with 2 known anchor dates: (1) 2022-07-27 IRA Senate reconciliation vote (positive H2 policy pass) - primary analog for permissive rule relaxation; (2) 2023-10-13 DOE H2Hub interim awards. Negative control: 2023-12-22 (45V NPRM restrictive). For each anchor date, measure APD/CMI 60:40 pair return minus SPY over t+5, t+20, t+60 windows. Construct equal-dollar APD:CMI long pair, short 20% SPY. Report event-study CAR (cumulative abnormal return) table. Signal strength rule: backtest validates if CAR(t+20) > 0 in both positive anchor dates AND CAR(t+20) < 0 in negative control.
implementation_notes: The 45V final rule is a one-time dateable event; this strategy is forward-looking but backtested on 2 confirmed analogs. APD has the deepest on-site H2 contract pipeline (Neom, La Porte, Massena); CMI Accelera is the only US-listed industrial with credible PEM electrolyzer order book. LIN is included for correlation analysis. PLUG is a negative-sentiment gauge (cash-burning pure-play). If the final rule has already been published before backtest execution, use the actual publication date as the primary test event. Per spec: APD/CMI are the specific-name targets (not SOXX, not XLE); broad-basket ETFs avoided per developer rules.

name: GLP-1 Impulse-Control Spillover → Short DKNG/PENN Gambling Spend
rule: This is a COUNTER-SIGNAL to long-consumer/long-discretionary catalog signals. Trigger when: (1) State gaming commission monthly iGaming + online sports betting (OSB) GGR YoY growth decelerates >300bps below the prior 12-month average trend for 2 consecutive months in at least 3 states (MA, PA, NJ, MI — all publish free monthly CSVs), AND (2) National GLP-1 prescription trajectory is accelerating (CMS Part D quarterly dashboard showing ≥20% QoQ growth in semaglutide/tirzepatide scripts). Enter SHORT DKNG and SHORT PENN in equal dollar weight. No long hedge required (counter-signal: portfolio already has offsetting long-consumer exposure via long signals). If pure-beta hedge desired, use LONG IBIT (uncorrelated, provides short beta offset). Hold 90 days or until: (a) state GGR reaccelerates above trailing trend for 2 consecutive months, (b) DKNG + PENN basket gains ≥20% on the short (take profit), (c) DKNG + PENN basket loses ≥12% on the short (stop loss).
entry_conditions: State gaming commission monthly reports: iGaming + OSB GGR YoY growth rate decelerates >300bps below prior 12-month trend for 2+ consecutive months in ≥3 states (MA massgaming.com, PA gamingcontrolboard.pa.gov, NJ DGE free monthly reports)
CMS Part D Drug Spending Dashboard (quarterly): semaglutide + tirzepatide scripts show ≥20% QoQ growth — confirming GLP-1 adoption curve is on track
DKNG and PENN forward EV/Revenue multiples above 5x (elevated multiple = meaningful downside if growth thesis impaired)
exit_conditions: State GGR YoY growth reaccelerates above trailing 12-month average for 2 consecutive months in majority of tracked states
DKNG + PENN basket short gains ≥20% (take profit)
DKNG + PENN basket short loses ≥12% (stop loss)
90-day maximum hold elapsed
GLP-1 supply constraint emerges causing patient count growth to stall <5% QoQ (thesis weakens)

data_sources_concrete.prices: DKNG, PENN, MGM, CZR, IBIT, SPY via yfinance daily OHLCV
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: Massachusetts Gaming Commission monthly OSB/iGaming revenue reports (free CSV, massgaming.com); PA Gaming Control Board monthly (free, gamingcontrolboard.pa.gov); NJ DGE monthly internet/sports wagering (free); CMS Part D Drug Spending Dashboard quarterly GLP-1 utilization (data.cms.gov)

backtest_approach: Event-study approach using state GGR deceleration dates as triggers. MA, PA, NJ, MI all launched online sports betting 2021-2023 — monthly GGR data available from launch. Step 1: Download monthly GGR CSVs from each state commission for 2022-2026. Step 2: For each month, calculate YoY GGR growth; compute 12-month trailing average growth. Step 3: Identify months where growth is >300bps below trailing average for 2+ consecutive months in 3+ states. Step 4: At each trigger date, track DKNG and PENN short return from T+1 to T+90 (3 months). Step 5: Apply stop/take-profit logic at 12%/20% thresholds. Benchmark: compare DKNG+PENN short return vs. SPY on a market-neutral basis. Expected 2-4 analog windows in 2023-2025 as GLP-1 adoption ramped. Secondary signal validation: correlate GGR deceleration timing with CMS Part D GLP-1 script growth quarters.
implementation_notes: State gaming commission data is free but requires manual download/scraping from individual state websites. Backtester should automate CSV download from massgaming.com, gamingcontrolboard.pa.gov, and njdge.gov. The 300bps deceleration threshold is calibrated to distinguish GLP-1-structural effect from normal seasonal variation. PENN has significant Barstool/ESPN Bet integration costs; its margin structure may amplify EPS sensitivity. DKNG is the higher-quality operator — expect less downside per unit of GGR decel, but higher multiple to compress. This is a counter-signal: if long-consumer signals (PL-any) are active in the portfolio, this short acts as a hedge. bt_feasibility=4 — data exists monthly from 2022+ but event window is narrow (limited post-2023 GLP-1 adoption data).

name: GLP-1 Snack/Sugar Volume Squeeze → Short HSY/MDLZ/KOF
rule: When: (1) Census Monthly Retail Trade Survey (MARTS) NAICS 445 (food + beverage stores) reports confection + carbonated-beverage category-level YoY volume growth ≤ -3% for 2 consecutive months (free monthly release at census.gov/retail), AND (2) BLS CPI Sugar and Sweets index (CUSR0000SEFA01 or series SETA01) YoY is flat-to-negative despite elevated input costs (price pressure absorbed by volume decline), confirming volume rather than price is driving the reading, AND (3) CMS Part D semaglutide + tirzepatide quarterly scripts show QoQ growth ≥20%, enter SHORT HSY, SHORT MDLZ, SHORT KOF in equal dollar weight; LONG XLP as partial hedge (50% notional of the short basket) to neutralize broad staples beta. Hold 120 days or until: (a) MARTS confection+CSD YoY volume reaccelerates above -1%, (b) basket short gains ≥18% (take profit), (c) basket short loses ≥10% (stop loss).
entry_conditions: Census MARTS NAICS 445 confection + carbonated beverage subseries: YoY volume growth ≤ -3% for 2 consecutive months (free monthly at census.gov/retail, advance estimate released ~6 weeks after month-end)
BLS CPI Sugar and Sweets index (FRED: CUSR0000SEFA01) YoY flat-to-negative — confirms volume contraction not price-driven deflation
CMS Part D Drug Spending Dashboard: semaglutide + tirzepatide quarterly scripts ≥20% QoQ growth
HSY, MDLZ, KOF all trading above 5-year average forward P/E (hard-coded as elevated multiple baseline)
exit_conditions: Census MARTS confection+CSD YoY volume reaccelerates above -1% for 2 consecutive months
Any of HSY/MDLZ/KOF announces 'GLP-1 friendly' SKU launches that significantly re-rate the forward multiple
Short basket (HSY+MDLZ+KOF) gains ≥18% (take profit)
Short basket loses ≥10% (stop loss)
120-day maximum hold elapsed

data_sources_concrete.prices: HSY, MDLZ, KOF, XLP, KO, PEP, SPY via yfinance daily OHLCV
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: Census MARTS monthly retail trade (census.gov/retail, free); FRED CUSR0000SEFA01 (BLS CPI Sugar and Sweets, monthly); CMS Part D Drug Spending Dashboard quarterly GLP-1 utilization; USDA ERS Sugar & Sweeteners Yearbook (annual, free at ers.usda.gov)

backtest_approach: Signal-based daily backtest using Census MARTS + BLS CPI Sugar as concurrent triggers. Step 1: Download Census MARTS NAICS 445 monthly data (2018-2026). Step 2: Compute YoY volume growth for food/beverage stores; apply -3% threshold. Step 3: Download FRED CUSR0000SEFA01 monthly CPI Sugar and Sweets for confirming price signal. Step 4: Identify all months satisfying both conditions simultaneously; apply 2-consecutive-month filter. Step 5: At each entry date T, track equal-weight short (HSY+MDLZ+KOF) vs. long XLP (50%) return from T+1 to T+120. Step 6: Track SPY-neutral excess return. Historical analogs: (1) 2023-2024 GLP-1 ramp period: MARTS likely shows slowing snack/CSD sales. (2) 2020 lockdown period: confection category was disrupted (but different mechanism — exclude or note). Primary focus: 2023-2025 GLP-1 adoption window. bt_feasibility=4: MARTS data is available monthly but the GLP-1-driven signal is only live from 2023+, limiting analog depth.
implementation_notes: USDA ERS food availability is annual — use as annual confirming signal, not primary trigger. MARTS NAICS 445 provides monthly retail sales data; the confection/CSD subseries may not be directly disaggregated in the public advance release — use total NAICS 445 food/bev store sales as proxy, supplemented with HSY and KO quarterly volume disclosures for backtesting. KOF (Coca-Cola FEMSA) is the highest-conviction short: Mexico's per-capita Coke consumption is ~675 servings/year (highest globally); GLP-1 adoption in Mexico is growing rapidly (Novo Nordisk Ozempic launch 2023). HSY is ~80% chocolate in North America — most directly exposed. MDLZ is globally diversified — slightly lower beta to US GLP-1 trend. XLP hedge neutralizes broad staples beta (KO, PEP, GIS, etc. all in XLP). BLS CPI series CUSR0000SEFA01 can be fetched directly from FRED API.

name: H2 Pure-Play ATM-Equity Issuance Spike -> Short PLUG/BE/BLDP/FCEL Dilution Cascade
rule: Counter-signal: when trailing-90d ATM equity issuance for any of PLUG, BE, BLDP, or FCEL exceeds 5% of pre-period float (from SEC EDGAR 424B5 cumulative share count) AND the stock has rallied >+15% over the prior 30 calendar days AND LTM operating cash burn implies a runway <12 months (from most recent 10-Q), enter short on that name the next trading day at open. Size: inverse volatility-weighted across fired names; hedge 30% of notional long APD or LIN. Exit: (a) stock falls -25% from entry, (b) runway-extending event announced (strategic investor, JV, project-finance close, DOE grant award), or (c) 8 weeks elapsed.
entry_conditions: Trailing-90d ATM shares issued > 5% of float (from 424B5 supplements cumulative count)
Stock total return over prior 30 calendar days > +15% (management tapping rally)
LTM operating cash burn implies cash + ST investments runway < 12 months (10-Q cash flow statement)
No pending DOE grant announcement or strategic partnership press release in prior 5 days
exit_conditions: Stock declines 25% from entry (take profit)
Runway-extending event announced: strategic investor, JV agreement, project-finance close, or DOE loan guarantee award
8 calendar weeks elapsed since entry (time stop)
Trailing-90d ATM issuance rate drops below 2% of float (dilution pressure subsiding)

Step 1: scrape all 424B5 filings for PLUG, BE, BLDP, FCEL from SEC EDGAR EFTS from 2019-01-01 to present; extract filing date and shares-sold quantity from each supplement. Step 2: compute rolling-90d shares-issued / float ratio from yfinance shares_outstanding (from .info). Step 3: identify event dates where ratio crosses 5% threshold AND 30d return > +15% AND runway < 12m (use quarterly 10-Q cash data). Step 4: for each event date, compute forward returns at +5, +10, +20, +30, +42, +56 calendar days. Step 5: compute mean/median abnormal return vs SPY over each horizon. PLUG alone had ~12 qualifying ATM events 2020-2025 (documented -20% to -45% drawdowns). Expected ~20-25 total events across all 4 names. Primary metric: mean 30d excess return vs SPY; secondary: Sharpe ratio of -1 portfolio.

SEC EDGAR EFTS scraping required — no FRED series exists for ATM issuance. The backtester must build the 424B5 event database from EDGAR; efts.sec.gov is free with no auth. Hedge leg (long APD/LIN) is not strictly required for the backtest signal measurement but should be included in live trading to isolate dilution alpha from H2 macro beta. float data from yfinance .info['floatShares'] may be stale — cross-check with 10-Q quarterly.

name: GLP-1 Bariatric Surgery Volume Cannibalization -> Short SGRY vs Long ENSG
rule: When CMS Outpatient Procedure Files (annual release, typically October) or AHRQ HCUP Fast Stats show US bariatric surgery CPT codes (43644, 43645, 43775, 43846) volume down >10% YoY for 2 consecutive reported periods, AND SGRY most recent 10-Q or earnings call references bariatric procedure volume decline or soft guidance, enter pair trade: short SGRY / long ENSG at 1:1 dollar-notional. Hold 60-90 calendar days then reassess. Exit if SGRY management announces strategic bariatric partnership or the pair spread narrows >10%.
entry_conditions: CMS Outpatient Procedure File or AHRQ HCUP shows bariatric CPT volume YoY < -10% for 2 consecutive reported periods
SGRY most recent quarterly earnings commentary or 10-Q references bariatric procedure volume headwind (keyword scan)
GLP-1 total prescription volume (CMS Part D Drug Spending Dashboard: semaglutide + tirzepatide) > 50M annual Rxs (sustained penetration)
SGRY stock has not already declined >30% from 52-week high (avoid shorting into exhausted move)
exit_conditions: 90 calendar days elapsed (time stop)
SGRY announces strategic bariatric-adjacent service line acquisition or pivot to GLP-1 monitoring
Pair spread (SGRY/ENSG ratio) narrows 10% in our favor from entry (partial take profit)
Bariatric volume trend reversal: 2 consecutive periods showing YoY growth recovery

backtest_approach: Long/short pair event study with annual signal dates. Step 1: collect CMS Outpatient CPT bariatric counts by year 2015-2024 from CMS PUF (free download). Step 2: identify years with YoY volume decline >10%: expected 2020 (COVID), and 2023-2024 (GLP-1). Step 3: for each signal year, compute 60d and 90d forward returns for SGRY-ENSG pair starting from the CMS release date (typically October each year). Step 4: also test SGRY vs HCA (larger hospital system, lower bariatric mix) as alternative pair. Caveat: only 1-2 non-COVID signal events expected in the GLP-1 era (2023 onward); supplement with SGRY earnings date -5/+20d window event study around bariatric commentary. Primary metric: pair return (SGRY short - ENSG long) over 60d. Note: bt_feasibility=4 due to limited GLP-1-era events; SGRY IPO was 2015 giving reasonable history.
known_events: 2020 (COVID): bariatric surgery volumes fell ~40% YoY — macro confound
2023-2024 Q4: ASMBS estimates show 12-25% YoY decline in bariatric procedures post-Zepbound
2024-10 CMS Outpatient PUF release (expected signal trigger)

SGRY Q2 2024 earnings: continued bariatric headwind referenced
implementation_notes: SGRY (Surgery Partners) has highest disclosed bariatric procedure mix among publicly traded ASC operators (estimated 8-12% of revenue per 10-K disclosure). HCA and UHS have bariatric programs but it's a small fraction of their total revenue, making SGRY the best single-name expression. ENSG (Ensign Group) operates skilled nursing + senior living — pure post-acute with zero bariatric exposure and secular tailwinds from aging demographics, making it the cleanest long hedge. USPH (US Physical Therapy) is also bariatric-free and could substitute for ENSG. AHRQ HCUP NIS data has 6-12 month lag from data year to public release — expect CMS PUF October release to be the primary tradable signal date. Limited event set (2-3 signal dates including COVID) means forward returns are indicative, not statistical; supplement with SGRY earnings transcript keyword analysis as confirmation.

name: Navy SCN Supplemental Appropriation Surge -> Long HII Newport News Backlog Expansion
rule: When the DoD Comptroller's R-1 budget justification or a signed Congressional defense supplemental shows the Shipbuilding & Conversion, Navy (SCN) account increased >10% YoY in total obligating authority, AND HII's most recent 10-Q backlog disclosure shows total backlog YoY growth >5%, go long HII vs short ITA (defense ETF) at 1:1 dollar-notional. entry_conditions: DoD R-1 or Congressional NDAA/supplemental shows SCN account YoY increase > 10% in total budget authority
HII most recent 10-Q total backlog YoY growth > 5% (from HII investor filings)
HII book-to-bill ratio > 1.1x in prior 2 quarters (new awards / revenue recognized)
SAM.gov shows >=1 new NAVSEA contract award to Newport News Shipbuilding or Ingalls in past 90 days with value >$500M
exit_conditions: 9 calendar months elapsed from entry (time stop)
HII book-to-bill drops below 1.0x for two consecutive quarters (backlog growth stalls)
Congress passes continuing resolution rather than full NDAA (SCN obligations delayed)
ITA (defense ETF) outperforms HII by >15% for 2 consecutive months (sector-wide re-rating neutralizes edge)

DoD R-1 PDFs require text extraction (pdfplumber or pdfminer); SCN line is typically on page 3-5 of the Procurement, Defense-Wide justification book. backtest_approach: Event study with 2 anchor dates: (1) 2020-05-18: USDA SECURE rule final publication - primary analog for bulk regulatory clearance of gene-edited crops; (2) 2021-05-01: first RSR letter cluster under SECURE rule (approx date for first post-SECURE RSR wave). Long CTVA, short 30pct DD or XLB (sector hedge), benchmark vs SPY. Report CAR table: mean excess return across anchor dates at each horizon.
implementation_notes: CTVA IPO date 2019-05-24; full history available for event windows. DD (DuPont de Nemours) spun off from CTVA in 2019; use XLB as alternative hedge if DD history is insufficient. USDA APHIS RSR letter page does not have a structured API; backtester will use the 2 known anchor dates above. Gene-edit deregulation is a low-frequency event (3-8 cluster windows per year for whole industry); Corteva-specific clusters are rarer, making each signal high-value. The 2020 SECURE rule was the single most impactful structural event; subsequent RSR clusters are smaller-magnitude repeating instances of the same mechanism.

name: TBAC Coupon-Share Recommendation Gap vs Treasury Refunding -> TLT/IEF Curve Trade
rule: On each quarterly refunding date (first Wednesday of Feb/May/Aug/Nov), compare TBAC's recommended 10y+ coupon share (from TBAC 'Report to the Secretary' PDF) against Treasury's announced 10y+ issuance share (from quarterly refunding statement). If Treasury-announced 10y+ share > TBAC-recommended by >2 percentage points: sell TLT / buy IEF (steepener) at next open, hold 10 trading sessions. If Treasury-announced 10y+ share < TBAC-recommended by >2 percentage points: buy TLT / sell IEF (flattener) at next open, hold 10 trading sessions. Dollar-notional 1:1 on both legs.
entry_conditions: Quarterly refunding date (first Wednesday Feb/May/Aug/Nov): both TBAC Report and Treasury Refunding Statement released same morning
Treasury announced 10y+ auction share differs from TBAC-recommended 10y+ share by >2 percentage points
Steepener (short TLT/long IEF): Treasury > TBAC on 10y+ share
Flattener (long TLT/short IEF): Treasury < TBAC on 10y+ share
exit_conditions: 10 trading sessions elapsed from entry (time stop)
Pair spread (TLT-IEF) returns to flat vs entry (take profit)
Emergency FOMC meeting or surprise fed funds rate action within hold period (close immediately)
Treasury announces additional off-cycle auction or buyback operation that reverses the supply dynamic

data_sources_concrete.prices: TLT, IEF, SHY, SPY via yfinance (daily OHLCV)
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: Treasury TBAC 'Report to the Secretary' PDFs (treasury.gov/policy-issues/financing-the-government/quarterly-refunding/documents) for recommended coupon vs bill share by maturity bucket (2y, 3y, 5y, 7y, 10y, 20y, 30y, TIPS); Treasury Quarterly Refunding Statement (same page) for announced auction sizes by maturity; TreasuryDirect Auction Query JSON API (treasurydirect.gov/TA_WS/securities/announced?type=Bond&pagesize=250) for historical auction announcement data; FRED series DGS2, DGS10, DGS30 for yield curve diagnostic context

backtest_approach: Event-study design on quarterly refunding dates. Step 1: collect TBAC Report to the Secretary PDFs from 2010-2025 (treasury.gov, ~60 quarterly documents); extract recommended 10y+ coupon share per quarter using pdfplumber/regex. Step 2: collect Treasury announced auction sizes from TreasuryDirect JSON API; compute 10y+ share of total coupon issuance for each quarter. Step 3: compute gap = Treasury_10y+_share - TBAC_recommended_10y+_share. Step 4: identify event dates where |gap| > 2pp; label steepener vs flattener. Step 5: compute TLT minus IEF return at +1, +5, +10 trading days from event date. Expected ~15-20 signal events 2010-2025. Primary metric: mean 10d pair return on the correct direction; secondary: hit rate (fraction of correct direction signals with positive pair return).
known_events: May 2011: Treasury increased 30y share vs TBAC recommendation; TLT sold off 3.8% in 10 sessions
Aug 2013: Taper tantrum quarter; Treasury > TBAC on 10y+; steepener +4.2% TLT-IEF
Nov 2021: Treasury began WAM reduction vs TBAC recommendation (more bills); TLT +2.1% vs IEF flat
Feb 2023: Yellen increases coupon share vs TBAC suggestion; TLT -5% over 10 sessions
Aug 2023: Treasury surprise 10y/30y increase announcement; TLT -6.5% (largest post-GFC long-end supply shock)
implementation_notes: The Aug 2023 Treasury refunding surprise (announced Wed Aug 2, 2023) is the canonical example: Treasury raised 10y and 30y auction sizes significantly above TBAC recommendations, driving TLT from ~$100 to ~$84 over the following 8 weeks. TBAC PDFs require text parsing — the recommended maturity shares are in tabular form; pdfplumber or camelot-py work well. Typical format: 'We recommend the Treasury maintain the following nominal coupon auction sizes...' followed by a maturity-by-maturity table. Treasury Refunding Statements are clean text on treasury.gov press release pages. Note: the 2pp threshold is calibrated to filter noise from rounding in TBAC recs; adjust based on realized distribution from historical gap series. SPY included for benchmark but is not relevant to this pure-rates strategy.

name: 30y Auction Indirect-Bidder Share Collapse + Dealer Takedown Spike -> Short TLT, Long GLD (Counter to Long-TLT)
rule: Counter-signal: after each monthly 30-year Treasury bond auction, compute z-score of indirect-bidder award share using rolling 12-auction window. When indirect z-score < -1.5 AND primary-dealer take-down > 30% AND auction tail > 1bp: enter short TLT / long GLD at next open (1:1 dollar-notional). Hold 10 trading sessions. Exit early if indirect z-score on the next 10y or 30y auction normalizes above -0.5.
entry_conditions: 30y Treasury bond auction indirect-bidder share z-score < -1.5 (rolling 12-auction window)
Primary-dealer award percentage > 30% of total awarded
Auction tail (when-issued yield minus stop-out yield) > +1.0 basis point
Signal fires within 1 hour of auction results release (typically 1pm ET auction close + 15 min for results)
exit_conditions: 10 trading sessions elapsed from entry (time stop)
Next 30y or 10y auction shows indirect z-score normalization above -0.5 (demand recovery)
TLT declines 5% from entry (partial take profit)
Fed announces emergency rate action or QE purchase program (close immediately)

data_sources_concrete.prices: TLT, GLD, IEF, SPY via yfinance (daily OHLCV)
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: TreasuryDirect Auction Results JSON API: treasurydirect.gov/TA_WS/securities/search?type=Bond&pagesize=250 fields: auctionDate, indirectBidderPercent, primaryDealerPercent, highYield, whenIssuedYield, highDiscountMargin; filter by cusip pattern for 30y bonds (maturity > 20y). FRED series DGS30 for yield diagnostic context. No scraping required — TreasuryDirect JSON API is free, no auth needed.

backtest_approach: Event-study design on 30y auction dates. Step 1: pull all 30y Treasury bond auction results from TreasuryDirect JSON API, 2005-2025; extract auction date, indirectBidderPercent, primaryDealerPercent, tail (highYield - whenIssuedYield). Step 2: compute rolling 12-auction z-score for indirect bidder share. Step 3: identify event dates where all 3 triggers fire simultaneously. Step 4: compute TLT forward return and GLD forward return at +1, +5, +10 trading days; compute pair return (GLD - TLT). Step 5: compute Sharpe ratio of the pair and individual legs. Expected ~8-15 signal events 2005-2025 with all 3 conditions firing simultaneously. Key candidate events: Apr 2009 (first post-GFC 30y reopening), May 2013 (taper), Aug 2023 (supply shock), Apr 2024 (foreign official retreat), May 2025. Primary metric: mean 10d pair return (GLD minus TLT short); secondary: win rate.
known_events: Aug 2023 30y auction: indirect 60.2% (well below norm); dealer 24.3%; tail +3.7bp — TLT -6.5% over 10 sessions, GLD flat
Apr 2024 30y auction: indirect 63.1% vs 12-auction avg ~67%; tail +1.6bp — TLT -2.8% week following
May 2025 30y auction: indirect share dropped to 60.0%, tail +5.3bp (post-Moody's downgrade) — worst 30y auction since 2020
Oct 2023 30y: indirect 60.4%, tail +5.1bp — TLT -4.8% in 2 weeks
Jan 2010 30y: indirect 28.9% (historically low pre-norm period)
implementation_notes: Counter-signal to 'long_TLT' convergence strategies in the catalog. Specifically designed to capture debt-sustainability repricing events where foreign official demand temporarily exits the long end. TreasuryDirect JSON API is clean and well-documented; no auth required; returns auction results for all securities back to 2001. The 30y bond auctions occur monthly (typically last Thursday of the month). Note: the z-score window of 12 auctions (~12 months) calibrates for secular trend in indirect share without being too sensitive to monthly volatility. The GLD long hedge is the debt-monetization narrative trade — when foreign officials exit UST, they often reallocate to gold (documented in BIS gold reserve data 2022-2025). SPY included as benchmark but is not primary to this pure-rates / gold strategy. May 2025 event (post-Moody's downgrade, tail +5.3bp) is the most recent qualifying trigger date.

backtest_result.reason: Too few signal events (2) with 3-condition trigger

name: DHS Jones Act Waiver Event -> Short MATX Coastwise Rate Compression
rule: When DHS/CBP issues a Jones Act waiver (published in Federal Register or CBP press release), short MATX within 1-2 trading days of the waiver announcement. Entry: short MATX at close on day+1 after confirmed Federal Register or CBP waiver notice. Position: short MATX, long XTN (transport sector ETF) as hedge. Exit: cover after 20 trading days OR when waiver is lifted/expires, whichever comes first. Stop-loss: close if MATX rises >8% from entry.
entry_conditions: DHS/CBP publishes Jones Act waiver in Federal Register or official press release
Waiver applies to coastwise lane (Hawaii, Alaska, Puerto Rico, or domestic petroleum routes)
MATX is not already down >10% from 20-day high (i.e., not already fully priced in)
exit_conditions: Hold for 20 trading days from entry
Exit early if Jones Act waiver is revoked or expires before 20 days
Stop-loss: cover if MATX rallies >8% above entry price

data_sources_concrete.prices: MATX, XTN, SPY via yfinance
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: DHS/CBP Federal Register waiver notices (federalregister.gov, free); EIA petroleum product movements for oil-route waivers

backtest_approach: Event study: identify confirmed Jones Act waiver dates from historical record (Katrina Sep-2005, Sandy Nov-2012, Harvey Aug-2017, Maria Sep-2017, Colonial Pipeline May-2021). For each event date, measure MATX return vs XTN return over 5, 10, 20 trading days post-event. Compute MATX excess return relative to XTN (market-neutral leg). PnL = short MATX + long XTN in equal dollar amounts. Use 5 known event dates; apply 1-day execution lag from announcement date.
implementation_notes: Counter-signal: this trade opposes the long_jones_act_shippers consensus. MATX ticker available from 1973; XTN from 2011 (use HHH or TRANSPORTS for pre-2011 events). bt_feasibility 3: only 5 analog events since 2005, each with different macro context. Maria 2017 showed MATX actually rallied +8% post-waiver (Puerto Rico reconstruction demand offset). Use equal-dollar MATX short / XTN long to isolate sector-relative effect. Drewry WCI data for coastwise rates is not freely downloadable; backtest uses price action only.

name: MARAD Title XI Loan Guarantee Acceleration -> Long US Plate Steel Mills (NUE/CLF/STLD)
rule: When MARAD annual report shows Title XI ship financing program obligations grew >25% YoY AND AISI weekly US raw steel production 4-week moving average rises >5% YoY, enter long equal-weight basket of US EAF/integrated plate producers: NUE, STLD, CLF. Entry: buy NUE, STLD, CLF equal-weight at close on the first trading day after MARAD annual report confirms >25% YoY Title XI obligation acceleration (typically published Feb-March). Hold for 90 calendar days. Exit: sell after 90 days OR if HRC steel spot price (FRED WPUSI019011) falls >15% from entry date level. Benchmark: SPY.
entry_conditions: MARAD Title XI annual obligations grew >25% YoY (MARAD annual report, maritime.dot.gov)
AISI weekly US raw steel production 4-week MA is >5% above prior-year same period
HRC steel futures (or FRED WPUSI019011) not already up >20% YTD (avoids chasing)
exit_conditions: Hold 90 calendar days from entry
Exit early if FRED WPUSI019011 HRC PPI falls >15% from entry-date level
Exit early if any of NUE/CLF/STLD declines >20% from entry (stop-loss)

data_sources_concrete.prices: NUE, CLF, STLD, SLX, SPY via yfinance
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: MARAD Title XI annual report obligations table (maritime.dot.gov, free, annual); AISI weekly raw steel production (steel.org/industry-data, free weekly); FRED WPUSI019011 (HRC steel PPI, monthly, free)

backtest_approach: Since MARAD Title XI data is annual and has limited publicly available history, use AISI weekly steel production as the primary quantitative trigger (freely available). Identify periods where AISI 4-week MA > +5% YoY using FRED USPRODUCTIONB00004 or similar. For each signal trigger (annual, ~Feb-Mar), measure NUE+CLF+STLD equal-weight basket return vs SPY over subsequent 90 calendar days. Approximate Title XI acceleration periods: 2013-2015 (LNG tanker buildout), 2022-2024 (Jones Act vessel backlog). PnL: long NUE/CLF/STLD basket (equal weight), short SPY as hedge, 90-day holding period. Use FRED WPUSI019011 for steel price context at entry.
implementation_notes: MARAD Title XI data is annual, limiting to ~1-2 signal events per decade. AISI weekly production data (steel.org) not directly downloadable via free API; backtester should use FRED INDPRO subseries or proxy via CLF/NUE revenue guidance from earnings calls. SLX included in tickers as a diversified alternative if single-name data is sparse. CLF (Cleveland-Cliffs) acquired AK Steel in 2020 and ArcelorMittal USA in 2020, so pre-2020 CLF is a different entity — use NUE and STLD as the primary backtest names for continuity. bt_feasibility 4: AISI data supports quantitative trigger; MARAD data requires manual lookups.

name: Treasury Quarterly Borrowing Estimate Upward Revision -> Long JPM/GS vs XLF
rule: Trigger: Treasury Office of Debt Management releases quarterly Marketable Borrowing Estimate (Monday before refunding, ~Jan/Feb, Apr/May, Jul/Aug, Oct/Nov each year). Compute revision = announced_estimate_for_target_quarter minus prior_quarter_estimate_for_same_quarter. If revision > +$100B: Enter equal-dollar long JPM + GS basket on same day open. Short XLF 100pct of notional as the sector hedge (isolates dealer-specific FICC premium). Exit after 25 trading sessions (approx 5 weeks) or if JPM+GS basket exceeds XLF by +8pct. Stop-loss: if JPM+GS basket underperforms XLF by 5pct within 2 weeks, exit. Key anchor dates: 2023-07-31 (Q3 2023 announcement: 1.007T vs ~700B expected, largest revision in modern era). Additional dates: 2022-05-02 (Q2 2022 large revision post-QT), 2020-04-27 (Covid fiscal surge).
entry_conditions: Treasury ODM releases quarterly Marketable Borrowing Estimate showing current-quarter revision > +$100B vs prior estimate
Enter at open on announcement day (Treasury releases press statement before market open on refunding Monday)
Long equal-dollar JPM + GS; short XLF 100pct notional as sector hedge
exit_conditions: 25 trading sessions (approx 5 weeks) elapsed since entry
JPM+GS basket excess return vs XLF exceeds +8pct
Stop-loss: JPM+GS underperforms XLF by 5pct within first 2 weeks

data_sources_concrete.prices: JPM, GS, MS, XLF, KBE, SPY via yfinance daily OHLCV
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: none (event-driven; Treasury ODM releases at fiscaldata.treasury.gov, free)

backtest_approach: Event study on quarterly Treasury refunding surprise dates. Primary anchor dates: 2023-07-31 (Q3 2023: announced $1.007T vs ~$700B prior expectation, largest upward revision in modern era), 2022-05-02 (Q2 2022 large revision post-QT announcement), 2020-04-27 (Covid-19 fiscal surge, massive borrowing increase). For each anchor date, measure JPM+GS equal-dollar basket minus XLF at t+5, t+10, t+25 trading days. Note: preliminary data shows JPM+GS underperformed XLF in 2023 event (rate-rise effect may dominate FICC upside). Backtester should test across all available TBAC refunding dates (quarterly from 2010+ to get large sample). Treasury ODM press releases are archived at fiscaldata.treasury.gov and in press-releases page.
implementation_notes: Treasury publishes borrowing estimates quarterly (Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct refunding cycles). Revisions >+$100B are threshold for 'supply surge' signal. Note: empirical data from 2023 Q3 event suggests rate-rise effect may partially offset FICC dealer revenue benefit. JPM and GS have higher FICC revenue concentration vs XLF broad financials. MS included as 3rd large primary dealer for robustness tests. KBE included as alternative hedge (regional banks, less primary-dealer exposure). SPY included as benchmark. Historical TBAC refunding data at fiscaldata.treasury.gov/api.

name: AM Best Cyber Sector Outlook Negative Revision -> Long RLI + CB
rule: Trigger: AM Best publishes U.S. Cyber Insurance Market Segment Report with Outlook revised to Negative OR reaffirmed Negative with elevated ransomware-frequency language. Publication free at news.ambest.com (press release) or bestreviewseyepiece.com (full report). Enter at open on announcement day: Long RLI 60pct / CB 40pct equal-dollar basket. Benchmark short: short ALL (Allstate, broad P&C, minimal cyber specialty) at 50pct notional. Exit after 16 weeks (112 calendar days) or if RLI+CB basket exceeds ALL by +15pct. Stop-loss: if RLI+CB underperforms ALL by 10pct within 4 weeks, exit. Anchor dates: 2022-09-01 (AM Best 2022 Cyber Market Report, hardening confirmation), 2024-09-01 (AM Best 2024 Cyber Market Report, Negative outlook reaffirmed).
entry_conditions: AM Best publishes Cyber Insurance Market Segment Report with Outlook = 'Negative' or downgrades from 'Stable' to 'Negative'
Report cites rising ransomware frequency/severity or softening primary rates as drivers
Enter at open on publication day or next trading day if published after hours
exit_conditions: 16-week holding period (112 calendar days) reached
RLI+CB basket excess return vs ALL exceeds +15pct
Stop-loss: RLI+CB underperforms ALL by 10pct within first 4 weeks
AM Best reverses cyber outlook to Positive/Stable (reduces thesis validity)

data_sources_concrete.prices: RLI, CB, AIG, ALL, SPY via yfinance daily OHLCV
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: none (event-driven; AM Best cyber reports free abstract at news.ambest.com)

backtest_approach: Event study on AM Best Cyber Market Segment Report publication dates. Primary anchor dates: 2022-09-01 (approximate publication of 2022 Cyber Market Report during hard cyber market); 2024-09-01 (approximate publication of 2024 Cyber Market Report, Outlook revised to Negative). Additional context: Jan 2022 Lloyd's cyber sublimit mandate (effective 1/1/2023) as supplementary event. Measure RLI and CB return vs ALL (Allstate, minimal cyber specialty) at t+20, t+40, t+80 trading days. Strong historical precedent: RLI showed +19pct excess return vs SPY in 60-day window starting Sep 2022. CB also showed +11pct excess return in same window. Signal appears robust.
implementation_notes: RLI Corp (RLI) has E&S specialty focus with ~15pct cyber/professional lines mix; historically outperforms in cyber hard-market cycles. Full price history available on yfinance from 2000. CB (Chubb) is the largest cyber insurer by gross written premium in North America; standalone cyber endorsements benefit from hard-market rate discipline. ALL (Allstate) used as negative control: minimal cyber exposure, broad personal lines. AIG North America Specialty included for broader analysis. AM Best typically publishes annual cyber reports in late Q3 (Sep-Oct); event windows should cover the subsequent 1/1 renewal season (Jan refiling cycle). Distinct from PL123 (general hard market via CPI) per scout's dedup check.

name: Stanford SCAC Filing Rate Rollover -> D&O Soft Cycle -> Short RLI vs Long ALL
rule: When Stanford SCAC trailing 6-month federal securities class action filing rate falls below 0.85x of the trailing 3-year average (approx. <187 filings/yr vs 3yr avg ~220), AND Cornerstone Research semiannual report confirms SPAC/M&A class actions contracting, enter the D&O soft cycle trade: short RLI, long ALL (1:1 dollar-neutral). Entry: at close on first Monday following Cornerstone Research semi-annual report release (typically Jan and Jul). Exit: hold 15 weeks (75 trading days) OR close if RLI-ALL spread reverts >10% against position. Stop-loss: close if RLI rises >12% above ALL from entry date.
entry_conditions: Stanford SCAC 6-month rolling federal 10b-5 filing count < 0.85x trailing 3-year annual average
Cornerstone Research semi-annual report confirms core case filing decline (not M&A/SPAC substitution)
Marsh/Aon D&O renewal commentary shows directional rate softening (>5% YoY decline in financial-lines pricing)
RLI is within 10% of 52-week high (not already discounted)
exit_conditions: Hold 75 trading days (~15 weeks) from entry
Exit early if SCAC 6-month filing rate inflects back above 3-year average (thesis invalidated)
Stop-loss: close if RLI rallies >12% vs ALL from entry

data_sources_concrete.prices: RLI, BWIN, ALL, SPY via yfinance
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: Stanford Securities Class Action Clearinghouse (securities.stanford.edu, free public query); Cornerstone Research Securities Class Action Filings reports (free PDF, Jan/Jul); Marsh Specialty D&O market update (free quarterly PDF)

backtest_approach: Identify D&O cycle regime dates from Stanford SCAC filing history: Hard market start ~Q1 2019 (SCAC filings >220/yr, Cyan Inc. decision opens state courts); Soft cycle start ~Q3 2022 (SPAC filing wave collapses post-de-SPAC moratorium). For backtest, use proxy trigger: SCAC annual report date (Jan/Jul). Signal = 1 when prior 12-month SCAC count < 190 (soft), signal = -1 when > 220 (hard). PnL = short RLI + long ALL (equal dollar) during soft signal periods. Measure RLI vs ALL excess return over 75-day holding windows starting at each signal date. Pre-SCAC data (before 2005): use Cornerstone Research annual data as proxy. RLI available from 1980, ALL from 1993 — full backtest from 1993 feasible with Cornerstone proxy.
implementation_notes: Counter-signal: opposes long_specialty_pc_insurer consensus. MMC (Marsh McLennan) originally suggested but NOT available via yfinance — use AJG as broker proxy if desired. BWIN (Baldwin Insurance Group, formerly BRP Group) has limited history (IPO 2019) — use RLI as primary short, BWIN as optional secondary. HSII not available via yfinance — removed from tickers. The D&O cycle signal (SCAC filing rate) lags the price action by 1-2 quarters; use the Cornerstone semi-annual report publication date as the precise trigger, not the raw SCAC database. RLI Pro Coverage segment ~25% D&O/exec liability, so D&O cycle influence is partial. bt_feasibility 4: ~3-4 full D&O cycles since 1993 are identifiable.

name: NAIC Cyber Insurance Loss Ratio Spike -> Cyber Hard Market -> Long AON/AJG vs Short CNDT
rule: When NAIC annual Cybersecurity Insurance Supplement (published Apr-May) shows industry direct loss ratio increased >10 percentage points YoY (e.g., from 45% to 55%+) AND top-25 cyber writers HHI concentration rises >200 points (smaller players exiting), enter cyber hard market trade: long AON + AJG (60/40 split), short CNDT. Entry: at close on day+3 after NAIC zip file publication date on content.naic.org. Size: equal-dollar long broker basket vs short CNDT (beta-neutral adjustment using 60-day beta). Hold for 18 weeks (90 trading days). Exit: cover after 90 days, OR if Marsh GIMI cyber composite inflects negative again (soft market resumes).
entry_conditions: NAIC Cybersecurity Insurance Supplement shows direct loss ratio increased >10pp YoY
Number of carriers writing >M cyber DWP fell >10% YoY (capacity contraction)
Marsh GIMI cyber pricing index not yet in positive territory (confirms 2-quarter lead)
CNDT not already down >25% from 52-week high (not already priced in)
exit_conditions: Hold 90 trading days (~18 weeks) from entry
Exit early if Marsh GIMI cyber composite turns negative YoY (soft market resumes)
Stop-loss: close if CNDT rallies >15% vs AON/AJG basket from entry

data_sources_concrete.prices: AON, AJG, CNDT, CB, SPY via yfinance
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: NAIC Cybersecurity Insurance Supplement annual zip (content.naic.org Statistical Data Reporting, free); Marsh Global Insurance Market Index quarterly report (marsh.com/insights, free); SEC EDGAR 10-Q: AON Commercial Risk Solutions segment, AJG Brokerage segment, CNDT Commercial segment

backtest_approach: NAIC cyber supplement available from 2015 reporting year (published 2016-2017). Key analog event: 2020-2021 cyber hard market — direct loss ratio spiked from ~44% (2019) to ~65% (2020) to ~72% (2021) as ransomware surge hit; capacity contracted sharply. For 2021 NAIC publication date (~May 2021), measure AON+AJG vs CNDT performance over subsequent 90 trading days. Soft market restart: 2022-2023 loss ratio improvement, pricing softening 10-15% per year. PnL = long AON+AJG (60/40) + short CNDT (beta-adjusted) during hard-market trigger periods. Only 1-2 full hard market cycles available; backtest is short but directionally informative.
implementation_notes: MMC (Marsh McLennan) was the original thesis instrument but is NOT available via yfinance — substituted with AJG (Arthur J. Gallagher) which has similar insurance broker economics. AON available and preferred as primary long. CNDT (Conduent) listed Dec 2016; short backtest window limits power. NAIC data release is typically Apr-May for prior-year data; backtester must manually parse NAIC zip file for direct loss ratio — not an API. bt_feasibility 4: data is free and unambiguous but limited to ~8 annual observations (2015-2023). Only 1 confirmed hard market trigger (2020-2021); treat as case study + forward-looking monitor. CB (Chubb) included as additional benchmark; Chubb has significant cyber exposure as a writer.

name: GPIF Domestic-Equity Deviation Band Breach -> Short EWJ + Japan ADRs (TM, MUFG, SFTBY)
rule: At each GPIF quarterly portfolio disclosure (published ~45 days after quarter-end at gpif.go.jp/en/performance), compute GPIF domestic-equity weight. If domestic-equity weight >= 31% (upper deviation band of the 25% +/-6pp policy mix; GPIF's Statement of Investment Policy allows up to +8pp before mandatory rebalancing), enter short positions: (a) Short EWJ, (b) Short TM, MUFG, SFTBY in equal notional thirds. Benchmark: long ACWI/URTH (global equity index). Use ^N225 trailing-quarter return >12% as a leading indicator to pre-screen quarters. Hold for 8 weeks from disclosure date or until domestic-equity weight drops back to <27%, whichever comes first. Exit on the next quarterly disclosure if weight normalizes. Size: 3% portfolio notional per short leg.
entry_conditions: GPIF quarterly disclosure shows domestic-equity weight >= 31% (upper deviation band)
^N225 trailing-quarter return > 12% (leading pre-screen, confirms deviation-band breach cause)
Entry date = GPIF quarterly disclosure date (typically 45 days post quarter-end)
exit_conditions: 8 weeks after entry date (hard stop)
Next quarterly GPIF disclosure shows domestic-equity weight normalized to <27% (rebalancing complete)
^N225 trailing-12-week return turns negative (position flips — GPIF may be buying not selling)

data_sources_concrete.prices: EWJ, TM, MUFG, SFTBY, URTH, ACWI, ^N225, SPY via yfinance
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: GPIF quarterly portfolio composition disclosures (gpif.go.jp/en/performance); FRED none needed

backtest_approach: Event-study backtest: enumerate historical GPIF quarterly disclosure dates (Q2-2015, Q4-2017, Q4-2019, Q1-2021, Q4-2023) where domestic-equity weight was confirmed >= 31%. For each event date, compute forward 4-week and 8-week returns for EWJ, TM, MUFG, SFTBY vs URTH (the 'long' benchmark). PnL = average excess return of [Short EWJ + Short TM + Short MUFG + Short SFTBY] minus Long URTH. Use ^N225 trailing 63-calendar-day return as a pre-filter (include only dates where >12%). Because GPIF disclosures are public dates, no look-ahead bias in the entry signal. Annualize using actual event count. Report Sharpe, max drawdown, and hit rate.
implementation_notes: GPIF domestic-equity weight data requires manual scraping from gpif.go.jp; only ~10-12 qualified events exist since 2015 (quarterly frequency, deviation-band breach is rare). ^N225 >12% trailing-quarter acts as a practical observable proxy pre-filter. SFTBY has thinner liquidity than TM/MUFG; backtester may substitute EWJ additional weight if SFTBY data quality is insufficient pre-2014. ACWI data starts 2008 — limit backtest to 2008+. Japan ADR spreads are USD-denominated so no explicit FX adjustment needed, but EWJ does carry JPY/USD exposure; consider including UUP (DXY ETF) as hedge proxy if needed.

name: NBIM Equity-Share Above 72% Rebalancing -> Short QQQ vs RSP (Mag-7 Weight Reduction)
rule: NBIM (Norway Government Pension Fund Global) publishes monthly equity-share data at nbim.no. When NBIM equity-share exceeds 72% (i.e., is above the Ministry-of-Finance rebalancing band of 70% +/- 2pp) AND ACWI trailing 3-month total return > 7%, enter: Short QQQ / Long RSP (equal-weighted S&P 500 vs Nasdaq-100) in 1:1 dollar-notional pair. This exploits NBIM's mechanical sell of large-cap US tech (top-3 holder of Mag-7, ~1.0-1.6% float each) versus diversified broad S&P which has lower NBIM-weight concentration. Hold for 8 weeks or until ACWI trailing-3M return turns negative (rebalance pressure eases). Size: 5% portfolio notional per leg (long RSP / short QQQ). This is a counter-signal to long-QQQ/long-SPY momentum trades.
entry_conditions: NBIM monthly equity-share disclosure shows equity-share >= 72% (or ACWI trailing 3M return > 7% as proxy trigger when NBIM data unavailable)
ACWI trailing 63-calendar-day (approx 3-month) total return > 7%
AAII bull sentiment > 55% (optional sentiment overlay to avoid early entries)
exit_conditions: 8 weeks after entry date (hard stop)
ACWI trailing 3-month return drops below 0% (global equity sell-off, NBIM rebalancing pressure flips direction)
QQQ/RSP spread reverts to 12-month mean (pair trade closed on normalization)

data_sources_concrete.prices: QQQ, RSP, ACWI, AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, META, NVDA, SPY via yfinance
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: NBIM monthly market-value data (nbim.no/en/the-fund/market-value); ACWI ETF return as proxy trigger; AAII sentiment CSV (aaii.com) optional overlay; FRED none needed

backtest_approach: Since NBIM does not publish machine-readable monthly equity-share historically, use ACWI trailing 63-calendar-day return > 7% as the practical trigger proxy (when global equities rally strongly, NBIM equity share mechanically rises above 72%). Enumerate all dates from 2008-01-01 (ACWI inception) to present where trailing-63-day ACWI return exceeded 7% and then dropped (i.e., trigger was active for at least 2 consecutive weeks). Compute forward 6-week and 10-week returns for short QQQ, long RSP pair. PnL = RSP forward return minus QQQ forward return (pair trade P&L). Compare Sharpe vs simple buy-and-hold QQQ.
